verses.sa:
त्वं ह्यग्ने प्रथमो मनोता ऽस्या धियो अभवो दस्म होता ।
त्वं सीं वृषन्नकृणोर्दुष्टरीतु सहो विश्वस्मै सहसे सहध्यै॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hyagne prathamo manotā 'syā dhiyo abhavo dasma hotā tvaṃ sīṃ vṛṣannakṛṇorduṣṭarītu saho viśvasmai sahase sahadhyai
verses.en: Thou, first inventor of this prayer, O Agni, Worker of Marvels, hast become our Herald. Thou, Bull, hast made us strength which none may conquer, strength that shall overcome all other prowess.

verses.sa:
अधा होता न्यसीदो यजीयानिळस्पद इषयन्नीड्यः सन् ।
तं त्वा नरः प्रथमं देवयन्तो महो राये चितयन्तो अनु ग्मन्॥
verses.tr: adhā hotā nyasīdo yajīyāniḻaspada iṣayannīḍyaḥ san taṃ tvā naraḥ prathamaṃ devayanto maho rāye citayanto anu gman
verses.en: As Priest thou sattest at the seat of worship, furthering us, best Offerer, meet for honour. So first to thee have pious men resorted, turning thy mind to thoughts of ample riches.

verses.sa:
वृतेव यन्तं बहुभिर्वसव्यै३स्त्वे रयिं जागृवांसो अनु ग्मन् ।
रुशन्तमग्निं दर्शत बृहन्तं वपावन्तं विश्वहा दीदिवांसम्॥
verses.tr: vṛteva yantaṃ bahubhirvasavyai3stve rayiṃ jāgṛvāṃso anu gman ruśantamagniṃ darśata bṛhantaṃ vapāvantaṃ viśvahā dīdivāṃsam
verses.en: In thee, still watching, they have followed riches, who goest with much wealth as with an army, The radiant Agni, lofty, fair to look on, worshipped with marrow, evermore resplendent.

verses.sa:
पदं देवस्य नमसा व्यन्तः श्रवस्यवः श्रव आपन्नमृक्तम् ।
नामानि चिद् दधिरे यज्ञियानि भद्रायां ते रणयन्त संदृष्टौ॥
verses.tr: padaṃ devasya namasā vyantaḥ śravasyavaḥ śrava āpannamṛktam nāmāni cid dadhire yajñiyāni bhadrāyāṃ te raṇayanta saṃdṛṣṭau
verses.en: They who approached the God's abode with homage, eager for glory, won them perfect glory: Yea, they gained even sacrificial titles, and found delight in thine auspicious aspect.

verses.sa:
त्वां वर्धन्ति क्षितयः पृथिव्यां त्वां राय उभयासो जनानाम् ।
त्वं त्राता तरणे चेत्यो भूः पिता माता सदमिन्मानुषाणाम्॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ vardhanti kṣitayaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tvāṃ rāya ubhayāso janānām tvaṃ trātā taraṇe cetyo bhūḥ pitā mātā sadaminmānuṣāṇām
verses.en: On earth the people magnify thee greatly, thee their celestial and terrestrial riches. Thou, Helper, must be known as our Preserver, Father and Mother of mankind for ever.

verses.sa:
सपर्येण्यः स प्रियो विक्ष्व१ग्निर्होता मन्द्रो नि षसादा यजीयान् ।
तं त्वा वयं दम आ दीदिवांसमुप ज्ञुबाधो नमसा सदेम॥
verses.tr: saparyeṇyaḥ sa priyo vikṣva1gnirhotā mandro ni ṣasādā yajīyān taṃ tvā vayaṃ dama ā dīdivāṃsamupa jñubādho namasā sadema
verses.en: Dear priest among mankind, adorable Agni hath seated him, joy-giver, skilled in worship. Let us approach thee shining in thy dwelling, kneeling upon our knees, with adoration.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा वयं सुध्यो३ नव्यमग्ने सुम्नायव ईमहे देवयन्तः ।
त्वं विशो अनयो दीद्यानो दिवो अग्ने बृहता रोचनेन॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā vayaṃ sudhyo3 navyamagne sumnāyava īmahe devayantaḥ tvaṃ viśo anayo dīdyāno divo agne bṛhatā rocanena
verses.en: Longing for bliss, pure-minded, God-devoted, Agni, we seek thee, such, meet to be lauded. Thou, Agni, leddest forth our men to battle, refulgent with the heaven's exalted splendour.

verses.sa:
विशां कविं विश्पतिं शश्वतीनां नितोशनं वृषभं चर्षणीनाम् ।
प्रेतीषणिमिषयन्तं पावकं राजन्तमग्निं यजतं रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: viśāṃ kaviṃ viśpatiṃ śaśvatīnāṃ nitośanaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām pretīṣaṇimiṣayantaṃ pāvakaṃ rājantamagniṃ yajataṃ rayīṇām
verses.en: Sage of mankind, all peoples' Lord and Master, the Bull of men, the sender down of blessings, Still pressing on, promoting, purifying, Agni the Holy One, the Lord of riches.

verses.sa:
सो अग्न ईजे शशमे च मर्तो यस्त आनट् समिधा हव्यदातिम् ।
य आहुतिं परि वेदा नमोभिर्विश्वेत् स वामा दधते त्वातः॥
verses.tr: so agna īje śaśame ca marto yasta ānaṭ samidhā havyadātim ya āhutiṃ pari vedā namobhirviśvet sa vāmā dadhate tvātaḥ
verses.en: Agni, the mortal who hath toiled and worshipped, brought thee oblations with his kindled fuel, And well knows sacrifice with adoration, gains every joy with thee to guard and help him.

verses.sa:
अस्मा उ ते महि महे विधेम नमोभिरग्ने समिधोत हव्यैः ।
वेदी सूनो सहसो गीर्भिरुक्थैरा ते भद्रायां सुमतौ यतेम॥
verses.tr: asmā u te mahi mahe vidhema namobhiragne samidhota havyaiḥ vedī sūno sahaso gīrbhirukthairā te bhadrāyāṃ sumatau yatema
verses.en: Mightily let us worship thee the Mighty, with reverence, Agni! fuel and oblations, With songs, O Son of Strength, with hymns, with altar: so may we strive for thine auspicious favour.

verses.sa:
आ यस्ततन्थ रोदसी वि भासा श्रवोभिश्च श्रवस्य१स्तरुत्रः ।
बृहद्भिर्वाजैः स्थविरेभिरस्मे रेवद्भिरग्ने वितरं वि भाहि॥
verses.tr: ā yastatantha rodasī vi bhāsā śravobhiśca śravasya1starutraḥ bṛhadbhirvājaiḥ sthavirebhirasme revadbhiragne vitaraṃ vi bhāhi
verses.en: Thou who hast covered heaven and earth with splendour and with thy glories, glorious and triumphant. Continue thou to shine on us, O Agni, with strength abundant, rich, and long enduring.

verses.sa:
नृवद् वसो सदमिद्धेह्यस्मे भूरि तोकाय तनयाय पश्वः ।
पूर्वीरिषो बृहतीरारेअघा अस्मे भद्रा सौश्रवसानि सन्तु॥
verses.tr: nṛvad vaso sadamiddhehyasme bhūri tokāya tanayāya paśvaḥ pūrvīriṣo bṛhatīrāreaghā asme bhadrā sauśravasāni santu
verses.en: Vouchsafe us ever, as man needs, O Vasu, abundant wealth of kine for son and offspring. Food noble, plenteous, far from sin and evil, he with us, and fair fame to make us happy.

verses.sa:
पुरूण्यग्ने पुरुधा त्वाया वसूनि राजन् वसुता ते अश्याम् ।
पुरूणि हि त्वे पुरुवार सन्त्यग्ने वसु विधते राजनि त्वे॥
verses.tr: purūṇyagne purudhā tvāyā vasūni rājan vasutā te aśyām purūṇi hi tve puruvāra santyagne vasu vidhate rājani tve
verses.en: May I obtain much wealth in many places by love of thee and through thy grace, King Agni; For in thee Bounteous One, in thee the Sovran, Agni, are many boons for him who serves thee.

verses.sa: त्वं हि क्षैतवद् यशो ऽग्ने मित्रो न पत्यसे । त्वं विचर्षणे श्रवो वसो पुष्टिं न पुष्यसि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi kṣaitavad yaśo 'gne mitro na patyase tvaṃ vicarṣaṇe śravo vaso puṣṭiṃ na puṣyasi
verses.en: Thou, Agni, even as Mitra, hast a princely glory of thine own. Thou, active Vasu, makest fame increase like full prosperity.

verses.sa: त्वां हि ष्मा चर्षणयो यज्ञेभिर्गीर्भिरीळते । त्वां वाजी यात्यवृको रजस्तूर्विश्वचर्षणिः॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ hi ṣmā carṣaṇayo yajñebhirgīrbhirīḻate tvāṃ vājī yātyavṛko rajastūrviśvacarṣaṇiḥ
verses.en: For, verily, men pray to thee with sacrifices and with songs. To thee the Friendly Courser, seen of all, comes speeding through the air.

verses.sa: सजोषस्त्वा दिवो नरो यज्ञस्य केतुमिन्धते । यद्ध स्य मानुषो जनः सुम्नायुर्जुह्वे अध्वरे॥
verses.tr: sajoṣastvā divo naro yajñasya ketumindhate yaddha sya mānuṣo janaḥ sumnāyurjuhve adhvare
verses.en: Of one accord men kindle thee Heaven's signal of the sacrifice, When, craving bliss, this race of man invites thee to the solemn rite.

verses.sa: ऋधद् यस्ते सुदानवे धिया मर्तः शशमते । ऊती ष बृहतो दिवो द्विषो अंहो न तरति॥
verses.tr: ṛdhad yaste sudānave dhiyā martaḥ śaśamate ūtī ṣa bṛhato divo dviṣo aṃho na tarati
verses.en: Let the man thrive who travails sore, in prayer, far thee the Bountiful. He with the help of lofty Dyaus comes safe through straits of enmity.

verses.sa: समिधा यस्त आहुतिं निशितिं मर्त्यो नशत् । वयावन्तं स पुष्यति क्षयमग्ने शतायुषम्॥
verses.tr: samidhā yasta āhutiṃ niśitiṃ martyo naśat vayāvantaṃ sa puṣyati kṣayamagne śatāyuṣam
verses.en: The mortal who with fuel lights thy flame and offers unto thee, Supports a house with many a branch, Agni, to live a hundred years.

verses.sa: त्वेषस्ते धूम ऋण्वति दिवि षञ्छुक्र आततः । सूरो न हि द्युता त्वं कृपा पावक रोचसे॥
verses.tr: tveṣaste dhūma ṛṇvati divi ṣañchukra ātataḥ sūro na hi dyutā tvaṃ kṛpā pāvaka rocase
verses.en: Thy bright smoke lifts itself aloft, and far-extended shines in heaven. For, Purifier! like the Sun thou beamest with thy radiant glow.

verses.sa: अधा हि विक्ष्वीड्यो ऽसि प्रियो नो अतिथिः । रण्वः पुरीव जूर्यः सूनुर्न त्रययाय्यः॥
verses.tr: adhā hi vikṣvīḍyo 'si priyo no atithiḥ raṇvaḥ purīva jūryaḥ sūnurna trayayāyyaḥ
verses.en: For in men's houses thou must be glorified as a well-loved guest, Gay like an elder in a fort, claiming protection like a son.

verses.sa: क्रत्वा हि द्रोणे अज्यसे ऽग्ने वाजी न कृत्व्यः । परिज्मेव स्वधा गयो ऽत्यो न ह्वार्यः शिशुः॥
verses.tr: kratvā hi droṇe ajyase 'gne vājī na kṛtvyaḥ parijmeva svadhā gayo 'tyo na hvāryaḥ śiśuḥ
verses.en: Thou, Agni, like an able steed, art urged by wisdom in the wood. Thou art like wind; food, home art thou, like a young horse that runs astray.

verses.sa: त्वं त्या चिदच्युता ऽग्ने पशुर्न यवसे । धामा ह यत् ते अजर वना वृश्चन्ति शिक्वसः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tyā cidacyutā 'gne paśurna yavase dhāmā ha yat te ajara vanā vṛścanti śikvasaḥ
verses.en: E'en things imperishable, thou, O Agni, like a gazing ox, Eatest, when hosts, Eternal One! of thee the Mighty rend the woods.

verses.sa: वेषि ह्यध्वरीयतामग्ने होता दमे विशां । समृधो विश्पते कृणु जुषस्व हव्यमङ्गिरः॥
verses.tr: veṣi hyadhvarīyatāmagne hotā dame viśāṃ samṛdho viśpate kṛṇu juṣasva havyamaṅgiraḥ
verses.en: Agni, thou enterest as Priest the home of men who sacrifice. Lord of the people, prosper them. Accept the ofrering, Angiras!

verses.sa: अच्छा नो मित्रमहो देव देवानग्ने वोचः सुमतिं रोदस्योः । वीहि स्वस्तिं सुक्षितिं दिवो नॄन् द्विषो अंहांसि दुरिता तरेम ता तरेम तवावसा तरेम॥
verses.tr: acchā no mitramaho deva devānagne vocaḥ sumatiṃ rodasyoḥ vīhi svastiṃ sukṣitiṃ divo nṝn dviṣo aṃhāṃsi duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema
verses.en: O Agni, God with Mitra's might, call hither the favour of the Gods from earth and heaven. Bring weal from heaven, that men may dwell securely. May we o'ercome the foe's malign oppressions, may we o'ercome them, through thy help o'ercome them.

verses.sa:
अग्ने स क्षेषदृतपा ऋतेजा उरु ज्योतिर्नशते देवयुष्टे ।
यं त्वं मित्रेण वरुणः सजोषा देव पासि त्यजसा मर्तमंहः॥
verses.tr: agne sa kṣeṣadṛtapā ṛtejā uru jyotirnaśate devayuṣṭe yaṃ tvaṃ mitreṇa varuṇaḥ sajoṣā deva pāsi tyajasā martamaṃhaḥ
verses.en: True, guardian of the Law, thy faithful servant wins ample light and dwells in peace, O Agni, Whom thou, as Varuna in accord with Mitra, guardest, O God, by banishing his trouble.

verses.sa:
ईजे यज्ञेभिः शशमे शमीभिॠधद्वारायाग्नये ददाश ।
एवा चन तं यशसामजुष्टिर्नांहो मर्तं नशते न प्रदृप्तिः॥
verses.tr: īje yajñebhiḥ śaśame śamībhiṝdhadvārāyāgnaye dadāśa evā cana taṃ yaśasāmajuṣṭirnāṃho martaṃ naśate na pradṛptiḥ
verses.en: He hath paid sacrifices, toiled in worship, and offered gifts to wealth-increasing Agni. Him the displeasure of the famous moves not, outrage and scorn affect not such a mortal.

verses.sa:
सूरो न यस्य दृशतिररेपा भीमा यदेति शुचतस्त आ धीः ।
हेषस्वतः शुरुधो नायमक्तोः कुत्रा चिद् रण्वो वसतिर्वनेजाः॥
verses.tr: sūro na yasya dṛśatirarepā bhīmā yadeti śucatasta ā dhīḥ heṣasvataḥ śurudho nāyamaktoḥ kutrā cid raṇvo vasatirvanejāḥ
verses.en: Bright God, whose look is free from stain like Surya's, thou, swift, what time thou earnestly desirest, Hast gear to give us. Come with joy at evening, where, Child of Wood, thou mayest also tarry.

verses.sa:
तिग्मं चिदेम महि वर्पो अस्य भसदश्वो न यमसान आसा ।
विजेहमानः परशुर्न जिह्वां द्रविर्न द्रावयति दारु धक्षत्॥
verses.tr: tigmaṃ cidema mahi varpo asya bhasadaśvo na yamasāna āsā vijehamānaḥ paraśurna jihvāṃ dravirna drāvayati dāru dhakṣat
verses.en: Fierce is his gait and vast his wondrous body: he champeth like a horse with bit and bridle, And, darting forth his tongue, as 'twere a hatchet, burning the woods, smelteth them like a smelter.

verses.sa:
स इदस्तेव प्रति धादसिष्यञ्छिशीत तेजोऽयसो न धाराम् ।
चित्रध्रजतिररतिर्यो अक्तोर्वेर्न द्रुषद्वा रघुपत्मजंहाः॥
verses.tr: sa idasteva prati dhādasiṣyañchiśīta tejo'yaso na dhārām citradhrajatiraratiryo aktorverna druṣadvā raghupatmajaṃhāḥ
verses.en: Archer-like, fain toshoot, he sets his arrow, and whets his splendour like the edge of iron: The messenger of night with brilliant pathway, like a tree-roosting bird of rapid pinion.

verses.sa:
स ईं रेभो न प्रति वस्त उस्राः शोचिषा रारपीति मित्रमहाः ।
नक्तं य ईमरुषो यो दिवा नॄनमर्त्यो अरुषो यो दिवा नॄन्॥
verses.tr: sa īṃ rebho na prati vasta usrāḥ śociṣā rārapīti mitramahāḥ naktaṃ ya īmaruṣo yo divā nṝnamartyo aruṣo yo divā nṝn
verses.en: In beams of morn he clothes him like the singer, and bright as Mitra with his splendour crackles. Red in the night, by day the men's possession: red, he belongs to men by day, Immortal.

verses.sa:
दिवो न यस्य विधतो नवीनोद् वृषा रुक्ष ओषधीषु नूनोत् ।
घृणा न यो ध्रजसा पत्मना यन्ना रोदसी वसुना दं सुपत्नी॥
verses.tr: divo na yasya vidhato navīnod vṛṣā rukṣa oṣadhīṣu nūnot ghṛṇā na yo dhrajasā patmanā yannā rodasī vasunā daṃ supatnī
verses.en: Like Heaven's when scattering beams his voice was uttered: among the plants the radiant Hero shouted, Who with his glow in rapid course came hither to fill both worlds, well-wedded Dames, with treasure.

verses.sa:
धायोभिर्वा यो युज्येभिरर्कैर्विद्युन्न दविद्योत् स्वेभिः शुष्मैः ।
शर्धो वा यो मरुतां ततक्ष ऋभुर्न त्वेषो रभसानो अद्यौत्॥
verses.tr: dhāyobhirvā yo yujyebhirarkairvidyunna davidyot svebhiḥ śuṣmaiḥ śardho vā yo marutāṃ tatakṣa ṛbhurna tveṣo rabhasāno adyaut
verses.en: Who, with supporting streams and rays that suit him, hath flashed like lightning with his native vigour. Like the deft Maker of the band of Maruts, the bright impetuous One hath shone refulgent.

verses.sa:
यथा होतर्मनुषो देवताता यज्ञेभिः सूनो सहसो यजासि ।
एवा नो अद्य समना समानानुशन्नग्न उशतो यक्षि देवान्॥
verses.tr: yathā hotarmanuṣo devatātā yajñebhiḥ sūno sahaso yajāsi evā no adya samanā samānānuśannagna uśato yakṣi devān
verses.en: As at man's service of the Gods, Invoker, thou, Son of Strength, dost sacrifice and worship, So bring for us to-day all Gods together, bring willingly the willing Gods, O Agni.

verses.sa:
स नो विभावा चक्षणिर्न वस्तोरग्निर्वन्दारु वेद्यश्चनो धात् ।
विश्वायुर्यो अमृतो मर्त्येषूषर्भुद् भूदतिथिर्जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: sa no vibhāvā cakṣaṇirna vastoragnirvandāru vedyaścano dhāt viśvāyuryo amṛto martyeṣūṣarbhud bhūdatithirjātavedāḥ
verses.en: May Agni, radiant Herald of the morning, meet to be known, accept our praise with favour. Dear to all life, mid mortal men Immortal, our guest, awake at dawn, is Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
द्यावो न यस्य पनयन्त्यभ्वं भासांसि वस्ते सूर्यो न शुक्रः ।
वि य इनोत्यजरः पावको ऽश्नस्य चिच्छिश्नथत् पूर्व्याणि॥
verses.tr: dyāvo na yasya panayantyabhvaṃ bhāsāṃsi vaste sūryo na śukraḥ vi ya inotyajaraḥ pāvako 'śnasya cicchiśnathat pūrvyāṇi
verses.en: Whose might the very heavens regard with wonder: bright as the Sun he clothes himself with lustre. He who sends forth,, Eternal Purifier, hath shattered e'en the ancient works of Asna.

verses.sa:
वद्मा हि सूनो अस्यद्मसद्वा चक्रे अग्निर्जनुषाज्मान्नम् ।
स त्वं न ऊर्जसन ऊर्जं धा राजेव जेरवृके क्षेष्यन्तः॥
verses.tr: vadmā hi sūno asyadmasadvā cakre agnirjanuṣājmānnam sa tvaṃ na ūrjasana ūrjaṃ dhā rājeva jeravṛke kṣeṣyantaḥ
verses.en: Thou art a Singer, Son! our feast-companion: Agni at birth prepared his food and pathway. Therefore vouchsafe us strength, O Strength-bestower. Win like a King: foes trouble not thy dwelling.

verses.sa:
नितिक्ति यो वारणमन्नमत्ति वायुर्न राष्ट्र्यत्येत्यक्तून् ।
तुर्याम यस्त आदिशामरातीरत्यो न ह्रुतः पततः परिह्रुत्॥
verses.tr: nitikti yo vāraṇamannamatti vāyurna rāṣṭryatyetyaktūn turyāma yasta ādiśāmarātīratyo na hrutaḥ patataḥ parihrut
verses.en: Even he who cats his firm hard food with swiftness,and overtakes the nights as Vayu kingdoms. May we o'ercome those who resist thine orders, like a steed casting down the flying foemen.

verses.sa:
आ सूर्यो न भानुमद्भिरर्कैरग्ने ततन्थ रोदसी वि भासा ।
चित्रो नयत् परि तमांस्यक्तः शोचिषा पत्मन्नौशिजो न दीयन्॥
verses.tr: ā sūryo na bhānumadbhirarkairagne tatantha rodasī vi bhāsā citro nayat pari tamāṃsyaktaḥ śociṣā patmannauśijo na dīyan
verses.en: Like Surya with his fulgent rays, O Agni, thou overspreadest both the worlds with splendour. Decked with bright colour he dispels the darkness, like Ausija, with clear flame swifily flying.

verses.sa:
त्वां हि मन्द्रतममर्कशोकैर्ववृमहे महि नः श्रोष्यग्ने ।
इन्द्रं न त्वा शवसा देवता वायुं पृणन्ति राधसा नृतमाः॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ hi mandratamamarkaśokairvavṛmahe mahi naḥ śroṣyagne indraṃ na tvā śavasā devatā vāyuṃ pṛṇanti rādhasā nṛtamāḥ
verses.en: We have elected thee as most delightful for thy beams' glow: hear our great laud, O Agni. The best men praise thee as the peer of Indra in strength, mid Gods, like Viyu in thy bounty.

verses.sa:
नू नो अग्नेऽवृकेभिः स्वस्ति वेषि रायः पथिभिः पर्ष्यंहः ।
ता सूरिभ्यो गृणते रासि सुम्नं मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: nū no agne'vṛkebhiḥ svasti veṣi rāyaḥ pathibhiḥ parṣyaṃhaḥ tā sūribhyo gṛṇate rāsi sumnaṃ madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Now, Agni, on the tranquil paths of riches come to us for our weal: save us from sorrow. Grant chiefs and bard this boon. May we live happy, with hero children, through a hundred winters.

verses.sa:
हुवे वः सूनुं सहसो युवानमद्रोघवाचं मतिभिर्यविष्ठम् ।
य इन्वति द्रविणानि प्रचेता विश्ववाराणि पुरुवारो अध्रुक्॥
verses.tr: huve vaḥ sūnuṃ sahaso yuvānamadroghavācaṃ matibhiryaviṣṭham ya invati draviṇāni pracetā viśvavārāṇi puruvāro adhruk
verses.en: I INVOCATE your Son of Strength, the Youthful, with hymns, the Youngest God, whose speech is guileless; Sage who sends wealth comprising every treasure, bringer of many boons, devoid of malice.

verses.sa:
त्वे वसूनि पुर्वणीक होतर्दोषा वस्तोरेरिरे यज्ञियासः ।
क्षामेव विश्वा भुवनानि यस्मिन् त्सं सौभगानि दधिरे पावके॥
verses.tr: tve vasūni purvaṇīka hotardoṣā vastorerire yajñiyāsaḥ kṣāmeva viśvā bhuvanāni yasmin tsaṃ saubhagāni dadhire pāvake
verses.en: At eve and morn thy pious servants bring thee their precious gifts, O Priest of many aspects, On whom, the Purifier, all things living as on firm. ground their happiness have stablished.

verses.sa:
त्वं विक्षु प्रदिवः सीद आसु क्रत्वा रथीरभवो वार्याणाम् ।
अत इनोषि विधते चिकित्वो व्यानुषग्जातवेदो वसूनि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ vikṣu pradivaḥ sīda āsu kratvā rathīrabhavo vāryāṇām ata inoṣi vidhate cikitvo vyānuṣagjātavedo vasūni
verses.en: Thou from of old hast dwelt among these people, by mental power the charioteer of blessings. Hence sendest thou, O sapient Jatavedas, to him who serves thee treasures in succession.

verses.sa:
यो नः सनुत्यो अभिदासदग्ने यो अन्तरो मित्रमहो वनुष्यात् ।
तमजरेभिर्वृषभिस्तव स्वैस्तपा तपिष्ठ तपसा तपस्वान्॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ sanutyo abhidāsadagne yo antaro mitramaho vanuṣyāt tamajarebhirvṛṣabhistava svaistapā tapiṣṭha tapasā tapasvān
verses.en: Agni, whoever secretly attacks us, the neighbour, thou with Mitra's might! who harms us, Burn him with thine own Steers for ever youthful, burning with burning heat, thou fiercest burner.

verses.sa:
यस्ते यज्ञेन समिधा य उक्थैरर्केभिः सूनो सहसो ददाशत् ।
स मर्त्येष्वमृत प्रचेता राया द्युम्नेन श्रवसा वि भाति॥
verses.tr: yaste yajñena samidhā ya ukthairarkebhiḥ sūno sahaso dadāśat sa martyeṣvamṛta pracetā rāyā dyumnena śravasā vi bhāti
verses.en: He who serves thee with sacrifice and fuel, with hymn, O Son of Strength, and chanted praises, Shines out, Immortal! in the midst of mortals, a sage, with wealth, with splendour and with glory.

verses.sa:
स तत् कृधीषितस्तूयमग्ने स्पृधो बाधस्व सहसा सहस्वान् ।
यच्छस्यसे द्युभिरक्तो वचोभिस्तज्जुषस्व जरितुर्घोषि मन्म॥
verses.tr: sa tat kṛdhīṣitastūyamagne spṛdho bādhasva sahasā sahasvān yacchasyase dyubhirakto vacobhistajjuṣasva jariturghoṣi manma
verses.en: Do this, O Agni, when we urge thee, quickly, triumphant in thy might subdue our foemen. When thou art praised with words and decked with brightness, accept this chanted hymn, the singer's worship.

verses.sa:
अश्याम तं काममग्ने तवोती अश्याम रयिं रयिवः सुवीरम् ।
अश्याम वाजमभि वाजयन्तो ऽश्याम द्युम्नमजराजरं ते॥
verses.tr: aśyāma taṃ kāmamagne tavotī aśyāma rayiṃ rayivaḥ suvīram aśyāma vājamabhi vājayanto 'śyāma dyumnamajarājaraṃ te
verses.en: Help us, that we may gain this wish, O Agni, gain riches, Wealthy One! with store of heroes. Desiring strength from thee may we be strengthened, and win, Eternal! thine eternal glory.

verses.sa:
प्र नव्यसा सहसः सूनुमच्छा यज्ञेन गातुमव इच्छमानः ।
वृश्चद्वनं कृष्णयामं रुशन्तं वीती होतारं दिव्यं जिगाति॥
verses.tr: pra navyasā sahasaḥ sūnumacchā yajñena gātumava icchamānaḥ vṛścadvanaṃ kṛṣṇayāmaṃ ruśantaṃ vītī hotāraṃ divyaṃ jigāti
verses.en: He who seeks furtherance and grace to help him goes to the Son of Strength with newest worship, Calling the heavenly Priest to share the banquet, who rends the wood, bright, with his blackened pathway.

verses.sa:
स श्वितानस्तन्यतू रोचनस्था अजरेभिर्नानदद्भिर्यविष्ठः ।
यः पावकः पुरुतमः पुरूणि पृथून्यग्निरनुयाति भर्वन्॥
verses.tr: sa śvitānastanyatū rocanasthā ajarebhirnānadadbhiryaviṣṭhaḥ yaḥ pāvakaḥ purutamaḥ purūṇi pṛthūnyagniranuyāti bharvan
verses.en: White-hued and thundering he dwells in splendour, Most Youthful, with the loudvoiced and eternal- Agni, most variform, the Purifier, who follows crunching many ample forests.

verses.sa:
वि ते विष्वग्वातजूतासो अग्ने भामासः शुचे शुचयश्चरन्ति ।
तुविम्रक्षासो दिव्या नवग्वा वना वनन्ति धृषता रुजन्तः॥
verses.tr: vi te viṣvagvātajūtāso agne bhāmāsaḥ śuce śucayaścaranti tuvimrakṣāso divyā navagvā vanā vananti dhṛṣatā rujantaḥ
verses.en: Incited by the wind thy flames, O Agni, move onward, Pure One! pure, in all directions. Thy most destructive heavenly Navagvas break the woods down and devastate them boldly.

verses.sa:
ये ते शुक्रासः शुचयः शुचिष्मः क्षां वपन्ति विषितासो अश्वाः ।
अध भ्रमस्त उर्विया वि भाति यातयमानो अधि सानु पृश्नेः॥
verses.tr: ye te śukrāsaḥ śucayaḥ śuciṣmaḥ kṣāṃ vapanti viṣitāso aśvāḥ adha bhramasta urviyā vi bhāti yātayamāno adhi sānu pṛśneḥ
verses.en: Thy pure white horses from their bonds are loosened: O Radiant One, they shear the ground beneath them, And far and wide shines out thy flame, and flickers rapidly moving over earth's high ridges.

verses.sa:
अध जिह्वा पापतीति प्र वृष्णो गोषुयुधो नाशनिः सृजाना ।
शूरस्येव प्रसितिः क्षातिरग्नेर्दुर्वर्तुर्भीमो दयते वनानि॥
verses.tr: adha jihvā pāpatīti pra vṛṣṇo goṣuyudho nāśaniḥ sṛjānā śūrasyeva prasitiḥ kṣātiragnerdurvarturbhīmo dayate vanāni
verses.en: Forth darts the Bull's tongue like the sharp stone weapon discharged by him who fights to win the cattle. Agni's fierce flame is like a hero's onset: dread and resistless he destroys the forests.

verses.sa:
आ भानुना पार्थिवानि ज्रयांसि महस्तोदस्य धृषता ततन्थ ।
स बाधस्वाप भया सहोभिः स्पृधो वनुष्यन् वनुषो नि जूर्व॥
verses.tr: ā bhānunā pārthivāni jrayāṃsi mahastodasya dhṛṣatā tatantha sa bādhasvāpa bhayā sahobhiḥ spṛdho vanuṣyan vanuṣo ni jūrva
verses.en: Thou with the sunlight of the great Impeller hast boldly over-spread the earth's expanses. So drive away with conquering might all perils. fighting out foemen burn up those who harm us.

verses.sa:
स चित्र चित्रं चितयन्तमस्मे चित्रक्षत्र चित्रतमं वयोधाम् ।
चन्द्रं रयिं पुरुवीरं बृहन्तं चन्द्र चन्द्राभिर्गृणते युवस्व॥
verses.tr: sa citra citraṃ citayantamasme citrakṣatra citratamaṃ vayodhām candraṃ rayiṃ puruvīraṃ bṛhantaṃ candra candrābhirgṛṇate yuvasva
verses.en: Wondrous! of wondrous power! give to the singer wealth wondrous, marked, most wonderful, life-giving. Wealth bright, O Bright One, vast, with many heroes, give with thy bright flames to the man who lauds thee.

verses.sa:
मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या वैश्वानरमृत आ जातमग्निम् ।
कविं सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्ना पात्रं जनयन्त देवाः॥
verses.tr: mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ā jātamagnim kaviṃ samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannā pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ
verses.en: Him, messenger of earth and head of heaven, Agni Vaisvanara, born in holy Order, The Sage, the King, the guest of men, a vessel fit for their mouths, the Gods have generated.

verses.sa:
नाभिं यज्ञानां सदनं रयीणां महामाहावमभि सं नवन्त ।
वैश्वानरं रथ्यमध्वराणां यज्ञस्य केतुं जनयन्त देवाः॥
verses.tr: nābhiṃ yajñānāṃ sadanaṃ rayīṇāṃ mahāmāhāvamabhi saṃ navanta vaiśvānaraṃ rathyamadhvarāṇāṃ yajñasya ketuṃ janayanta devāḥ
verses.en: Him have they praised, mid-point of sacrifices, great cistern of libations, seat of riches. Vaisvanara, conveyer of oblations, ensign of worship, have the Gods engendered.

verses.sa:
त्वद् विप्रो जायते वाज्यग्ने त्वद् वीरासो अभिमातिषाहः ।
वैश्वानर त्वमस्मासु धेहि वसूनि राजन् त्स्पृहयाय्याणि॥
verses.tr: tvad vipro jāyate vājyagne tvad vīrāso abhimātiṣāhaḥ vaiśvānara tvamasmāsu dhehi vasūni rājan tspṛhayāyyāṇi
verses.en: From thee, O Agni, springs the mighty singer, from thee come heroes who subdue the foeman. O King, Vaisvanara, bestow thou on us excellent treasures worthy to belonged fo r.

verses.sa:
त्वां विश्वे अमृत जायमानं शिशुं न देवा अभि सं नवन्ते ।
तव क्रतुभिरमृतत्वमायन् वैश्वानर यत् पित्रोरदीदेः॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ viśve amṛta jāyamānaṃ śiśuṃ na devā abhi saṃ navante tava kratubhiramṛtatvamāyan vaiśvānara yat pitroradīdeḥ
verses.en: To thee, Immortal! when to life thou springest, all the Gods sing for joy as to their infant. They by thy mental powers were made immortal, Vaisvanara, when thou shonest from thy Parents.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानर तव तानि व्रतानि महान्यग्ने नकिरा दधर्ष ।
यज्जायमानः पित्रोरुपस्थे ऽविन्दः केतुं वयुनेष्वह्नाम्॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānara tava tāni vratāni mahānyagne nakirā dadharṣa yajjāyamānaḥ pitrorupasthe 'vindaḥ ketuṃ vayuneṣvahnām
verses.en: Agni Vaisvanara, no one hath ever resisted these thy mighty ordinances, When thou, arising from thy Parents' bosom, foundest the light for days' appointed courses.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरस्य विमितानि चक्षसा सानूनि दिवो अमृतस्य केतुना ।
तस्येदु विश्वा भुवनाधि मूर्धनि वया इव रुरुहुः सप्त विस्रुहः॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānarasya vimitāni cakṣasā sānūni divo amṛtasya ketunā tasyedu viśvā bhuvanādhi mūrdhani vayā iva ruruhuḥ sapta visruhaḥ
verses.en: The summits of the heaven are traversed through and through by the Immortal's light, Vaisvanara's brilliancy. All creatures in existence rest upon his head. The Seven swift-flowing Streams have grown like branches forth,

verses.sa:
वि यो रजांस्यमिमीत सुक्रतुर्वैश्वानरो वि दिवो रोचना कविः ।
परि यो विश्वा भुवनानि पप्रथे ऽदब्धो गोपा अमृतस्य रक्षिता॥
verses.tr: vi yo rajāṃsyamimīta sukraturvaiśvānaro vi divo rocanā kaviḥ pari yo viśvā bhuvanāni paprathe 'dabdho gopā amṛtasya rakṣitā
verses.en: Vaisvanara, who measured out the realms of air, Sage very wise who made the lucid spheres of heaven, The Undeceivable who spread out all the worlds, keeper is he and guard of immortality.

verses.sa:
पृक्षस्य वृष्णो अरुषस्य नू सहः प्र नु वोचं विदथा जातवेदसः ।
वैश्वानराय मतिर्नव्यसी शुचिः सोम इव पवते चारुरग्नये॥
verses.tr: pṛkṣasya vṛṣṇo aruṣasya nū sahaḥ pra nu vocaṃ vidathā jātavedasaḥ vaiśvānarāya matirnavyasī śuciḥ soma iva pavate cāruragnaye
verses.en: At Jatavedas' holy gathering I will tell aloud the conquering might of the swift red-hued Steer. A pure and fresher hymn flows to Vaisvanara, even as for Agni lovely Soma is made pure.

verses.sa:
स जायमानः परमे व्योमनि व्रतान्यग्निर्व्रतपा अरक्षत ।
व्य१न्तरिक्षममिमीत सुक्रतुर्वैश्वानरो महिना नाकमस्पृशत्॥
verses.tr: sa jāyamānaḥ parame vyomani vratānyagnirvratapā arakṣata vya1ntarikṣamamimīta sukraturvaiśvānaro mahinā nākamaspṛśat
verses.en: That Agni, when in loftiest heaven he sprang to life, Guardian of Holy Laws, kept and observed them well. Exceeding wise, he measured out the firmament. Vaisvanara attained to heaven by mightiness.

verses.sa:
व्यस्तभ्नाद् रोदसी मित्रो अद्भुतो ऽन्तर्वावदकृणोज्ज्योतिषा तमः ।
वि चर्मणीव धिषणे अवर्तयद् वैश्वानरो विश्वमधत्त वृष्ण्यम्॥
verses.tr: vyastabhnād rodasī mitro adbhuto 'ntarvāvadakṛṇojjyotiṣā tamaḥ vi carmaṇīva dhiṣaṇe avartayad vaiśvānaro viśvamadhatta vṛṣṇyam
verses.en: Wonderful Mitra propped the heaven and earth apart, and covered and concealed the darkness with his light. He made the two bowls part asunder like two skins. Vaisvanara put forth all his creative power.

verses.sa:
अपामुपस्थे महिषा अगृभ्णत विशो राजानमुप तस्थुॠग्मियम् ।
आ दूतो अग्निमभरद् विवस्वतो वैश्वानरं मातरिश्वा परावतः॥
verses.tr: apāmupasthe mahiṣā agṛbhṇata viśo rājānamupa tasthuṝgmiyam ā dūto agnimabharad vivasvato vaiśvānaraṃ mātariśvā parāvataḥ
verses.en: The Migbty seized him in the bosom of the floods: the people waited on the King who should be praised. As envoy of Vivasvan MatariSvan brought Agni Vaisvanara hither from far away.

verses.sa:
युगेयुगे विदथ्यं गृणद्भ्यो ऽग्ने रयिं यशसं धेहि नव्यसीम् ।
पव्येव राजन्नघशंसमजर नीचा नि वृश्च वनिनं न तेजसा॥
verses.tr: yugeyuge vidathyaṃ gṛṇadbhyo 'gne rayiṃ yaśasaṃ dhehi navyasīm pavyeva rājannaghaśaṃsamajara nīcā ni vṛśca vaninaṃ na tejasā
verses.en: In every age bestow upon the singers wealth, worthy of holy synods, glorious, ever new. King, undecaying, as it were with sharpened bolt, smite down the sinner like a tree with lightning-flash.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमग्ने मघवत्सु धारयाऽनामि क्षत्रमजरं सुवीर्यम् ।
वयं जयेम शतिनं सहस्रिणं वैश्वानर वाजमग्ने तवोतिभिः॥
verses.tr: asmākamagne maghavatsu dhārayā'nāmi kṣatramajaraṃ suvīryam vayaṃ jayema śatinaṃ sahasriṇaṃ vaiśvānara vājamagne tavotibhiḥ
verses.en: Do thou bestow, O Agni, on our wealthy chiefs, rule, with good heroes, undecaying, bending not. So may we win for us strength. O Vaisvanara, hundredfold, thousandfold, O Agni, by thy help.

verses.sa:
अदब्धेभिस्तव गोपाभिरिष्टे ऽस्माकं पाहि त्रिषधस्थ सूरीन् ।
रक्षा च नो ददुषां शर्धो अग्ने वैश्वानर प्र च तारीः स्तवानः॥
verses.tr: adabdhebhistava gopābhiriṣṭe 'smākaṃ pāhi triṣadhastha sūrīn rakṣā ca no daduṣāṃ śardho agne vaiśvānara pra ca tārīḥ stavānaḥ
verses.en: O thou who dwellest in three places, Helper, keep with effective guards our princely patrons. Keep our band, Agni, who have brought thee presents. Lengthen their lives, Vaisvanara, when lauded.

verses.sa:
अहश्च कृष्णमहरर्जुनं च वि वर्तेते रजसी वेद्याभिः ।
वैश्वानरो जायमानो न राजा ऽवातिरज्ज्योतिषाग्निस्तमांसि॥
verses.tr: ahaśca kṛṣṇamahararjunaṃ ca vi vartete rajasī vedyābhiḥ vaiśvānaro jāyamāno na rājā 'vātirajjyotiṣāgnistamāṃsi
verses.en: One half of day is dark, and bright the other: both atmospheres move on by sage devices. Agni Vaisvanara, when born as Sovran, hath with his lustre overcome the darkness.

verses.sa:
नाहं तन्तुं न वि जानाम्योतुं न यं वयन्ति समरेऽतमानाः ।
कस्य स्वित् पुत्र इह वक्त्वानि परो वदात्यवरेण पित्रा॥
verses.tr: nāhaṃ tantuṃ na vi jānāmyotuṃ na yaṃ vayanti samare'tamānāḥ kasya svit putra iha vaktvāni paro vadātyavareṇa pitrā
verses.en: I know not either warp or woof, I know not the web they weave when moving to the contest. Whose son shall here speak words that must be spoken without assistance from the Father near him?

verses.sa:
स इत् तन्तुं स वि जानात्योतुं स वक्त्वान्यृतुथा वदाति ।
य ईं चिकेतदमृतस्य गोपा अवश्चरन् परो अन्येन पश्यन्॥
verses.tr: sa it tantuṃ sa vi jānātyotuṃ sa vaktvānyṛtuthā vadāti ya īṃ ciketadamṛtasya gopā avaścaran paro anyena paśyan
verses.en: For both the warp and woof he understandeth, and in due time shall speak what should be spoken, Who knoweth as the immortal world's Protector, descending, seeing with no aid from other.

verses.sa:
अयं होता प्रथमः पश्यतेममिदं ज्योतिरमृतं मर्त्येषु ।
अयं स जज्ञे ध्रुव आ निषत्तो ऽमर्त्यस्तन्वा३ वर्धमानः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ hotā prathamaḥ paśyatemamidaṃ jyotiramṛtaṃ martyeṣu ayaṃ sa jajñe dhruva ā niṣatto 'martyastanvā3 vardhamānaḥ
verses.en: He is the Priest, the first of all: behold him. Mid mortal men he is the light immortal. Here was he born, firm-seated in his station Immortal, ever waxing in his body.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवं ज्योतिर्निहितं दृशये कं मनो जविष्ठं पतयत्स्वन्तः ।
विश्वे देवाः समनसः सकेता एकं क्रतुमभि वि यन्ति साधु॥
verses.tr: dhruvaṃ jyotirnihitaṃ dṛśaye kaṃ mano javiṣṭhaṃ patayatsvantaḥ viśve devāḥ samanasaḥ saketā ekaṃ kratumabhi vi yanti sādhu
verses.en: A firm light hath been set for men to look on: among all things that fly the mind is swiftest. All Gods of one accord, with one intention, move unobstructed to a single purpose.

verses.sa:
वि मे कर्णा पतयतो वि चक्षुर्वी३दं ज्योतिर्हृदय आहितं यत् ।
वि मे मनश्चरति दूरआधीः किं स्विद् वक्ष्यामि किमु नू मनिष्ये॥
verses.tr: vi me karṇā patayato vi cakṣurvī3daṃ jyotirhṛdaya āhitaṃ yat vi me manaścarati dūraādhīḥ kiṃ svid vakṣyāmi kimu nū maniṣye
verses.en: Mine ears unclose to hear, mine eye to see him; the light that harbours in my spirit broadens. Far roams my mind whose thoughts are in the distance. What shall I speak, what shall I now imagine?

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवा अनमस्यन्भियानास्त्वामग्ने तमसि तस्थिवांसम् ।
वैश्वानरोऽवतूतये नो ऽमर्त्योऽवतूतये नः॥
verses.tr: viśve devā anamasyanbhiyānāstvāmagne tamasi tasthivāṃsam vaiśvānaro'vatūtaye no 'martyo'vatūtaye naḥ
verses.en: All the Gods bowed them down in fear before thee, Agni, when thou wast dwelling in the darkness. Vaisvanara be gracious to assist us, may the Immortal favour us and help us.

verses.sa:
पुरो वो मन्द्रं दिव्यं सुवृक्तिं प्रयति यज्ञे अग्निमध्वरे दधिध्वम् ।
पुर उक्थेभिः स हि नो विभावा स्वध्वरा करति जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: puro vo mandraṃ divyaṃ suvṛktiṃ prayati yajñe agnimadhvare dadhidhvam pura ukthebhiḥ sa hi no vibhāvā svadhvarā karati jātavedāḥ
verses.en: Install at sacrifice, while the rite advances, your pleasant, heavenly Agni, meet for praises. With hymns-for he illumines us-install him. He, Jatavedas, makes our rites successful.

verses.sa:
तमु द्युमः पुर्वणीक होतरग्ने अग्निभिर्मनुष इधानः ।
स्तोमं यमस्मै ममतेव शूषं घृतं न शुचि मतयः पवन्ते॥
verses.tr: tamu dyumaḥ purvaṇīka hotaragne agnibhirmanuṣa idhānaḥ stomaṃ yamasmai mamateva śūṣaṃ ghṛtaṃ na śuci matayaḥ pavante
verses.en: Hear this laud, Radiant Priest of many aspects, O Agni with the fires of man enkindled, Laud which bards send forth pure as sacred butter, strength to this man, as 'twere for self-advantage.

verses.sa:
पीपाय स श्रवसा मर्त्येषु यो अग्नये ददाश विप्र उक्थैः ।
चित्राभिस्तमूतिभिश्चित्रशोचिर्व्रजस्य साता गोमतो दधाति॥
verses.tr: pīpāya sa śravasā martyeṣu yo agnaye dadāśa vipra ukthaiḥ citrābhistamūtibhiścitraśocirvrajasya sātā gomato dadhāti
verses.en: Mid mortal men that singer thrives in glory who offers gifts with hymns of praise to Agni, And the God, wondrous bright, with wondrous succours helps him to win a stable filled with cattle.

verses.sa:
आ यः पप्रौ जायमान उर्वी दूरेदृशा भासा कृष्णाध्वा ।
अध बहु चित् तम ऊर्म्यायास्तिरः शोचिषा ददृशे पावकः॥
verses.tr: ā yaḥ paprau jāyamāna urvī dūredṛśā bhāsā kṛṣṇādhvā adha bahu cit tama ūrmyāyāstiraḥ śociṣā dadṛśe pāvakaḥ
verses.en: He, at his birth, whose path is black behind him, filled heaven and earth with far-apparent splendour: And he himself hath been. through night's thick darkness, made manifest by light, the Purifier.

verses.sa:
नू नश्चित्रं पुरुवाजाभिरूती अग्ने रयिं मघवद्भ्यश्च धेहि ।
ये राधसा श्रवसा चात्यन्यान् त्सुवीर्येभिश्चाभि सन्ति जनान्॥
verses.tr: nū naścitraṃ puruvājābhirūtī agne rayiṃ maghavadbhyaśca dhehi ye rādhasā śravasā cātyanyān tsuvīryebhiścābhi santi janān
verses.en: With thy most mighty aid, confer, O Agni, wonderful wealth on us and on our princes, Who stand preeminent, surpassing others in liberal gifts, in fame, and hero virtues.

verses.sa:
इमं यज्ञं चनो धा अग्न उशन् यं त आसानो जुहुते हविष्मान् ।
भरद्वाजेषु दधिषे सुवृक्तिमवीर्वाजस्य गध्यस्य सातौ॥
verses.tr: imaṃ yajñaṃ cano dhā agna uśan yaṃ ta āsāno juhute haviṣmān bharadvājeṣu dadhiṣe suvṛktimavīrvājasya gadhyasya sātau
verses.en: Agni, accept this sacrifice with gladness, which, seated here, the worshipper presenteth. Fair hymns hadst thou among the Bharadvajas, and holpest them to gain abundant vigour.

verses.sa: वि द्वेषांसीनुहि वर्धयेळां मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: vi dveṣāṃsīnuhi vardhayeḻāṃ madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Scatter our foes, increase our store. May we he glad a hundred winters with brave sons.

verses.sa:
यजस्व होतरिषितो यजीयानग्ने बाधो मरुतां न प्रयुक्ति ।
आ नो मित्रावरुणा नासत्या द्यावा होत्राय पृथिवी ववृत्याः॥
verses.tr: yajasva hotariṣito yajīyānagne bādho marutāṃ na prayukti ā no mitrāvaruṇā nāsatyā dyāvā hotrāya pṛthivī vavṛtyāḥ
verses.en: Eagerly Sacrifice thou, most skilful, Agni! Priest, pressing on as if the Maruts sent thee. To our oblation bring the two Nasatyas, Mitra and Varuna and Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
त्वं होता मन्द्रतमो नो अध्रुगन्तर्देवो विदथा मर्त्येषु ।
पावकया जुह्वा३ वह्निरासा ऽग्ने यजस्व तन्वं१ तव स्वाम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hotā mandratamo no adhrugantardevo vidathā martyeṣu pāvakayā juhvā3 vahnirāsā 'gne yajasva tanvaṃ1 tava svām
verses.en: Thou art our guileless, most delightful Herald, the God, among mankind, of holy synods. A Priest with purifying tongue, O Agni, sacrifice with thy mouth to thine own body.

verses.sa:
धन्या चिद्धि त्वे धिषणा वष्टि प्र देवाञ्जन्म गृणते यजध्यै ।
वेपिष्ठो अङ्गिरसां यद्ध विप्रो मधु च्छन्दो भनति रेभ इष्टौ॥
verses.tr: dhanyā ciddhi tve dhiṣaṇā vaṣṭi pra devāñjanma gṛṇate yajadhyai vepiṣṭho aṅgirasāṃ yaddha vipro madhu cchando bhanati rebha iṣṭau
verses.en: For even the blessed longing that is in thee would bring the Gods down to the singer's worship, When the Angirases' sagest Sage, the Poet, sings the sweet measure at the solemn service.

verses.sa:
अदिद्युतत् स्वपाको विभावा ऽग्ने यजस्व रोदसी उरूची ।
आयुं न यं नमसा रातहव्या अञ्जन्ति सुप्रयसं पञ्च जनाः॥
verses.tr: adidyutat svapāko vibhāvā 'gne yajasva rodasī urūcī āyuṃ na yaṃ namasā rātahavyā añjanti suprayasaṃ pañca janāḥ
verses.en: Bright hath he beamed, the wise, the far-refulgent. Worship the two widespreading Worlds, O Agni, Whom as the Living One rich in oblations the Five Tribes, bringing gifts, adorn with homage.

verses.sa:
वृञ्जे ह यन्नमसा बर्हिरग्नावयामि स्रुग्घृतवती सुवृक्तिः ।
अम्यक्षि सद्म सदने पृथिव्या अश्रायि यज्ञः सूर्ये न चक्षुः॥
verses.tr: vṛñje ha yannamasā barhiragnāvayāmi srugghṛtavatī suvṛktiḥ amyakṣi sadma sadane pṛthivyā aśrāyi yajñaḥ sūrye na cakṣuḥ
verses.en: When I with reverence clip the grass for Agni, when the trimmed ladle, fullof oil, is lifted, Firm on the seat of earth is based the altar: eye-like, the sacrifice is directed Sun-ward.

verses.sa:
दशस्या नः पुर्वणीक होतर्देवेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिधानः ।
रायः सूनो सहसो वावसाना अति स्रसेम वृजनं नांहः॥
verses.tr: daśasyā naḥ purvaṇīka hotardevebhiragne agnibhiridhānaḥ rāyaḥ sūno sahaso vāvasānā ati srasema vṛjanaṃ nāṃhaḥ
verses.en: Enrich us, O thou Priest of many aspects, with the Gods, Agni, with thy fires, enkindled. O Son of Strength, clad in the robe of riches, may we escape from woe as from a prison.

verses.sa:
[ ६ पुरस्ताज्ज्योतिर्वा ]।
मध्ये होता दुरोणे बर्हिषो राळग्निस्तोदस्य रोदसी यजध्यै ।
अयं स सूनुः सहस ऋतावा दूरात् सूर्यो न शोचिषा ततान॥
verses.tr: [ 6 purastājjyotirvā ] madhye hotā duroṇe barhiṣo rāḻagnistodasya rodasī yajadhyai ayaṃ sa sūnuḥ sahasa ṛtāvā dūrāt sūryo na śociṣā tatāna
verses.en: King of trimmed grass, Herald within the dwelling, may Agni worship the Impeller's World-halves. He, Son of Strength, the Holy, from a distance hath spread himself abroad with light like Surya.

verses.sa:
आ यस्मिन् त्वे स्वपाके यजत्र यक्षद् राजन् त्सर्वतातेव नु द्यौः ।
त्रिषधस्थस्ततरुषो न जंहो हव्या मघानि मानुषा यजध्यै॥
verses.tr: ā yasmin tve svapāke yajatra yakṣad rājan tsarvatāteva nu dyauḥ triṣadhasthastataruṣo na jaṃho havyā maghāni mānuṣā yajadhyai
verses.en: In thee, most wise, shall Dyaus, for full perfection, King! Holy One! pronounce the call to worship. Found in three places, like the Speeder's footstep, come to present men's riches as oblations!

verses.sa:
तेजिष्ठा यस्यारतिर्वनेराट् तोदो अध्वन् न वृधसानो अद्यौत् ।
अद्रोघो न द्रविता चेतति त्मन्नमर्त्योऽवर्त्र ओषधीषु॥
verses.tr: tejiṣṭhā yasyāratirvanerāṭ todo adhvan na vṛdhasāno adyaut adrogho na dravitā cetati tmannamartyo'vartra oṣadhīṣu
verses.en: Whose blaze most splendid, sovran in the forest, shines waxing on his way like the - Impeller. He knows himself, like as a guileless smelter, not to be stayed among the plants, Immortal.

verses.sa:
सास्माकेभिरेतरी न शूषैरग्निः ष्टवे दम आ जातवेदाः ।
द्र्वन्नो वन्वन् क्रत्वा नार्वोस्रः पितेव जारयायि यज्ञैः॥
verses.tr: sāsmākebhiretarī na śūṣairagniḥ ṣṭave dama ā jātavedāḥ drvanno vanvan kratvā nārvosraḥ piteva jārayāyi yajñaiḥ
verses.en: Our friends extol him like a steed for vigour even Agni in the dwelling, jatave~as. Trce-fed, he fights with power as doth a champion, like Dawn's Sire to be praised with sacrifices.

verses.sa:
अध स्मास्य पनयन्ति भासो वृथा यत् तक्षदनुयाति पृथ्वीम् ।
सद्यो यः स्पन्द्रो विषितो धवीयानृणो न तायुरति धन्वा राट्॥
verses.tr: adha smāsya panayanti bhāso vṛthā yat takṣadanuyāti pṛthvīm sadyo yaḥ spandro viṣito dhavīyānṛṇo na tāyurati dhanvā rāṭ
verses.en: Men wonder at his shining glows when, paring the woods with case, o'er the broad earth he goeth, And, like a rushing flood, loosed quickly, burneth, swift as a guilty thief, o'er desert places.

verses.sa:
स त्वं नो अर्वन् निदाया विश्वेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिधानः ।
वेषि रायो वि यासि दुच्छुना मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ no arvan nidāyā viśvebhiragne agnibhiridhānaḥ veṣi rāyo vi yāsi ducchunā madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ
verses.en: So mighty thou protectest us from slander, O Champion, Agni! with all fires enkindled. Bring opulence and drive away affliction. May brave sons gladden us through a hundred winters.

verses.sa:
त्वद् विश्वा सुभग सौभगान्यग्ने वि यन्ति वनिनो न वयाः ।
श्रुष्टी रयिर्वाजो वृत्रतूर्ये दिवो वृष्टिरीड्यो रीतिरपाम्॥
verses.tr: tvad viśvā subhaga saubhagānyagne vi yanti vanino na vayāḥ śruṣṭī rayirvājo vṛtratūrye divo vṛṣṭirīḍyo rītirapām
verses.en: From thee, as branches from a tree, O Agni, from thee, Auspicious God! spring all our blessings- Wealth swiftly, strength in battle with our foemen, the rain besought of heaven, the flow of waters.

verses.sa:
त्वं भगो न आ हि रत्नमिषे परिज्मेव क्षयसि दस्मवर्चाः ।
अग्ने मित्रो न बृहत ऋतस्याऽसि क्षत्ता वामस्य देव भूरेः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ bhago na ā hi ratnamiṣe parijmeva kṣayasi dasmavarcāḥ agne mitro na bṛhata ṛtasyā'si kṣattā vāmasya deva bhūreḥ
verses.en: Thou art our Bhaga to send wealth thou dwellest, like circumambient air, with wondrous splendour. Friend art thou of the lofty Law, like Mitra, Controller, Agni! God! of many a blessing.

verses.sa:
स सत्पतिः शवसा हन्ति वृत्रमग्ने विप्रो वि पणेर्भर्ति वाजम् ।
यं त्वं प्रचेत ऋतजात राया सजोषा नप्त्रापां हिनोषि॥
verses.tr: sa satpatiḥ śavasā hanti vṛtramagne vipro vi paṇerbharti vājam yaṃ tvaṃ praceta ṛtajāta rāyā sajoṣā naptrāpāṃ hinoṣi
verses.en: Agni! the hero slays with might his foeman; the singer bears away the Pani's booty- Even he whom thou, Sage, born in Law, incitest by wealth, accordant with the Child of Waters.

verses.sa:
यस्ते सूनो सहसो गीर्भिरुक्थैर्यज्ञैर्मर्तो निशितिं वेद्यानट् ।
विश्वं स देव प्रति वारमग्ने धत्ते धान्यं१ पत्यते वसव्यैः॥
verses.tr: yaste sūno sahaso gīrbhirukthairyajñairmarto niśitiṃ vedyānaṭ viśvaṃ sa deva prati vāramagne dhatte dhānyaṃ1 patyate vasavyaiḥ
verses.en: The man who, Son of Strength one with sacrifices, hymns, lauds, attracts thy fervour to the altar, Enjoys each precious thing, O God, O Agni, gains wealth of corn and is the lord of treasures.

verses.sa:
ता नृभ्य आ सौश्रवसा सुवीरा ऽग्ने सूनो सहसः पुष्यसे धाः ।
कृणोषि यच्छवसा भूरि पश्वो वयो वृकायारये जसुरये॥
verses.tr: tā nṛbhya ā sauśravasā suvīrā 'gne sūno sahasaḥ puṣyase dhāḥ kṛṇoṣi yacchavasā bhūri paśvo vayo vṛkāyāraye jasuraye
verses.en: Grant, Son of Strength, to men for their subsistence such things as bring high fame and hero children. For thou with might givest much food in cattle even to the wicked wolf when he is hungry.

verses.sa:
वद्मा सूनो सहसो नो विहाया अग्ने तोकं तनयं वाजि नो दाः ।
विश्वाभिर्गीर्भिरभि पूर्तिमश्यां मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: vadmā sūno sahaso no vihāyā agne tokaṃ tanayaṃ vāji no dāḥ viśvābhirgīrbhirabhi pūrtimaśyāṃ madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Eloquent, Son of Strength, Most Mighty, Agni, vouchsafe us seed and offspring, full of vigour. May I by all my songs obtain abundance. May brave sons gladden us through a hundred winters.

verses.sa: अग्ना यो मर्त्यो दुवो धियं जुजोष धीतिभिः । भसन्नु ष प्र पूर्व्य इषं वुरीतावसे॥
verses.tr: agnā yo martyo duvo dhiyaṃ jujoṣa dhītibhiḥ bhasannu ṣa pra pūrvya iṣaṃ vurītāvase
verses.en: Whoso to Agni hath endeared his thought and service by his hymns, That mortal eats before the rest, and finds sufficiency of food.

verses.sa: अग्निरिद्धि प्रचेता अग्निर्वेधस्तम ऋषिः । अग्निं होतारमीळते यज्ञेषु मनुषो विशः॥
verses.tr: agniriddhi pracetā agnirvedhastama ṛṣiḥ agniṃ hotāramīḻate yajñeṣu manuṣo viśaḥ
verses.en: Agni, in truth, is passing wise, most skilled in ordering, a Seer. At sacrifices Manus' sons glorify Agni as their Priest.

verses.sa: नाना ह्य१ग्नेऽवसे स्पर्धन्ते रायो अर्यः । तूर्वन्तो दस्युमायवो व्रतैः सीक्षन्तो अव्रतम्॥
verses.tr: nānā hya1gne'vase spardhante rāyo aryaḥ tūrvanto dasyumāyavo vrataiḥ sīkṣanto avratam
verses.en: The foeman's wealth in many a place, Agni, is emulous to help. Men fight the fiend, and seek by rites to overcome the riteless foe.

verses.sa: अग्निरप्सामृतीषहं वीरं ददाति सत्पतिम् । यस्य त्रसन्ति शवसः संचक्षि शत्रवो भिया॥
verses.tr: agnirapsāmṛtīṣahaṃ vīraṃ dadāti satpatim yasya trasanti śavasaḥ saṃcakṣi śatravo bhiyā
verses.en: Agni bestows the hero chief, winner of waters, firm in fray. Soon as they look upon his might his enemies tremble in alarm.

verses.sa: अग्निर्हि विद्मना निदो देवो मर्तमुरुष्यति । सहावा यस्यावृतो रयिर्वाजेष्ववृतः॥
verses.tr: agnirhi vidmanā nido devo martamuruṣyati sahāvā yasyāvṛto rayirvājeṣvavṛtaḥ
verses.en: For with his wisdom Agni, God, protects the mortal from reproach, Whose conquering wealth is never checked, is never checked in deeds of might.

verses.sa:
अच्छा नो मित्रमहो देव देवानग्ने वोचः सुमतिं रोदस्योः ।
वीहि स्वस्तिं सुक्षितिं दिवो नॄन् द्विषो अंहांसि दुरिता तरेम ता तरेम तवावसा तरेम॥
verses.tr: acchā no mitramaho deva devānagne vocaḥ sumatiṃ rodasyoḥ vīhi svastiṃ sukṣitiṃ divo nṝn dviṣo aṃhāṃsi duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema
verses.en: O Agni, God with Mitra's might call hither the favour of the Gods from earth and heaven. Bring weal from heaven that men may dwell securely. May we o'ercome the foe's malign oppressions, may we o'ercome them, through thy help o'ercome them.

verses.sa:
अग्नि : ।जगती; ३; १५ शक्वरी;
६ अतिशक्वरी; १० – १४, १६,१९ त्रिष्टुप् , १७ अनुष्टुप् ; १८ बृहती ।
इममू षु वो अतिथिमुषर्बुधं विश्वासां विशां पतिमृञ्जसे गिरा ।
वेतीद् दिवो जनुषा कच्चिदा शुचिर्ज्योक् चिदत्ति गर्भो यदच्युतम्॥
verses.tr: agni : jagatī; 3; 15 śakvarī; 6 atiśakvarī; 10 – 14, 16,19 triṣṭup , 17 anuṣṭup ; 18 bṛhatī imamū ṣu vo atithimuṣarbudhaṃ viśvāsāṃ viśāṃ patimṛñjase girā vetīd divo januṣā kaccidā śucirjyok cidatti garbho yadacyutam
verses.en: With this my song I strive to reach this guest of yours, who wakes at early morn, the Lord of all the tribes. Each time he comes from heaven, the Pure One from of old: from ancient days the Child eats everlasting food.

verses.sa:
मित्रं न यं सुधितं भृगवो दधुर्वनस्पतावीड्यमूर्ध्वशोचिषम् ।
स त्वं सुप्रीतो वीतहव्ये अद्भुत प्रशस्तिभिर्महयसे दिवेदिवे॥
verses.tr: mitraṃ na yaṃ sudhitaṃ bhṛgavo dadhurvanaspatāvīḍyamūrdhvaśociṣam sa tvaṃ suprīto vītahavye adbhuta praśastibhirmahayase divedive
verses.en: Whom, well disposed, the Bhrgus stablished as a friend, whom men must glorify, high-flaming in the wood. As such, most friendly, thou art every day extolled in lauds by Vitahavya, O thou wondrous God.

verses.sa:
स त्वं दक्षस्यावृको वृधो भूरर्यः परस्यान्तरस्य तरुषः ।
रायः सूनो सहसो मर्त्येष्वा छर्दिर्यच्छ वीतहव्याय सप्रथो भरद्वाजाय सप्रथः॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ dakṣasyāvṛko vṛdho bhūraryaḥ parasyāntarasya taruṣaḥ rāyaḥ sūno sahaso martyeṣvā chardiryaccha vītahavyāya sapratho bharadvājāya saprathaḥ
verses.en: Be thou the foeless helper of the skilful man, subduer of the enemy near or far away. Bestow a wealthy home on men, O Son of Strength. Give Vitahavya riches spreading far and wide, give Bharadvaja wide-spread wealth.

verses.sa:
द्युतानं वो अतिथिं स्वर्णरमग्निं होतारं मनुषः स्वध्वरम् ।
विप्रं न द्युक्षवचसं सुवृक्तिभिर्हव्यवाहमरतिं देवमृञ्जसे॥
verses.tr: dyutānaṃ vo atithiṃ svarṇaramagniṃ hotāraṃ manuṣaḥ svadhvaram vipraṃ na dyukṣavacasaṃ suvṛktibhirhavyavāhamaratiṃ devamṛñjase
verses.en: Him, your refulgent guest, Agni who comes from heaven, the Herald of mankind, well-skilled in sacred rites, Who, like a holy singer, utters heavenly words, oblation-bearer, envoy, God, I seek with hymns.

verses.sa:
पावकया यश्चितयन्त्या कृपा क्षामन् रुरुच उषसो न भानुना ।
तूर्वन् न यामन्नेतशस्य नू रण आ यो घृणे न ततृषाणो अजरः॥
verses.tr: pāvakayā yaścitayantyā kṛpā kṣāman ruruca uṣaso na bhānunā tūrvan na yāmannetaśasya nū raṇa ā yo ghṛṇe na tatṛṣāṇo ajaraḥ
verses.en: Who with his purifying, eye-attracting form hath shone upon the earth as with the light of Dawn; Who speeding on, as in the fight of Etaia, cometh, untouched by age, as one athirst in heat.

verses.sa:
अग्निमग्निं वः समिधा दुवस्यत प्रियंप्रियं वो अतिथिं गृणीषणि ।
उप वो गीर्भिरमृतं विवासत देवो देवेषु वनते हि वार्यं देवो देवेषु वनते हि नो दुवः॥
verses.tr: agnimagniṃ vaḥ samidhā duvasyata priyaṃpriyaṃ vo atithiṃ gṛṇīṣaṇi upa vo gīrbhiramṛtaṃ vivāsata devo deveṣu vanate hi vāryaṃ devo deveṣu vanate hi no duvaḥ
verses.en: Worship ye Agni, Agni, with your log of wood; praise your beloved, your beloved guest with songs. Invite ye the Immortal hither with your hymns. A God among the Gods, he loveth what is choice, loveth our service, God mid Gods.

verses.sa:
समिद्धमग्निं समिधा गिरा गृणे शुचिं पावकं पुरो अध्वरे ध्रुवम् ।
विप्रं होतारं पुरुवारमद्रुहं कविं सुम्नैरीमहे जातवेदसम्॥
verses.tr: samiddhamagniṃ samidhā girā gṛṇe śuciṃ pāvakaṃ puro adhvare dhruvam vipraṃ hotāraṃ puruvāramadruhaṃ kaviṃ sumnairīmahe jātavedasam
verses.en: Agni inflamed with fuel in my song I sing, pure, Cleanser, steadlast, set in tront at sacrifice. Wise Jatavedas we implore with prayers for bliss the Priest, the holy Singer, bounteous, void of guile.

verses.sa:
त्वां दूतमग्ने अमृतं युगेयुगे हव्यवाहं दधिरे पायुमीड्यम् ।
देवासश्च मर्तासश्च जागृविं विभुं विश्पतिं नमसा नि षेदिरे॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ dūtamagne amṛtaṃ yugeyuge havyavāhaṃ dadhire pāyumīḍyam devāsaśca martāsaśca jāgṛviṃ vibhuṃ viśpatiṃ namasā ni ṣedire
verses.en: Men, Agni, in each age have made thee, Deathiess One, their envoy, offering-bearer, guard adorable. With reverence Gods and mortals have established thee, the ever-watchful, omnipresent Household Lord.

verses.sa:
विभूषन्नग्न उभयाँ अनु व्रता दूतो देवानां रजसी समीयसे ।
यत् ते धीतिं सुमतिमावृणीमहे ऽध स्मा नस्त्रिवरूथः शिवो भव॥
verses.tr: vibhūṣannagna ubhayāṃ anu vratā dūto devānāṃ rajasī samīyase yat te dhītiṃ sumatimāvṛṇīmahe 'dha smā nastrivarūthaḥ śivo bhava
verses.en: Thou, Agni, ordering the works and ways of both, as envoy of the Gods traversest both the worlds. When we lay claim to thy regard and gracious fare, be thou to us a thriceprotecting friendly guard.

verses.sa:
तं सुप्रतीकं सुदृशं स्वञ्चमविद्वांसो विदुष्टरं सपेम ।
स यक्षद् विश्वा वयुनानि विद्वान् प्र हव्यमग्निरमृतेषु वोचत्॥
verses.tr: taṃ supratīkaṃ sudṛśaṃ svañcamavidvāṃso viduṣṭaraṃ sapema sa yakṣad viśvā vayunāni vidvān pra havyamagniramṛteṣu vocat
verses.en: Him fair of face, rapid, and fair to look on, him very wise may we who know not follow. Let him who knows all rules invite for worship, Agru announce our offering to the Immortals.

verses.sa:
तमग्ने पास्युत तं पिपर्षि यस्त आनट् कवये शूर धीतिम् ।
यज्ञस्य वा निशितिं वोदितिं वा तमित् पृणक्षि शवसोत राया॥
verses.tr: tamagne pāsyuta taṃ piparṣi yasta ānaṭ kavaye śūra dhītim yajñasya vā niśitiṃ voditiṃ vā tamit pṛṇakṣi śavasota rāyā
verses.en: Him, Agni, thou deliverest and savest who brings him prayer to thee the Wise, O Hero, The end of sacrifice or its inception; yea, thou endowest him with power and riches.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने वनुष्यतो नि पाहि त्वमु नः सहसावन्नवद्यात् ।
सं त्वा ध्वस्मन्वदभ्येतु पाथः सं रयिः स्पृहयाय्यः सहस्री॥
verses.tr: tvamagne vanuṣyato ni pāhi tvamu naḥ sahasāvannavadyāt saṃ tvā dhvasmanvadabhyetu pāthaḥ saṃ rayiḥ spṛhayāyyaḥ sahasrī
verses.en: Guard us from him who would assail us, Agni; preserve us, O thou Victor, from dishonour. Here let the place of darkening come upon thee: may wealth be ours, desirable in thousands.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्होता गृहपतिः स राजा विश्वा वेद जनिमा जातवेदाः ।
देवानामुत यो मर्त्यानां यजिष्ठः स प्र यजतामृतावा॥
verses.tr: agnirhotā gṛhapatiḥ sa rājā viśvā veda janimā jātavedāḥ devānāmuta yo martyānāṃ yajiṣṭhaḥ sa pra yajatāmṛtāvā
verses.en: Agni, the Priest, is King, Lord of the homestead, he, Jatayedas, knows all generations. Most skilful worshipper mid Gods and mortals, may he begin the sacrifice, the Holy.

verses.sa:
अग्ने यदद्य विशो अध्वरस्य होतः पावकशोचे वेष्ट्वं हि यज्वा ।
ऋता यजासि महिना वि यद् भूर्हव्या वह यविष्ठ या ते अद्य॥
verses.tr: agne yadadya viśo adhvarasya hotaḥ pāvakaśoce veṣṭvaṃ hi yajvā ṛtā yajāsi mahinā vi yad bhūrhavyā vaha yaviṣṭha yā te adya
verses.en: Whate'er to-day thou, bright-flamed Priest, enjoyest from the man's rite-for thou art sacrificer- Worship, for duly dost thou spread in greatness: bear off thine ofrerings of to-day, Most Youthful.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रयांसि सुधितानि हि ख्यो नि त्वा दधीत रोदसी यजध्यै ।
अवा नो मघवन् वाजसातावग्ने विश्वानि दुरिता तरेम ता तरेम तवावसा तरेम॥
verses.tr: abhi prayāṃsi sudhitāni hi khyo ni tvā dadhīta rodasī yajadhyai avā no maghavan vājasātāvagne viśvāni duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema
verses.en: Look thou upon the viands duly laid for thee. Fain would he set thee here to worship Heaven and,Earth. Help us, O liberal Agni, in the strife for spoil, so that we may o'ercome all things that trouble us, o'ercome, o'ercome them with thy help.

verses.sa:
अग्ने विश्वेभिः स्वनीक देवैरूर्णावन्तं प्रथमः सीद योनिम् ।
कुलायिनं घृतवन्तं सवित्रे यज्ञं नय यजमानाय साधु॥
verses.tr: agne viśvebhiḥ svanīka devairūrṇāvantaṃ prathamaḥ sīda yonim kulāyinaṃ ghṛtavantaṃ savitre yajñaṃ naya yajamānāya sādhu
verses.en: Together with all Gods, O fair-faced Agni, be seated first upon the woollined altar, Nest-like, bedewed with oil. Bear this our worship to Savitar who sacrifices rightly.

verses.sa: इममु त्यमथर्ववदग्निं मन्थन्ति वेधसः । यमङ्कूयन्तमानयन्नमूरं श्याव्याभ्यः॥
verses.tr: imamu tyamatharvavadagniṃ manthanti vedhasaḥ yamaṅkūyantamānayannamūraṃ śyāvyābhyaḥ
verses.en: Here the arranging priests, as did Atharvan, rub this Agni forth, Whom, not bewildered, as he moved in winding ways, they brought from gloom.

verses.sa: जनिष्वा देववीतये सर्वताता स्वस्तये । आ देवान् वक्ष्यमृताँ ऋतावृधो यज्ञं देवेषु पिस्पृशः॥
verses.tr: janiṣvā devavītaye sarvatātā svastaye ā devān vakṣyamṛtāṃ ṛtāvṛdho yajñaṃ deveṣu pispṛśaḥ
verses.en: For the Gods' banquet be thou born, for full perfection and for weal. Bring the Immortal Gods who strengthen holy Law: so let our sacrifice reach the Gods.

verses.sa:
वयमु त्वा गृहपते जनानामग्ने अकर्म समिधा बृहन्तम् ।
अस्थूरि नो गार्हपत्यानि सन्तु तिग्मेन नस्तेजसा सं शिशाधि॥
verses.tr: vayamu tvā gṛhapate janānāmagne akarma samidhā bṛhantam asthūri no gārhapatyāni santu tigmena nastejasā saṃ śiśādhi
verses.en: O Agni, Lord and Master of men's homesteads, with kindled fuel we have made thee mighty. Let not our household gear be found defective. Sharpen us with thy penetrating splendour.

verses.sa: त्वमग्ने यज्ञानां होता विश्वेषां हितः । देवेभिर्मानुषे जने॥
verses.tr: tvamagne yajñānāṃ hotā viśveṣāṃ hitaḥ devebhirmānuṣe jane
verses.en: Priest of all sacrifices hast thou been appointed by the Gods, Agni, amid the race of man.

verses.sa: स नो मन्द्राभिरध्वरे जिह्वाभिर्यजा महः । आ देवान् वक्षि यक्षि च॥
verses.tr: sa no mandrābhiradhvare jihvābhiryajā mahaḥ ā devān vakṣi yakṣi ca
verses.en: So with thy joyous tongues for us sacrifice nobly in this rite. Bring thou the Gods and worship them.

verses.sa: वेत्था हि वेधो अध्वनः पथश्च देवाञ्जसा । अग्ने यज्ञेषु सुक्रतो॥
verses.tr: vetthā hi vedho adhvanaḥ pathaśca devāñjasā agne yajñeṣu sukrato
verses.en: For well, O God, Disposer, thou knowest, straight on, the paths and ways, Agni, most wise in sacrifice.

verses.sa: त्वामीळे अध द्विता भरतो वाजिभिः शुनम् । ईजे यज्ञेषु यज्ञियम्॥
verses.tr: tvāmīḻe adha dvitā bharato vājibhiḥ śunam īje yajñeṣu yajñiyam
verses.en: Thee, too, hath Bharata of old, with mighty men, implored for bliss. And worshipped thee the worshipful.

verses.sa: त्वमिमा वार्या पुरु दिवोदासाय सुन्वते । भरद्वाजाय दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: tvamimā vāryā puru divodāsāya sunvate bharadvājāya dāśuṣe
verses.en: Thou givest these abundant boons to Divodasa pouring forth, To Bharadvaja offering gifts.

verses.sa: त्वं दूतो अमर्त्य आ वहा दैव्यं जनम् । शृण्वन् विप्रस्य सुष्टुतिम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ dūto amartya ā vahā daivyaṃ janam śṛṇvan viprasya suṣṭutim
verses.en: Do thou, Immortal Messenger, bring hither the Celestial Folk; Hearing the singer's eulogy.

verses.sa: त्वामग्ने स्वाध्यो३ मर्तासो देववीतये । यज्ञेषु देवमीळते॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne svādhyo3 martāso devavītaye yajñeṣu devamīḻate
verses.en: Mortals with pious thought implore thee, Agni, God, at holy rites, To come unto the feast of Gods.

verses.sa: तव प्र यक्षि संदृशमुत क्रतुं सुदानवः । विश्वे जुषन्त कामिनः॥
verses.tr: tava pra yakṣi saṃdṛśamuta kratuṃ sudānavaḥ viśve juṣanta kāminaḥ
verses.en: I glorify thine aspect and the might of thee the Bountilul. All those who love shall joy in thee,

verses.sa: त्वं होता मनुर्हितो वह्निरासा विदुष्टरः । अग्ने यक्षि दिवो विशः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hotā manurhito vahnirāsā viduṣṭaraḥ agne yakṣi divo viśaḥ
verses.en: Invoker placed by Manus, thou, Agni, art near, the wisest Priest: Pay worship to the Tribes of Heaven.

verses.sa: अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो हव्यदातये । नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि॥
verses.tr: agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye ni hotā satsi barhiṣi
verses.en: Come, Agni, lauded, to the feast; come to the offering of the gifts. As Priest be seated on the grass.

verses.sa: तं त्वा समिद्भिरङ्गिरो घृतेन वर्धयामसि । बृहच्छोचा यविष्ठ्य॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā samidbhiraṅgiro ghṛtena vardhayāmasi bṛhacchocā yaviṣṭhya
verses.en: So, Angiras, we make thee strong with fuel and with holy oil. Blaze high, thou youngest of the Gods.

verses.sa: स नः पृथु श्रवाय्यमच्छा देव विवाससि । बृहदग्ने सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ pṛthu śravāyyamacchā deva vivāsasi bṛhadagne suvīryam
verses.en: For us thou winnest, Agni, God, heroic strength exceeding great, Far-spreading and of high renown.

verses.sa: त्वामग्ने पुष्करादध्यथर्वा निरमन्थत । मूर्ध्नो विश्वस्य वाघतः॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne puṣkarādadhyatharvā niramanthata mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ
verses.en: Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth, by rubbing, from the lotus-flower, The head of Visva, of the Priest.

verses.sa: तमु त्वा दध्यङ्ङृषिः पुत्र ईधे अथर्वणः । वृत्रहणं पुरंदरम्॥
verses.tr: tamu tvā dadhyaṅṅṛṣiḥ putra īdhe atharvaṇaḥ vṛtrahaṇaṃ puraṃdaram
verses.en: Thee. Vrtra's slayer, breaker down of castles, hath Atharvan's son, Dadhyac the Rsi, lighted up.

verses.sa: तमु त्वा पाथ्यो वृषा समीधे दस्युहन्तमम् । धनंजयं रणेरणे॥
verses.tr: tamu tvā pāthyo vṛṣā samīdhe dasyuhantamam dhanaṃjayaṃ raṇeraṇe
verses.en: The hero Pathya kindled thee the Dasyus'. most destructive foe, Winner of spoil in every fight.

verses.sa: एह्यू षु ब्रवाणि ते ऽग्न इत्थेतरा गिरः । एभिर्वर्धास इन्दुभिः॥
verses.tr: ehyū ṣu bravāṇi te 'gna itthetarā giraḥ ebhirvardhāsa indubhiḥ
verses.en: Come, here, O Agni, will I sing verily other songs to thee, And with these drops shalt thou grow strong.

verses.sa: यत्र क्व च ते मनो दक्षं दधस उत्तरम् । तत्रा सदः कृणवसे॥
verses.tr: yatra kva ca te mano dakṣaṃ dadhasa uttaram tatrā sadaḥ kṛṇavase
verses.en: Where'er tby mind applies itself, vigour preeminent bast thou: There wilt thou gain a dwelling-place.

verses.sa: नहि ते पूर्तमक्षिपद् भुवन्नेमानां वसो । अथा दुवो वनवसे॥
verses.tr: nahi te pūrtamakṣipad bhuvannemānāṃ vaso athā duvo vanavase
verses.en: Not for a moment only lasts thy bounty, good to many a one! Our service therefore shalt thou gain.

verses.sa: आग्निरगामि भारतो वृत्रहा पुरुचेतनः । दिवोदासस्य सत्पतिः॥
verses.tr: āgniragāmi bhārato vṛtrahā purucetanaḥ divodāsasya satpatiḥ
verses.en: Agni, the Bharata, hath been sought, the Vrtra-slayer, marked of all, Yea, Divodasa's Hero Lord.

verses.sa: स हि विश्वाति पार्थिवा रयिं दाशन्महित्वना । वन्वन्नवातो अस्तृतः॥
verses.tr: sa hi viśvāti pārthivā rayiṃ dāśanmahitvanā vanvannavāto astṛtaḥ
verses.en: For he gave riches that surpass in greatness all the things of earth, Fighting untroubled, unsubdued.

verses.sa: स प्रत्नवन्नवीयसा ऽग्ने द्युम्नेन संयता । बृहत् ततन्थ भानुना॥
verses.tr: sa pratnavannavīyasā 'gne dyumnena saṃyatā bṛhat tatantha bhānunā
verses.en: Thou, Agni, as in days of old, with recent glory, gathered light, Hast overspread the lofty heaven.

verses.sa: प्र वः सखायो अग्नये स्तोमं यज्ञं च धृष्णुया । अर्च गाय च वेधसे॥
verses.tr: pra vaḥ sakhāyo agnaye stomaṃ yajñaṃ ca dhṛṣṇuyā arca gāya ca vedhase
verses.en: Bring to your Agni, O my friends, boldly your laud and sacrifice: Give the Disposer praise and song.

verses.sa: स हि यो मानुषा युगा सीदद्धोता कविक्रतुः । दूतश्च हव्यवाहनः॥
verses.tr: sa hi yo mānuṣā yugā sīdaddhotā kavikratuḥ dūtaśca havyavāhanaḥ
verses.en: For as sagacious Herald he hath sat through every age of man, Oblation-bearing messenger.

verses.sa: ता राजाना शुचिव्रता ऽऽदित्यान् मारुतं गणम् । वसो यक्षीह रोदसी॥
verses.tr: tā rājānā śucivratā ''dityān mārutaṃ gaṇam vaso yakṣīha rodasī
verses.en: Bring those Two Kings whose ways are pure, Adityas, and the Marut host, Excellent God! and Heaven and Earth.

verses.sa: वस्वी ते अग्ने संदृष्टिरिषयते मर्त्याय । ऊर्जो नपादमृतस्य॥
verses.tr: vasvī te agne saṃdṛṣṭiriṣayate martyāya ūrjo napādamṛtasya
verses.en: For strong and active mortal man, excellent, Agni, is the look Of thee Immortal, Son of Strength

verses.sa: क्रत्वा दा अस्तु श्रेष्ठो ऽद्य त्वा वन्वन् त्सुरेक्णाः । मर्त आनाश सुवृक्तिम्॥
verses.tr: kratvā dā astu śreṣṭho 'dya tvā vanvan tsurekṇāḥ marta ānāśa suvṛktim
verses.en: Rich through his wisdom, noblest be the giver serving thee to-day: The man hath brought his hymn of praise.

verses.sa: ते ते अग्ने त्वोता इषयन्तो विश्वमायुः । तरन्तो अर्यो अरातीर्वन्वन्तो अर्यो अरातीः॥
verses.tr: te te agne tvotā iṣayanto viśvamāyuḥ taranto aryo arātīrvanvanto aryo arātīḥ
verses.en: These, Agni, these are helped by thee, who strong and active all their lives, O'ercome the malice of the foe, fight down the malice of the foe.

verses.sa: अग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा यासद् विश्वं न्य१त्रिणम् । अग्निर्नो वनते रयिम्॥
verses.tr: agnistigmena śociṣā yāsad viśvaṃ nya1triṇam agnirno vanate rayim
verses.en: May Agni with his pointed blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiend May Agni win us wealth by war.

verses.sa: सुवीरं रयिमा भर जातवेदो विचर्षणे । जहि रक्षांसि सुक्रतो॥
verses.tr: suvīraṃ rayimā bhara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe jahi rakṣāṃsi sukrato
verses.en: O active Jatavedas, bring riches with store of hero sons: Slay thou the demons, O Most Wise.

verses.sa: त्वं नः पाह्यंहसो जातवेदो अघायतः । रक्षा णो ब्रह्मणस्कवे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ naḥ pāhyaṃhaso jātavedo aghāyataḥ rakṣā ṇo brahmaṇaskave
verses.en: Keep us, O Jatavedas, from the troubling of the man of sin: Guard us thou Sage who knowest prayer.

verses.sa: यो नो अग्ने दुरेव आ मर्तो वधाय दाशति । तस्मान्नः पाह्यंहसः॥
verses.tr: yo no agne dureva ā marto vadhāya dāśati tasmānnaḥ pāhyaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Whatever sinner, Agni, brings oblations to procure our death, Save us from woe that he would work.

verses.sa: त्वं तं देव जिह्वया परि बाधस्व दुष्कृतम् । मर्तो यो नो जिघांसति॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ taṃ deva jihvayā pari bādhasva duṣkṛtam marto yo no jighāṃsati
verses.en: Drive from us with thy tongue, O God, the man who doeth evil deeds, The mortal who would strike us dead.

verses.sa: भरद्वाजाय सप्रथः शर्म यच्छ सहन्त्य । अग्ने वरेण्यं वसु॥
verses.tr: bharadvājāya saprathaḥ śarma yaccha sahantya agne vareṇyaṃ vasu
verses.en: Give shelter reaching far and wide to Bharadvaja, conquering Lord! Agni, send wealth most excellent.

verses.sa: अग्निर्वृत्राणि जङ्घनद् द्रविणस्युर्विपन्यया । समिद्धः शुक्र आहुतः॥
verses.tr: agnirvṛtrāṇi jaṅghanad draviṇasyurvipanyayā samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ
verses.en: May Agni slay the Vrtras,-fain for riches, through the lord of song, Served with oblation, kindled, bright.

verses.sa: गर्भे मातुः पितुष्पिता विदिद्युतानो अक्षरे । सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा॥
verses.tr: garbhe mātuḥ pituṣpitā vididyutāno akṣare sīdannṛtasya yonimā
verses.en: His Father's Father, shining in his Mother's everlasting side, Set on the seat of holy Law.

verses.sa: ब्रह्म प्रजावदा भर जातवेदो विचर्षणे । अग्ने यद् दीदयद् दिवि॥
verses.tr: brahma prajāvadā bhara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe agne yad dīdayad divi
verses.en: O active Jatavedas, bring devotion that wins progeny, Agni, that it may shine to heaven.

verses.sa: उप त्वा रण्वसंदृशं प्रयस्वन्तः सहस्कृत । अग्ने ससृज्महे गिरः॥
verses.tr: upa tvā raṇvasaṃdṛśaṃ prayasvantaḥ sahaskṛta agne sasṛjmahe giraḥ
verses.en: O Child of Strength, to thee whose look is lovely we with dainty food, O Agni, have poured forth our songs.

verses.sa: उप च्छायामिव घृणेरगन्म शर्म ते वयम् । अग्ने हिरण्यसंदृशः॥
verses.tr: upa cchāyāmiva ghṛṇeraganma śarma te vayam agne hiraṇyasaṃdṛśaḥ
verses.en: To thee for shelter are we come, as to the shade from fervent heat Agni, who glitterest like gold.

verses.sa: य उग्र इव शर्यहा तिग्मशृङ्गो न वंसगः । अग्ने पुरो रुरोजिथ॥
verses.tr: ya ugra iva śaryahā tigmaśṛṅgo na vaṃsagaḥ agne puro rurojitha
verses.en: Mighty as one who slays with shafts, or like a bull with sharpened horn, Agni, thou breakest down the forts.

verses.sa: आ यं हस्ते न खादिनं शिशुं जातं न बिभ्रति । विशामग्निं स्वध्वरं॥
verses.tr: ā yaṃ haste na khādinaṃ śiśuṃ jātaṃ na bibhrati viśāmagniṃ svadhvaraṃ
verses.en: Whom, like an infant newly born, devourer, in their arms they bear, Men's Agni, skilled in holy rites.

verses.sa: प्र देवं देववीतये भरता वसुवित्तमम् । आ स्वे योनौ नि षीदतु॥
verses.tr: pra devaṃ devavītaye bharatā vasuvittamam ā sve yonau ni ṣīdatu
verses.en: Bear to the banquet of the Gods the God best finder-out of wealth, Let him he seated in his place.

verses.sa: आ जातं जातवेदसि प्रियं शिशीतातिथिम् । स्योन आ गृहपतिम्॥
verses.tr: ā jātaṃ jātavedasi priyaṃ śiśītātithim syona ā gṛhapatim
verses.en: In Jatavedas kindle ye the dear guest who hath now appeared In a soft place, the homestead's Lord.

verses.sa: अग्ने युक्ष्वा हि ये तवाऽश्वासो देव साधवः । अरं वहन्ति मन्यवे॥
verses.tr: agne yukṣvā hi ye tavā'śvāso deva sādhavaḥ araṃ vahanti manyave
verses.en: Harness, O Agni, O thou God, thy steeds which are most excellent: They bear thee as thy spirit wills.

verses.sa: अच्छा नो याह्या वहाऽभि प्रयांसि वीतये । आ देवान् त्सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: acchā no yāhyā vahā'bhi prayāṃsi vītaye ā devān tsomapītaye
verses.en: Come hither, bring the Gods to us to taste the sacrificial feast, To drink the draught of Soma juice.

verses.sa: उदग्ने भारत द्युमदजस्रेण दविद्युतत् । शोचा वि भाह्यजर॥
verses.tr: udagne bhārata dyumadajasreṇa davidyutat śocā vi bhāhyajara
verses.en: O Agni of the Bharatas, blaze high with everlasting might, Shine forth and gleam, Eternal One.

verses.sa:
वीती यो देवं मर्तो दुवस्येदग्निमीळीताध्वरे हविष्मान् ।
होतारं सत्ययजं रोदस्योरुत्तानहस्तो नमसा विवासेत्॥
verses.tr: vītī yo devaṃ marto duvasyedagnimīḻītādhvare haviṣmān hotāraṃ satyayajaṃ rodasyoruttānahasto namasā vivāset
verses.en: The mortal man who serves the God with banquet, and, bringing gifts at sacrifice, lauds Agni, May well attract, with prayer and hands uplifted, the Priest of Heaven and Earth, true Sacrificer.

verses.sa: आ ते अग्न ऋचा हविर्हृदा तष्टं भरामसि । ते ते भवन्तूक्षण ऋषभासो वशा उत॥
verses.tr: ā te agna ṛcā havirhṛdā taṣṭaṃ bharāmasi te te bhavantūkṣaṇa ṛṣabhāso vaśā uta
verses.en: Agni, we bring thee, with our hymn, oblation fashioned in the heart. Let these be oxen unto thee, let these be bulls and kine to thee.

verses.sa: अग्निं देवासो अग्रियमिन्धते वृत्रहन्तमम् । येना वसून्याभृता तृळ्हा रक्षांसि वाजिना॥
verses.tr: agniṃ devāso agriyamindhate vṛtrahantamam yenā vasūnyābhṛtā tṛḻhā rakṣāṃsi vājinā
verses.en: The Gods enkindle Agni, best slayer of Vrtra, first in rank, The Mighty, One who brings us wealth and crushes down the Raksasas.

verses.sa:
पिबा सोममभि यमुग्र तर्द ऊर्वं गव्यं महि गृणान इन्द्र ।
वि यो धृष्णो वधिषो वज्रहस्त विश्वा वृत्रममित्रिया शवोभिः॥
verses.tr: pibā somamabhi yamugra tarda ūrvaṃ gavyaṃ mahi gṛṇāna indra vi yo dhṛṣṇo vadhiṣo vajrahasta viśvā vṛtramamitriyā śavobhiḥ
verses.en: Drink Soma, Mighty One, for which, when lauded, thou breakest through the cattle-stall, O Indra; Thou who, O Bold One, armed with thunder smotest Vrtra with might, and every hostile being.

verses.sa:
स ईं पाहि य ऋजीषी तरुत्रो यः शिप्रवान् वृषभो यो मतीनाम् ।
यो गोत्रभिद् वज्रभृद् यो हरिष्ठाः स इन्द्र चित्राँ अभि तृन्धि वाजान्॥
verses.tr: sa īṃ pāhi ya ṛjīṣī tarutro yaḥ śipravān vṛṣabho yo matīnām yo gotrabhid vajrabhṛd yo hariṣṭhāḥ sa indra citrāṃ abhi tṛndhi vājān
verses.en: Drink it thou God who art impetuous victor, Lord of our hymns, with beauteousjaws, the Hero, Render of kine-stalls, car-borne, thunder-wielding, so pierce thy way to wondrous strength, O Indra.

verses.sa:
एवा पाहि प्रत्नथा मन्दतु त्वा श्रुधि ब्रह्म वावृधस्वोत गीर्भिः ।
आविः सूर्यं कृणुहि पीपिहीषो जहि शत्रूँरभि गा इन्द्र तृन्धि॥
verses.tr: evā pāhi pratnathā mandatu tvā śrudhi brahma vāvṛdhasvota gīrbhiḥ āviḥ sūryaṃ kṛṇuhi pīpihīṣo jahi śatrūṃrabhi gā indra tṛndhi
verses.en: Drink as of old, and let the draught delight thee. hear thou our prayer and let our songs exalt thee. Make the Sun visible, make food abundant, slaughter the foes, pierce through and free the cattle.

verses.sa:
ते त्वा मदा बृहदिन्द्र स्वधाव इमे पीता उक्षयन्त द्युमन्तम् ।
महामनूनं तवसं विभूतिं मत्सरासो जर्हृषन्त प्रसाहम्॥
verses.tr: te tvā madā bṛhadindra svadhāva ime pītā ukṣayanta dyumantam mahāmanūnaṃ tavasaṃ vibhūtiṃ matsarāso jarhṛṣanta prasāham
verses.en: These gladdening drops, O Indra, Self-sustainer, quaffed shall augment thee in thy mighty splendour. Yea, let the cheering drops delight thee greatly, great, perfect, strong, powerful, all-subduing.

verses.sa:
येभिः सूर्यमुषसं मन्दसानो ऽवासयोऽप दृळ्हानि दर्द्रत् ।
महामद्रिं परि गा इन्द्र सन्तं नुत्था अच्युतं सदसस्परि स्वात्॥
verses.tr: yebhiḥ sūryamuṣasaṃ mandasāno 'vāsayo'pa dṛḻhāni dardrat mahāmadriṃ pari gā indra santaṃ nutthā acyutaṃ sadasaspari svāt
verses.en: Gladdened whereby, bursting the firm enclosures, thou gavest splendour to the Sun and Morning. The mighty rock that compassed in the cattle, ne'er moved, thou shookest from its seat, O Indra.

verses.sa:
तव क्रत्वा तव तद् दंसनाभिरामासु पक्वं शच्या नि दीधः ।
और्णोर्दुर उस्रियाभ्यो वि दृळ्होदूर्वाद् गा असृजो अङ्गिरस्वान्॥
verses.tr: tava kratvā tava tad daṃsanābhirāmāsu pakvaṃ śacyā ni dīdhaḥ aurṇordura usriyābhyo vi dṛḻhodūrvād gā asṛjo aṅgirasvān
verses.en: Thou with thy wisdom, power, and works of wonder, hast stored the ripe milk in the raw cows' udders Unbarred the firm doors for the kine of Morning, and, with the Angirases, set free the cattle.

verses.sa:
पप्राथ क्षां महि दंसो व्यु१र्वीमुप द्यामृष्वो बृहदिन्द्र स्तभायः ।
अधारयो रोदसी देवपुत्रे प्रत्ने मातरा यह्वी ऋतस्य॥
verses.tr: paprātha kṣāṃ mahi daṃso vyu1rvīmupa dyāmṛṣvo bṛhadindra stabhāyaḥ adhārayo rodasī devaputre pratne mātarā yahvī ṛtasya
verses.en: Thou hast spread out wide earth, a mighty marvel, and, high thyself, propped lofty heaven, O Indra. Both worlds, whose Sons are Gods, thou hast supported, young, Mothers from old time ofholy Order.

verses.sa:
अध त्वा विश्वे पुर इन्द्र देवा एकं तवसं दधिरे भराय ।
अदेवो यदभ्यौहिष्ट देवान् त्स्वर्षाता वृणत इन्द्रमत्र॥
verses.tr: adha tvā viśve pura indra devā ekaṃ tavasaṃ dadhire bharāya adevo yadabhyauhiṣṭa devān tsvarṣātā vṛṇata indramatra
verses.en: Yea, Indra, all the Deities installed thee their one strong Champion in the van for battle. What time the godless was the Gods' assailant, Indra they chose to win the light of heaven.

verses.sa:
अध द्यौश्चित् ते अप सा नु वज्राद् द्वितानमद् भियसा स्वस्य मन्योः ।
अहिं यदिन्द्रो अभ्योहसानं नि चिद् विश्वायुः शयथे जघान॥
verses.tr: adha dyauścit te apa sā nu vajrād dvitānamad bhiyasā svasya manyoḥ ahiṃ yadindro abhyohasānaṃ ni cid viśvāyuḥ śayathe jaghāna
verses.en: Yea, e'en that heaven itself of old bent backward before thy bolt, in terror of its anger, When Indra, life of every living creature, smote down within his lair the assailing Dragon.

verses.sa:
अध त्वष्टा ते मह उग्र वज्रं सहस्रभृष्टिं ववृतच्छताश्रिम् ।
निकाममरमणसं येन नवन्तमहिं सं पिणगृजीषिन्॥
verses.tr: adha tvaṣṭā te maha ugra vajraṃ sahasrabhṛṣṭiṃ vavṛtacchatāśrim nikāmamaramaṇasaṃ yena navantamahiṃ saṃ piṇagṛjīṣin
verses.en: Yea, Strong One! Tvastar turned for thee, the Mighty, the bolt with thousand spikes and hundred edges, Eager and prompt at will, wherewith thou crushedst the boasting Dragon, O impetuous Hero.

verses.sa:
वर्धान् यं विश्वे मरुतः सजोषाः पचच्छतं महिषाँ इन्द्र तुभ्यम् ।
पूषा विष्णुस्त्रीणि सरांसि धावन् वृत्रहणं मदिरमंशुमस्मै॥
verses.tr: vardhān yaṃ viśve marutaḥ sajoṣāḥ pacacchataṃ mahiṣāṃ indra tubhyam pūṣā viṣṇustrīṇi sarāṃsi dhāvan vṛtrahaṇaṃ madiramaṃśumasmai
verses.en: He dressed a hundred buffaloes, O Indra, for thee whom all accordant Maruts strengthen. He, Pusan Visnu, poured forth three great vessels to him, the juice that cheers, that slaughters Vrtra.

verses.sa:
आ क्षोदो महि वृतं नदीनां परिष्ठितमसृज ऊर्मिमपाम् ।
तासामनु प्रवत इन्द्र पन्थां प्रार्दयो नीचीरपसः समुद्रम्॥
verses.tr: ā kṣodo mahi vṛtaṃ nadīnāṃ pariṣṭhitamasṛja ūrmimapām tāsāmanu pravata indra panthāṃ prārdayo nīcīrapasaḥ samudram
verses.en: Thou settest free the rushing wave of waters, the floods' great swell encompassed and obstructed. Along steep slopes their course thou tumedst, Indra, directed downward, speeding to the ocean.

verses.sa:
एवा ता विश्वा चकृवांसमिन्द्रं महामुग्रमजुर्यं सहोदाम् ।
सुवीरं त्वा स्वायुधं सुवज्रमा ब्रह्म नव्यमवसे ववृत्यात्॥
verses.tr: evā tā viśvā cakṛvāṃsamindraṃ mahāmugramajuryaṃ sahodām suvīraṃ tvā svāyudhaṃ suvajramā brahma navyamavase vavṛtyāt
verses.en: So may our new prayer bring thee to protect us, thee well-armed Hero with thy bolt of thunder, Indra, who made these worlds, the Strong, the ty, who never groweth old, the victory-giver.

verses.sa:
स नो वाजाय श्रवस इषे च राये धेहि द्युमत इन्द्र विप्रान् ।
भरद्वाजे नृवत इन्द्र सूरीन् दिवि च स्मैधि पार्ये न इन्द्र॥
verses.tr: sa no vājāya śravasa iṣe ca rāye dhehi dyumata indra viprān bharadvāje nṛvata indra sūrīn divi ca smaidhi pārye na indra
verses.en: So, Indra, form us brilliant holy singers for strength, for glory, and for food and riches. Give Bharadvaja hero patrons, Indra Indra, be ours upon the day of trial.

verses.sa: अया वाजं देवहितं सनेम मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: ayā vājaṃ devahitaṃ sanema madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ
verses.en: With this may we obtain strength God-appointed, and brave sons gladden us through a hundred winters.

verses.sa:
तमु ष्टुहि यो अभिभूत्योजा वन्वन्नवातः पुरुहूत इन्द्रः ।
अषाळ्हमुग्रं सहमानमाभिर्गीर्भिर्वर्ध वृषभं चर्षणीनाम्॥
verses.tr: tamu ṣṭuhi yo abhibhūtyojā vanvannavātaḥ puruhūta indraḥ aṣāḻhamugraṃ sahamānamābhirgīrbhirvardha vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām
verses.en: Glorify him whose might is all-surpassing, Indra the much-invoked who fights uninjured. Magnify with these songs the never-vanquished, the Strong, the Bull of men, the Mighty Victor.

verses.sa:
स युध्मः सत्वा खजकृत् समद्वा तुविम्रक्षो नदनुमाँ ऋजीषी ।
बृहद्रेणुश्च्यवनो मानुषीणामेकः कृष्टीनामभवत् सहावा॥
verses.tr: sa yudhmaḥ satvā khajakṛt samadvā tuvimrakṣo nadanumāṃ ṛjīṣī bṛhadreṇuścyavano mānuṣīṇāmekaḥ kṛṣṭīnāmabhavat sahāvā
verses.en: He, Champion, Hero, Warrior, Lord of battles, impetuous, loudly roaring, great destroyer, Who whirls the dust on high, alone, oerthrower, hath made all races of mankind his subjects.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह नु त्यददमायो दस्यूँरेकः कृष्टीरवनोरार्याय ।
अस्ति स्विन्नु वीर्यं१ तत् त इन्द्र न स्विदस्ति तदृतुथा वि वोचः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ ha nu tyadadamāyo dasyūṃrekaḥ kṛṣṭīravanorāryāya asti svinnu vīryaṃ1 tat ta indra na svidasti tadṛtuthā vi vocaḥ
verses.en: Thou, thou alone, hast tamed the Dasyus; singly thou hast subdued the people for the Arya. In this, or is it not, thine hero exploit, Indra? Declare it at the proper season.

verses.sa:
सदिद्धि ते तुविजातस्य मन्ये सहः सहिष्ठ तुरतस्तुरस्य ।
उग्रमुग्रस्य तवसस्तवीयो ऽरध्रस्य रध्रतुरो बभूव॥
verses.tr: sadiddhi te tuvijātasya manye sahaḥ sahiṣṭha turatasturasya ugramugrasya tavasastavīyo 'radhrasya radhraturo babhūva
verses.en: For true, I deem, thy strength is, thine the Mighty, thine, O Most Potent, thine the Conquering Victor; Strong, of the strong, Most Mighty, of the mighty, thine, driver of the churl to acts of bounty.

verses.sa:
तन्नः प्रत्नं सख्यमस्तु युष्मे इत्था वदद्भिर्वलमङ्गिरोभिः ।
हन्नच्युतच्युद् दस्मेषयन्तमृणोः पुरो वि दुरो अस्य विश्वाः॥
verses.tr: tannaḥ pratnaṃ sakhyamastu yuṣme itthā vadadbhirvalamaṅgirobhiḥ hannacyutacyud dasmeṣayantamṛṇoḥ puro vi duro asya viśvāḥ
verses.en: Be this our ancient bond of friendship with you and with Angirases here who speak of Vala. Thou, Wondrous, Shaker of things firm, didst smite him in his fresh strength, and force his doors and castles.

verses.sa:
स हि धीभिर्हव्यो अस्त्युग्र ईशानकृन्महति वृत्रतूर्ये ।
स तोकसाता तनये स वज्री वितन्तसाय्यो अभवत् समत्सु॥
verses.tr: sa hi dhībhirhavyo astyugra īśānakṛnmahati vṛtratūrye sa tokasātā tanaye sa vajrī vitantasāyyo abhavat samatsu
verses.en: With holy thoughts must he be called, the Mighty, showing his power in the great fight with Vrtra. He must be called to give us seed and offspring, the Thunderer must he moved and sped to battle.

verses.sa:
स मज्मना जनिम मानुषाणाममर्त्येन नाम्नाति प्र सर्स्रे ।
स द्युम्नेन स शवसोत राया स वीर्येण नृतमः समोकाः॥
verses.tr: sa majmanā janima mānuṣāṇāmamartyena nāmnāti pra sarsre sa dyumnena sa śavasota rāyā sa vīryeṇa nṛtamaḥ samokāḥ
verses.en: He in his might, with name that lives for ever, hath far surpassed all human generations. He, most heroic, hath his home with splendour, with glory and with riches and with valour.

verses.sa:
स यो न मुहे न मिथू जनो भूत् सुमन्तुनामा चुमुरिं धुनिं च ।
वृणक् पिप्रुं शम्बरं शुष्णमिन्द्रः पुरां च्यौत्नाय शयथाय नू चित्॥
verses.tr: sa yo na muhe na mithū jano bhūt sumantunāmā cumuriṃ dhuniṃ ca vṛṇak pipruṃ śambaraṃ śuṣṇamindraḥ purāṃ cyautnāya śayathāya nū cit
verses.en: Stranger to guile, who ne'er was false or faithless, bearing a name that may be well remembered, Indra crushed Cumuri, Dhuni, Sambara, Pipru, and Susna, that their castles fell in ruin.

verses.sa:
उदावता त्वक्षसा पन्यसा च वृत्रहत्याय रथमिन्द्र तिष्ठ ।
धिष्व वज्रं हस्त आ दक्षिणत्रा ऽभि प्र मन्द पुरुदत्र मायाः॥
verses.tr: udāvatā tvakṣasā panyasā ca vṛtrahatyāya rathamindra tiṣṭha dhiṣva vajraṃ hasta ā dakṣiṇatrā 'bhi pra manda purudatra māyāḥ
verses.en: With saving might that must be praised and lauded, Indra, ascend thy car to smite down Vrtra. In thy right hand hold fast thy bolt of thunder, and weaken, Bounteous Lord, his art and magic.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्न शुष्कं वनमिन्द्र हेती रक्षो नि धक्ष्यशनिर्न भीमा ।
गम्भीरय ऋष्वया यो रुरोजाध्वानयद् दुरिता दम्भयच्च॥
verses.tr: agnirna śuṣkaṃ vanamindra hetī rakṣo ni dhakṣyaśanirna bhīmā gambhīraya ṛṣvayā yo rurojādhvānayad duritā dambhayacca
verses.en: As Agni, as the dart burns the dry forest, like the dread shaft burn down the fiends, O Indra; Thou who with high deep-reaching spear hast broken, hast covered over mischief and destroyed it.

verses.sa:
आ सहस्रं पथिभिरिन्द्र राया तुविद्युम्न तुविवाजेभिरर्वाक् ।
याहि सूनो सहसो यस्य नू चिददेव ईशे पुरुहूत योतोः॥
verses.tr: ā sahasraṃ pathibhirindra rāyā tuvidyumna tuvivājebhirarvāk yāhi sūno sahaso yasya nū cidadeva īśe puruhūta yotoḥ
verses.en: With wealth, by thousand paths come hither, Agni, paths that bring ample strength, O thou Most Splendid. Come, Son of Strength, o'er whom, Invoked of many! the godless hath no power to keep thee distant.

verses.sa:
प्र तुविद्युम्नस्य स्थविरस्य घृष्वेर्दिवो ररप्शे महिमा पृथिव्याः ।
नास्य शत्रुर्न प्रतिमानमस्ति न प्रतिष्ठिः पुरुमायस्य सह्योः॥
verses.tr: pra tuvidyumnasya sthavirasya ghṛṣverdivo rarapśe mahimā pṛthivyāḥ nāsya śatrurna pratimānamasti na pratiṣṭhiḥ purumāyasya sahyoḥ
verses.en: From heaven, from earth is bruited forth the greatness of him the firm, the fiery, the resplendent. No foe hath he, no counterpart, no refuge is there from him the Conqueror full of wisdom

verses.sa:
प्र तत् ते अद्या करणं कृतं भूत् कुत्सं यदायुमतिथिग्वमस्मै ।
पुरू सहस्रा नि शिशा अभि क्षामुत् तूर्वयाणं धृषता निनेथ॥
verses.tr: pra tat te adyā karaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ bhūt kutsaṃ yadāyumatithigvamasmai purū sahasrā ni śiśā abhi kṣāmut tūrvayāṇaṃ dhṛṣatā ninetha
