verses.tr: tyamu vo aprahaṇaṃ gṛṇīṣe śavasaspatim indraṃ viśvāsāhaṃ naraṃ maṃhiṣṭhaṃ viśvacarṣaṇim
verses.en: Him for your sake I glorify as Lord of Strength who wrongeth none, The Hero Indra, conquering all, Most Bounteous, God of all the tribes.

verses.sa: यं वर्धयन्तीद्गिरः पतिं तुरस्य राधसः । तमिन्न्वस्य रोदसी देवी शुष्मं सपर्यतः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ vardhayantīdgiraḥ patiṃ turasya rādhasaḥ taminnvasya rodasī devī śuṣmaṃ saparyataḥ
verses.en: Those Goddesses, both Heaven and Earth, revere the power and might of him, Him whom our songs increase in strength, the Lord of bounty swift to come.

verses.sa: तद्व उक्थस्य बर्हणेन्द्रायोपस्तृणीषणि । विपो न यस्योतयो वि यद्रोहन्ति सक्षितः॥
verses.tr: tadva ukthasya barhaṇendrāyopastṛṇīṣaṇi vipo na yasyotayo vi yadrohanti sakṣitaḥ
verses.en: To seat your Indra, I will spread abroad with power this song of praise. The saving succours that abide in him, like songs, extend and grow.

verses.sa:
अविदद्दक्षं मित्रो नवीयान्पपानो देवेभ्यो वस्यो अचैत् ।
ससवान्त्स्तौलाभिर्धौतरीभिरुरुष्या पायुरभवत्सखिभ्यः॥
verses.tr: avidaddakṣaṃ mitro navīyānpapāno devebhyo vasyo acait sasavāntstaulābhirdhautarībhiruruṣyā pāyurabhavatsakhibhyaḥ
verses.en: A recent Friend, he found the skilful priest: he drank, and showed forth treasure from the Gods. He conquered, borne by strong all-shaking mares, and was with far-spread power his friends' Protector.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य पथि वेधा अपायि श्रिये मनांसि देवासो अक्रन् ।
दधानो नाम महो वचोभिर्वपुर्दृशये वेन्यो व्यावः॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya pathi vedhā apāyi śriye manāṃsi devāso akran dadhāno nāma maho vacobhirvapurdṛśaye venyo vyāvaḥ
verses.en: In course of Law the sapient juice was quaffed: the Deities to glory turned their mind. Winning through hymns a lofty title, he, the Lovely, made his beauteous form apparent.

verses.sa:
द्युमत्तमं दक्षं धेह्यस्मे सेधा जनानां पूर्वीररातीः ।
वर्षीयो वयः कृणुहि शचीभिर्धनस्य सातावस्माँ अविड्ढि॥
verses.tr: dyumattamaṃ dakṣaṃ dhehyasme sedhā janānāṃ pūrvīrarātīḥ varṣīyo vayaḥ kṛṇuhi śacībhirdhanasya sātāvasmāṃ aviḍḍhi
verses.en: Bestow on us the most illustrious strength ward off men's manifold malignities. Give with thy might abundant vital force, and aid us graciously in gaining riches.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र तुभ्यमिन्मघवन्नभूम वयं दात्रे हरिवो मा वि वेनः ।
नकिरापिर्ददृशे मर्त्यत्रा किमङ्ग रध्रचोदनं त्वाहुः॥
verses.tr: indra tubhyaminmaghavannabhūma vayaṃ dātre harivo mā vi venaḥ nakirāpirdadṛśe martyatrā kimaṅga radhracodanaṃ tvāhuḥ
verses.en: We turn to thee as Giver, liberal Indra. Lord of the Bay Steeds, be not thou ungracious. No friend among mankind have we to lookto: why have men called thee him who spurs the niggard?

verses.sa:
मा जस्वने वृषभ नो ररीथा मा ते रेवतः सख्ये रिषाम ।
पूर्वीष्ट इन्द्र निष्षिधो जनेषु जह्यसुष्वीन्प्र वृहापृणतः॥
verses.tr: mā jasvane vṛṣabha no rarīthā mā te revataḥ sakhye riṣāma pūrvīṣṭa indra niṣṣidho janeṣu jahyasuṣvīnpra vṛhāpṛṇataḥ
verses.en: Give us not up, Strong Hero! to the hungry: unharmed be we whom thou, so rich, befriendest. Full many a boon hast thou for men demolish those who present no gifts nor pour oblations.

verses.sa:
उदभ्राणीव स्तनयन्नियर्तीन्द्रो राधांस्यश्व्यानि गव्या ।
त्वमसि प्रदिवः कारुधाया मा त्वादामान आ दभन्मघोनः॥
verses.tr: udabhrāṇīva stanayanniyartīndro rādhāṃsyaśvyāni gavyā tvamasi pradivaḥ kārudhāyā mā tvādāmāna ā dabhanmaghonaḥ
verses.en: As Indra thundering impels the rain-clouds, so doth he send us store of kine and horses. Thou art of old the Cherisher of singers let not the rich who bring no gifts deceive thee.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यो वीर प्र महे सुतानामिन्द्राय भर स ह्यस्य राजा ।
यः पूर्व्याभिरुत नूतनाभिर्गीर्भिर्वावृधे गृणतामृषीणाम्॥
verses.tr: adhvaryo vīra pra mahe sutānāmindrāya bhara sa hyasya rājā yaḥ pūrvyābhiruta nūtanābhirgīrbhirvāvṛdhe gṛṇatāmṛṣīṇām
verses.en: Adbyaryu, hero, bring to mighty Indrafor he is King thereof-the pressed-out juices; To him exalted by the hymns and praises, ancient and modern, of the singing Rsis.

verses.sa:
अस्य मदे पुरु वर्पांसि विद्वानिन्द्रो वृत्राण्यप्रती जघान ।
तमु प्र होषि मधुमन्तमस्मै सोमं वीराय शिप्रिणे पिबध्यै॥
verses.tr: asya made puru varpāṃsi vidvānindro vṛtrāṇyapratī jaghāna tamu pra hoṣi madhumantamasmai somaṃ vīrāya śipriṇe pibadhyai
verses.en: In the wild joy of this hath Indra, knowing full many a form, struck down resistless Vrtras. Proclaim aloud to him the savoury Soma so that the Hero, strong of jaw, may drink it.

verses.sa:
पाता सुतमिन्द्रो अस्तु सोमं हन्ता वृत्रं वज्रेण मन्दसानः ।
गन्ता यज्ञं परावतश्चिदच्छा वसुर्धीनामविता कारुधायाः॥
verses.tr: pātā sutamindro astu somaṃ hantā vṛtraṃ vajreṇa mandasānaḥ gantā yajñaṃ parāvataścidacchā vasurdhīnāmavitā kārudhāyāḥ
verses.en: May Indra drink this Soma poured to please him, and cheered therewith slay Vrtra with his thunder. Come to our sacrifice even from a distance, good lover of our songs, the bard's Supporter.

verses.sa:
इदं त्यत्पात्रमिन्द्रपानमिन्द्रस्य प्रियममृतमपायि ।
मत्सद्यथा सौमनसाय देवं व्य१स्मद्द्वेषो युयवद्व्यंहः॥
verses.tr: idaṃ tyatpātramindrapānamindrasya priyamamṛtamapāyi matsadyathā saumanasāya devaṃ vya1smaddveṣo yuyavadvyaṃhaḥ
verses.en: The cup whence Indra drinks the draught is present: the Amrta dear to Indra hath been drunken, That it may cheer the God to gracious favour, and keep far from us hatred and affliction.

verses.sa:
एना मन्दानो जहि शूर शत्रूञ्जामिमजामिं मघवन्नमित्रान् ।
अभिषेणाँ अभ्या३देदिशानान्पराच इन्द्र प्र मृणा जही च॥
verses.tr: enā mandāno jahi śūra śatrūñjāmimajāmiṃ maghavannamitrān abhiṣeṇāṃ abhyā3dediśānānparāca indra pra mṛṇā jahī ca
verses.en: Therewith enraptured, Hero, slay our foemen, the unfriendly, Maghavan be they kin or strangers, Those who still aim their hostile darts to smite us, turn them to flight, O Indra, crush and kill them.

verses.sa:
आसु ष्मा णो मघवन्निन्द्र पृत्स्व१स्मभ्यं महि वरिवः सुगं कः ।
अपां तोकस्य तनयस्य जेष इन्द्र सूरीन्कृणुहि स्मा नो अर्धम्॥
verses.tr: āsu ṣmā ṇo maghavannindra pṛtsva1smabhyaṃ mahi varivaḥ sugaṃ kaḥ apāṃ tokasya tanayasya jeṣa indra sūrīnkṛṇuhi smā no ardham
verses.en: O Indra Maghavan, in these our battles win easy paths for us and ample freedom. That we may gain waters and seed and offspring, set thou our princes on thy side, O Indra.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा हरयो वृषणो युजाना वृषरथासो वृषरश्मयोऽत्याः ।
अस्मत्राञ्चो वृषणो वज्रवाहो वृष्णे मदाय सुयुजो वहन्तु॥
verses.tr: ā tvā harayo vṛṣaṇo yujānā vṛṣarathāso vṛṣaraśmayo'tyāḥ asmatrāñco vṛṣaṇo vajravāho vṛṣṇe madāya suyujo vahantu
verses.en: Let thy Bay Stallions, harnessed, bring thee hither, Steeds with strong chariot and strong reins to hold them, Strong Horses, speeding hither, bearing thunder, well-harnessed, for the strong exciting potion.

verses.sa:
आ ते वृषन्वृषणो द्रोणमस्थुर्घृतप्रुषो नोर्मयो मदन्तः ।
इन्द्र प्र तुभ्यं वृषभिः सुतानां वृष्णे भरन्ति वृषभाय सोमम्॥
verses.tr: ā te vṛṣanvṛṣaṇo droṇamasthurghṛtapruṣo normayo madantaḥ indra pra tubhyaṃ vṛṣabhiḥ sutānāṃ vṛṣṇe bharanti vṛṣabhāya somam
verses.en: Beside the vat, Strong God! stand thy strong Horses, shining with holy oil, like waves exulting. Indra, they bring to thee, the Strong and Mighty, Soma of juices shed by mighty press-stones.

verses.sa:
वृषासि दिवो वृषभः पृथिव्या वृषा सिन्धूनां वृषभः स्तियानाम् ।
वृष्णे त इन्दुर्वृषभ पीपाय स्वादू रसो मधुपेयो वराय॥
verses.tr: vṛṣāsi divo vṛṣabhaḥ pṛthivyā vṛṣā sindhūnāṃ vṛṣabhaḥ stiyānām vṛṣṇe ta indurvṛṣabha pīpāya svādū raso madhupeyo varāya
verses.en: Thou art the Bull of earth, the Bull of heaven, Bull of the rivers, Bull of standing waters. For thee, the Strong, O Bull, hath Indu swollen. juice pleasant, sweet to drink, for thine election.

verses.sa:
अयं देवः सहसा जायमान इन्द्रेण युजा पणिमस्तभायत् ।
अयं स्वस्य पितुरायुधानीन्दुरमुष्णादशिवस्य मायाः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ devaḥ sahasā jāyamāna indreṇa yujā paṇimastabhāyat ayaṃ svasya piturāyudhānīnduramuṣṇādaśivasya māyāḥ
verses.en: This God, with might, when first he had his being, with Indra for ally, held fast the Pani. This Indu stole away the warlike weapons, and foiled the arts of his malignant father.

verses.sa:
अयमकृणोदुषसः सुपत्नीरयं सूर्ये अदधाज्ज्योतिरन्तः ।
अयं त्रिधातु दिवि रोचनेष त्रितेषु विन्ददमृतं निगूळ्हम्॥
verses.tr: ayamakṛṇoduṣasaḥ supatnīrayaṃ sūrye adadhājjyotirantaḥ ayaṃ tridhātu divi rocaneṣa triteṣu vindadamṛtaṃ nigūḻham
verses.en: The Dawns he wedded to a glorious Consort, and set within the Sun the light that lights him. He found in heaven, in the third lucid regions, the threefold Amrta in its close concealment.

verses.sa:
अयं द्यावापृथिवी वि ष्कभायदयं रथमयुनक्सप्तरश्मिम् ।
अयं गोषु शच्या पक्वमन्तः सोमो दाधार दशयन्त्रमुत्सम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī vi ṣkabhāyadayaṃ rathamayunaksaptaraśmim ayaṃ goṣu śacyā pakvamantaḥ somo dādhāra daśayantramutsam
verses.en: He stayed and held the heaven and earth asunder: the chariot with the sevenfold reins he harnessed. This Soma Set with power within the milch-kine a spring whose ripe contents ten fingers empty.

verses.sa: य आनयत्परावतः सुनीती तुर्वशं यदुम् । इन्द्रः स नो युवा सखा॥
verses.tr: ya ānayatparāvataḥ sunītī turvaśaṃ yadum indraḥ sa no yuvā sakhā
verses.en: That Indra is our youthful Friend, who with his trusty guidance led Turvasa, Yadu from afar.

verses.sa: अविप्रे चिद्वयो दधदनाशुना चिदर्वता । इन्द्रो जेता हितं धनम्॥
verses.tr: avipre cidvayo dadhadanāśunā cidarvatā indro jetā hitaṃ dhanam
verses.en: Even to the dull and uninspired Indra, gives vital power, and wins Even with slow steed the offered prize.

verses.sa: महीरस्य प्रणीतयः पूर्वीरुत प्रशस्तयः । नास्य क्षीयन्त ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: mahīrasya praṇītayaḥ pūrvīruta praśastayaḥ nāsya kṣīyanta ūtayaḥ
verses.en: Great are his ways of guiding us, and! manifold are his eulogies: His kind protections never fail.

verses.sa: सखायो ब्रह्मवाहसेऽर्चत प्र च गायत । स हि नः प्रमतिर्मही॥
verses.tr: sakhāyo brahmavāhase'rcata pra ca gāyata sa hi naḥ pramatirmahī
verses.en: Friends, sing your psalm and offer praise to him to whom the prayer is brought: For our great Providence is he.

verses.sa: त्वमेकस्य वृत्रहन्नविता द्वयोरसि । उतेदृशे यथा वयम्॥
verses.tr: tvamekasya vṛtrahannavitā dvayorasi utedṛśe yathā vayam
verses.en: Thou, Slaughterer of Vrtra, art Guardian and Friend of one and two, Yea, of a man like one of us.

verses.sa: नयसीद्वति द्विषः कृणोष्युक्थशंसिनः । नृभिः सुवीर उच्यसे॥
verses.tr: nayasīdvati dviṣaḥ kṛṇoṣyukthaśaṃsinaḥ nṛbhiḥ suvīra ucyase
verses.en: Beyond men's hate thou leadest us, and givest cause to sing thy praise: Good hero art thou called by men.

verses.sa: ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मवाहसं गीर्भिः सखायमृग्मियम् । गां न दोहसे हुवे॥
verses.tr: brahmāṇaṃ brahmavāhasaṃ gīrbhiḥ sakhāyamṛgmiyam gāṃ na dohase huve
verses.en: I call with hymns, as 'twere a cow to milk, the Friend who merits praise, The Brahman who accepts the prayer.

verses.sa: यस्य विश्वानि हस्तयोरूचुर्वसूनि नि द्विता । वीरस्य पृतनाषहः॥
verses.tr: yasya viśvāni hastayorūcurvasūni ni dvitā vīrasya pṛtanāṣahaḥ
verses.en: Him in whose hands they say are stored all treasures from the days of old, The Hero, conquering in the fight.

verses.sa: वि दृळ्हानि चिदद्रिवो जनानां शचीपते । वृह माया अनानत॥
verses.tr: vi dṛḻhāni cidadrivo janānāṃ śacīpate vṛha māyā anānata
verses.en: Lord of Strength, Caster of the Stone, destroy the firm forts built by men, And foil their arts, unbending God!

verses.sa: तमु त्वा सत्य सोमपा इन्द्र वाजानां पते । अहूमहि श्रवस्यवः॥
verses.tr: tamu tvā satya somapā indra vājānāṃ pate ahūmahi śravasyavaḥ
verses.en: Thee, thee as such, O Lord of Power, O Indra, Soma-drinker, true, We, fain for glory, have invoked.

verses.sa: तमु त्वा यः पुरासिथ यो वा नूनं हिते धने । हव्यः स श्रुधी हवम्॥
verses.tr: tamu tvā yaḥ purāsitha yo vā nūnaṃ hite dhane havyaḥ sa śrudhī havam
verses.en: Such as thou wast of old, and art now to be called on when the prize lies ready, listen to our call.

verses.sa: धीभिरर्वद्भिरर्वतो वाजाँ इन्द्र श्रवाय्यान् । त्वया जेष्म हितं धनम्॥
verses.tr: dhībhirarvadbhirarvato vājāṃ indra śravāyyān tvayā jeṣma hitaṃ dhanam
verses.en: With hymns and coursers we will gain, Indra, through thee, both steeds and spoil Most glorious, and the proffered prize.

verses.sa: अभूरु वीर गिर्वणो महाँ इन्द्र धने हिते । भरे वितन्तसाय्यः॥
verses.tr: abhūru vīra girvaṇo mahāṃ indra dhane hite bhare vitantasāyyaḥ
verses.en: Thou, Indra, Lover of the Song, whom men must stir to help, hast been Great in the contest for the prize.

verses.sa: या त ऊतिरमित्रहन्मक्षूजवस्तमासति । तया नो हिनुही रथम्॥
verses.tr: yā ta ūtiramitrahanmakṣūjavastamāsati tayā no hinuhī ratham
verses.en: Slayer of foes, whatever aid of thine imparts the swiftest course, With that impel our car to speed.

verses.sa: स रथेन रथीतमोऽस्माकेनाभियुग्वना । जेषि जिष्णो हितं धनम्॥
verses.tr: sa rathena rathītamo'smākenābhiyugvanā jeṣi jiṣṇo hitaṃ dhanam
verses.en: As skilfullest of those who drive the chariot, with our art and aim, O Conqueror, win the proffered prize.

verses.sa: य एक इत्तमु ष्टुहि कृष्टीनां विचर्षणिः । पतिर्जज्ञे वृषक्रतुः॥
verses.tr: ya eka ittamu ṣṭuhi kṛṣṭīnāṃ vicarṣaṇiḥ patirjajñe vṛṣakratuḥ
verses.en: Praise him who, Matchless and Alone, was born the Lord of living men, Most active, with heroic soul.

verses.sa: यो गृणतामिदासिथाऽऽपिरूती शिवः सखा । स त्वं न इन्द्र मृळय॥
verses.tr: yo gṛṇatāmidāsithā''pirūtī śivaḥ sakhā sa tvaṃ na indra mṛḻaya
verses.en: Thou who hast been the singers' Friend, a Friend auspicious with thine aid, As such, O Indra, favour us.

verses.sa: धिष्व वज्रं गभस्त्यो रक्षोहत्याय वज्रिवः । सासहीष्ठा अभि स्पृधः॥
verses.tr: dhiṣva vajraṃ gabhastyo rakṣohatyāya vajrivaḥ sāsahīṣṭhā abhi spṛdhaḥ
verses.en: Grasp in thine arms the thunderbolt, O Thunder-armed, to slay the fiends: Mayst thou subdue the foemen's host.

verses.sa: प्रत्नं रयीणां युजं सखायं कीरिचोदनम् । ब्रह्मवाहस्तमं हुवे॥
verses.tr: pratnaṃ rayīṇāṃ yujaṃ sakhāyaṃ kīricodanam brahmavāhastamaṃ huve
verses.en: I call the ancient Friend, allied with wealth, who speeds the lowly man, Him to whom chiefly prayer is brought.

verses.sa: स हि विश्वानि पार्थिवाँ एको वसूनि पत्यते । गिर्वणस्तमो अध्रिगुः॥
verses.tr: sa hi viśvāni pārthivāṃ eko vasūni patyate girvaṇastamo adhriguḥ
verses.en: For he alone is Lord of all the treasures of the earth: he speeds Hither, chief Lover of the Song.

verses.sa: स नो नियुद्भिरा पृण कामं वाजेभिरश्विभिः । गोमद्भिर्गोपते धृषत्॥
verses.tr: sa no niyudbhirā pṛṇa kāmaṃ vājebhiraśvibhiḥ gomadbhirgopate dhṛṣat
verses.en: So with thy yoked teams satisfy our wish with power and wealth in steeds And cattle, boldly, Lord of kine!

verses.sa: तद्वो गाय सुते सचा पुरुहूताय सत्वने । शं यद्गवे न शाकिने॥
verses.tr: tadvo gāya sute sacā puruhūtāya satvane śaṃ yadgave na śākine
verses.en: Sing this, what time the ' juice is pressed, to him your Hero, Much-invoked, To please him as a mighty Steer.

verses.sa: न घा वसुर्नि यमते दानं वाजस्य गोमतः । यत्सीमुप श्रवद्गिरः॥
verses.tr: na ghā vasurni yamate dānaṃ vājasya gomataḥ yatsīmupa śravadgiraḥ
verses.en: He, Excellent, withholdeth not his gift of power and wealth in kine, When he hath listened to our songs.

verses.sa: कुवित्सस्य प्र हि व्रजं गोमन्तं दस्युहा गमत् । शचीभिरप नो वरत्॥
verses.tr: kuvitsasya pra hi vrajaṃ gomantaṃ dasyuhā gamat śacībhirapa no varat
verses.en: May he with might unclose for us the cow's stall, whosesoe'er it be, To which the Dasyu-slayer goes.

verses.sa: इमा उ त्वा शतक्रतोऽभि प्र णोनुवुर्गिरः । इन्द्र वत्सं न मातरः॥
verses.tr: imā u tvā śatakrato'bhi pra ṇonuvurgiraḥ indra vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ
verses.en: O Indra Satakratu, these our songs have called aloud to thee, Like mother cows to meet their calves.

verses.sa: दूणाशं सख्यं तव गौरसि वीर गव्यते । अश्वो अश्वायते भव॥
verses.tr: dūṇāśaṃ sakhyaṃ tava gaurasi vīra gavyate aśvo aśvāyate bhava
verses.en: Hard is thy love to win: thou art a Steer to him who longs for steers: Be to one craving steeds a Steed.

verses.sa: स मन्दस्वा ह्यन्धसो राधसे तन्वा महे । न स्तोतारं निदे करः॥
verses.tr: sa mandasvā hyandhaso rādhase tanvā mahe na stotāraṃ nide karaḥ
verses.en: Delight thee with the juice we pour for thine own great munificence: Yield not thy singer to reproach.

verses.sa: इमा उ त्वा सुतेसुते नक्षन्ते गिर्वणो गिरः । वत्सं गावो न धेनवः॥
verses.tr: imā u tvā sutesute nakṣante girvaṇo giraḥ vatsaṃ gāvo na dhenavaḥ
verses.en: These songs with every draught we pour come, Lover of the Song, to thee, As milch-kine hasten to their young

verses.sa: पुरूतमं पुरूणां स्तोतॄणां विवाचि । वाजेभिर्वाजयताम्॥
verses.tr: purūtamaṃ purūṇāṃ stotṝṇāṃ vivāci vājebhirvājayatām
verses.en: To thee most oft invoked, amid the many singers' rivalry Who beg with all their might for wealth.

verses.sa: अस्माकमिन्द्र भूतु ते स्तोमो वाहिष्ठो अन्तमः । अस्मान्राये महे हिनु॥
verses.tr: asmākamindra bhūtu te stomo vāhiṣṭho antamaḥ asmānrāye mahe hinu
verses.en: Nearest and most attractive may our laud, O Indra come to thee. Urge thou us on to ample wealth.

verses.sa: अधि बृबुः पणीनां वर्षिष्ठे मूर्धन्नस्थात् । उरुः कक्षो न गाङ्ग्यः॥
verses.tr: adhi bṛbuḥ paṇīnāṃ varṣiṣṭhe mūrdhannasthāt uruḥ kakṣo na gāṅgyaḥ
verses.en: Brbu hath set himself above the Panis, o'er their highest head, Like the wide bush on Ganga's bank.

verses.sa: यस्य वायोरिव द्रवद्भद्रा रातिः सहस्रिणी । सद्यो दानाय मंहते॥
verses.tr: yasya vāyoriva dravadbhadrā rātiḥ sahasriṇī sadyo dānāya maṃhate
verses.en: He whose good bounty, thousandfold, swift as the rushing of the wind, Suddenly offers as a gift.

verses.sa: तत्सु नो विश्वे अर्य आ सदा गृणन्ति कारवः । बृबुं सहस्रदातमं सूरिं सहस्रसातमम्॥
verses.tr: tatsu no viśve arya ā sadā gṛṇanti kāravaḥ bṛbuṃ sahasradātamaṃ sūriṃ sahasrasātamam
verses.en: So all our singers ever praise the pious Brbu's noble deed, Chief, best to give his thousands, best to give a thousand liberal gifts.

verses.sa:
त्वामिद्धि हवामहे साता वाजस्य कारवः ।
त्वां वृत्रेष्विन्द्र सत्पतिं नरस्त्वां काष्ठास्वर्वतः॥
verses.tr: tvāmiddhi havāmahe sātā vājasya kāravaḥ tvāṃ vṛtreṣvindra satpatiṃ narastvāṃ kāṣṭhāsvarvataḥ
verses.en: That we may win us wealth and power we poets, verily, call on thee: In war men call on thee, Indra, the hero's Lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee.

verses.sa:
स त्वं नश्चित्र वज्रहस्त धृष्णुया महः स्तवानो अद्रिवः ।
गामश्वं रथ्यमिन्द्र सं किर सत्रा वाजं न जिग्युषे॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ naścitra vajrahasta dhṛṣṇuyā mahaḥ stavāno adrivaḥ gāmaśvaṃ rathyamindra saṃ kira satrā vājaṃ na jigyuṣe
verses.en: As such, O Wonderful, whose hand holds thunder, praised as mighty, Caster of the Stone! Pour on us boldly, Indra, kine and chariotsteeds, ever to be the conqueror's strength.

verses.sa:
यः सत्राहा विचर्षणिरिन्द्रं तं हूमहे वयम् ।
सहस्रमुष्क तुविनृम्ण सत्पते भवा समत्सु नो वृधे॥
verses.tr: yaḥ satrāhā vicarṣaṇirindraṃ taṃ hūmahe vayam sahasramuṣka tuvinṛmṇa satpate bhavā samatsu no vṛdhe
verses.en: We call upon that Indra, who, most active, ever slays the foe: Lord of the brave, Most Manly, with a thousand powers, help thou and prosper us in fight.

verses.sa:
बाधसे जनान्वृषभेव मन्युना घृषौ मीळ्ह ऋचीषम ।
अस्माकं बोध्यविता महाधने तनूष्वप्सु सूर्ये॥
verses.tr: bādhase janānvṛṣabheva manyunā ghṛṣau mīḻha ṛcīṣama asmākaṃ bodhyavitā mahādhane tanūṣvapsu sūrye
verses.en: Rcisama, thou forcest men as with a bull, with anger, in the furious fray. Be thou our Helper in the mighty battle fought for sunlight, water, and for life.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र ज्येष्ठं न आ भरँ ओजिष्ठं पपुरि श्रवः ।
येनेमे चित्र वज्रहस्त रोदसी ओभे सुशिप्र प्राः॥
verses.tr: indra jyeṣṭhaṃ na ā bharaṃ ojiṣṭhaṃ papuri śravaḥ yeneme citra vajrahasta rodasī obhe suśipra prāḥ
verses.en: O Indra, bring us name and fame, enriching, mightiest, excellent, Wherewith, O Wondrous God, fair-visored, thunder-armed, thou hast filled full this earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
त्वामुग्रमवसे चर्षणीसहं राजन्देवेषु हूमहे ।
विश्वा सु नो विथुरा पिब्दना वसोऽमित्रान्त्सुषहान्कृधि॥
verses.tr: tvāmugramavase carṣaṇīsahaṃ rājandeveṣu hūmahe viśvā su no vithurā pibdanā vaso'mitrāntsuṣahānkṛdhi
verses.en: We call on thee, O King, Mighty amid the Gods, Ruler of men, to succour us. All that is weak in us, Excellent God, make firm: make our foes easy to subdue.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र नाहुषीष्वाँ ओजो नृम्णं च कृष्टिषु ।
यद्वा पञ्च क्षितीनां द्युम्नमा भर सत्रा विश्वानि पौंस्या॥
verses.tr: yadindra nāhuṣīṣvāṃ ojo nṛmṇaṃ ca kṛṣṭiṣu yadvā pañca kṣitīnāṃ dyumnamā bhara satrā viśvāni pauṃsyā
verses.en: All strength and valour that is found, Indra, in tribes of Nahusas, and all the splendid fame that the Five Tribes enjoy Bring, yea, all manly powers at once.

verses.sa:
यद्वा तृक्षौ मघवन्द्रुह्यावा जने यत्पूरौ कच्च वृष्ण्यम् ।
अस्मभ्यं तद्रिरीहि सं नृषाह्येऽमित्रान्पृत्सु तुर्वणे॥
verses.tr: yadvā tṛkṣau maghavandruhyāvā jane yatpūrau kacca vṛṣṇyam asmabhyaṃ tadrirīhi saṃ nṛṣāhye'mitrānpṛtsu turvaṇe
verses.en: Or, Maghavan, what vigorous strength in Trksi lay, in Druhyus or in Paru's folk, Fully bestow on us, that, in the conquering fray, we may subdue our foes in fight.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र त्रिधातु शरणं त्रिवरूथं स्वस्तिमत् ।
छर्दिर्यच्छ मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च यावया दिद्युमेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: indra tridhātu śaraṇaṃ trivarūthaṃ svastimat chardiryaccha maghavadbhyaśca mahyaṃ ca yāvayā didyumebhyaḥ
verses.en: O Indra, grant a happy home, a triple refuge triply strong. Bestow a dwelling-place on the rich lords and me, and keep thy dart afar from these.

verses.sa:
ये गव्यता मनसा शत्रुमादभुरभिप्रघ्नन्ति धृष्णुया ।
अध स्मा नो मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणस्तनूपा अन्तमो भव॥
verses.tr: ye gavyatā manasā śatrumādabhurabhipraghnanti dhṛṣṇuyā adha smā no maghavannindra girvaṇastanūpā antamo bhava
verses.en: They who with minds intent on spoil subdue the foe, boldly attack and smite him down,- From these, O Indra Maghavan who lovest song, be closest guardian of our lives.

verses.sa:
अध स्मा नो वृधे भवेन्द्र नायमवा युधि ।
यदन्तरिक्षे पतयन्ति पर्णिनो दिद्यवस्तिग्ममूर्धानः॥
verses.tr: adha smā no vṛdhe bhavendra nāyamavā yudhi yadantarikṣe patayanti parṇino didyavastigmamūrdhānaḥ
verses.en: And now, O Indra, strengthen us: come near and aid us in the fight, What time the feathered shafts are flying in the air, the arrows with their sharpened points.

verses.sa:
यत्र शूरासस्तन्वो वितन्वते प्रिया शर्म पितॄणाम् ।
अध स्मा यच्छ तन्वे३ तने च छर्दिरचित्तं यावय द्वेषः॥
verses.tr: yatra śūrāsastanvo vitanvate priyā śarma pitṝṇām adha smā yaccha tanve3 tane ca chardiracittaṃ yāvaya dveṣaḥ
verses.en: Give us, where heroes strain their bodies in the fight, the shelter that our fathers loved. To us and to our sons give refuge: keep afar all unobserved hostility.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र सर्गे अर्वतश्चोदयासे महाधने ।
असमने अध्वनि वृजिने पथि श्येनाँ इव श्रवस्यतः॥
verses.tr: yadindra sarge arvataścodayāse mahādhane asamane adhvani vṛjine pathi śyenāṃ iva śravasyataḥ
verses.en: When, Indra, in the mighty fray thou urgest chargers to their speed, On the uneven road and on a toilsome path, like falcons, eager for renown,

verses.sa:
सिन्धूँरिव प्रवण आशुया यतो यदि क्लोशमनु ष्वणि ।
आ ये वयो न वर्वृतत्यामिषि गृभीता बाह्वोर्गवि॥
verses.tr: sindhūṃriva pravaṇa āśuyā yato yadi klośamanu ṣvaṇi ā ye vayo na varvṛtatyāmiṣi gṛbhītā bāhvorgavi
verses.en: Speeding like rivers rushing down a steep descent, responsive to the urging call, That come like birds attracted to the bait, held in by reins in both the driver's hands.

verses.sa:
स्वादुष्किलायं मधुमाँ उतायं तीव्रः किलायं रसवाँ उतायम् ।
उतो न्व१स्य पपिवांसमिन्द्रं न कश्चन सहत आहवेषु॥
verses.tr: svāduṣkilāyaṃ madhumāṃ utāyaṃ tīvraḥ kilāyaṃ rasavāṃ utāyam uto nva1sya papivāṃsamindraṃ na kaścana sahata āhaveṣu
verses.en: Yea, this is good to taste and full of. sweetness, verily it is strong and rich in flavour. No one may conquer Indra in the battle when he hath drunken of the draught we offer.

verses.sa:
अयं स्वादुरिह मदिष्ठ आस यस्येन्द्रो वृत्रहत्ये ममाद ।
पुरूणि यश्च्यौत्ना शम्बरस्य वि नवतिं नव च देह्यो३ हन्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ svāduriha madiṣṭha āsa yasyendro vṛtrahatye mamāda purūṇi yaścyautnā śambarasya vi navatiṃ nava ca dehyo3 han
verses.en: This sweet juice here had mightiest power to gladden: it boldened Indra when he siaughtered Vrtra, When he defeated Sambara's many onslaughts, and battered down his nineand ninety ramparts.

verses.sa:
अयं मे पीत उदियर्ति वाचमयं मनीषामुशतीमजीगः ।
अयं षळुर्वीरमिमीत धीरो न याभ्यो भुवनं कच्चनारे॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ me pīta udiyarti vācamayaṃ manīṣāmuśatīmajīgaḥ ayaṃ ṣaḻurvīramimīta dhīro na yābhyo bhuvanaṃ kaccanāre
verses.en: This stirreth up my voice when I have drunk it: this hath aroused from sleep my yearning spirit. This Sage hath measured out the six expanses from which no single creature is excluded.

verses.sa:
अयं स यो वरिमाणं पृथिव्या वर्ष्माणं दिवो अकृणोदयं सः ।
अयं पीयूषं तिसृषु प्रवत्सु सोमो दाधारोर्व१न्तरिक्षम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ sa yo varimāṇaṃ pṛthivyā varṣmāṇaṃ divo akṛṇodayaṃ saḥ ayaṃ pīyūṣaṃ tisṛṣu pravatsu somo dādhārorva1ntarikṣam
verses.en: This, even this, is he who hath created the breadth of earth, the lofty height of heaven. He formed the nectar in three headlong rivers. Soma supports the wide mid-air above us.

verses.sa:
अयं विदच्चित्रदृशीकमर्णः शुक्रसद्मनामुषसामनीके ।
अयं महान्महता स्कम्भनेनोद्द्यामस्तभ्नाद्वृषभो मरुत्वान्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vidaccitradṛśīkamarṇaḥ śukrasadmanāmuṣasāmanīke ayaṃ mahānmahatā skambhanenoddyāmastabhnādvṛṣabho marutvān
verses.en: He found the wavy sea of brilliant colours in forefront of the Dawns who dwell in brightness. This Mighty One, the Steer begirt by Maruts, hath propped the heavens up with a mighty pillar.

verses.sa:
धृषत्पिब कलशे सोममिन्द्र वृत्रहा शूर समरे वसूनाम् ।
माध्यंदिने सवन आ वृषस्व रयिस्थानो रयिमस्मासु धेहि॥
verses.tr: dhṛṣatpiba kalaśe somamindra vṛtrahā śūra samare vasūnām mādhyaṃdine savana ā vṛṣasva rayisthāno rayimasmāsu dhehi
verses.en: Drink Soma boldly from the beaker, Indra, in war for treasures, Hero, Vrtra-slayer! Fill thyself full at the mid-day libation, and give us wealth, thou Treasury of riches.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र प्र णः पुरएतेव पश्य प्र नो नय प्रतरं वस्यो अच्छ ।
भवा सुपारो अतिपारयो नो भवा सुनीतिरुत वामनीतिः॥
verses.tr: indra pra ṇaḥ puraeteva paśya pra no naya prataraṃ vasyo accha bhavā supāro atipārayo no bhavā sunītiruta vāmanītiḥ
verses.en: Look out for us, O Indra, as our Leader, and guide us on to gain yet goodlier treasure. Excellent Guardian, bear us well through peril, and lead us on to wealth with careful guidance.

verses.sa:
उरुं नो लोकमनु नेषि विद्वान्त्स्वर्वज्ज्योतिरभयं स्वस्ति ।
ऋष्वा त इन्द्र स्थविरस्य बाहू उप स्थेयाम शरणा बृहन्ता॥
verses.tr: uruṃ no lokamanu neṣi vidvāntsvarvajjyotirabhayaṃ svasti ṛṣvā ta indra sthavirasya bāhū upa stheyāma śaraṇā bṛhantā
verses.en: Lead us to ample room, O thou who knowest, to happiness, security, and sunlight. High, Indra, are the arms of thee the Mighty: may we betake. us to their lofty shelter.

verses.sa:
वरिष्ठे न इन्द्र वन्धुरे धा वहिष्ठयोः शतावन्नश्वयोरा ।
इषमा वक्षीषां वर्षिष्ठां मा नस्तारीन्मघवन्रायो अर्यः॥
verses.tr: variṣṭhe na indra vandhure dhā vahiṣṭhayoḥ śatāvannaśvayorā iṣamā vakṣīṣāṃ varṣiṣṭhāṃ mā nastārīnmaghavanrāyo aryaḥ
verses.en: Set us on widest chariot-seat, O Indra, with two steeds best to draw, O Lord of Hundreds! Bring us the best among all sorts of viands: let not the foe's wealth, Maghavan, subdue us.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र मृळ मह्यं जीवातुमिच्छ चोदय धियमयसो न धाराम् ।
यत्किं चाहं त्वायुरिदं वदामि तज्जुषस्व कृधि मा देववन्तम्॥
verses.tr: indra mṛḻa mahyaṃ jīvātumiccha codaya dhiyamayaso na dhārām yatkiṃ cāhaṃ tvāyuridaṃ vadāmi tajjuṣasva kṛdhi mā devavantam
verses.en: Be gracious, Indra, let my days be lengthened: sharpen my thought as 'twere a blade of iron Approve whatever words I speak, dependent on thee, and grant me thy divine protection.

verses.sa:
त्रातारमिन्द्रमवितारमिन्द्रं हवेहवे सुहवं शूरमिन्द्रम् ।
ह्वयामि शक्रं पुरुहूतमिन्द्रं स्वस्ति नो मघवा धात्विन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: trātāramindramavitāramindraṃ havehave suhavaṃ śūramindram hvayāmi śakraṃ puruhūtamindraṃ svasti no maghavā dhātvindraḥ
verses.en: Indra the Rescuer, Indra the Helper, Hero who listens at each invocation, Sakra I call, Indra invoked of many. May Indra Maghavan prosper and bless us.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सुत्रामा स्ववाँ अवोभिः सुमृळीको भवतु विश्ववेदाः ।
बाधतां द्वेषो अभयं कृणोतु सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम॥
verses.tr: indraḥ sutrāmā svavāṃ avobhiḥ sumṛḻīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma
verses.en: May helpful Indra as our good Protector, Lord of all treasures, favour us with succour, Baffle our foes, and give us rest and safety, and may we be the lords of hero vigour.

verses.sa:
तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्याऽपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम ।
स सुत्रामा स्ववाँ इन्द्रो अस्मे आराच्चिद्द्वेषः सनुतर्युयोतु॥
verses.tr: tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyā'pi bhadre saumanase syāma sa sutrāmā svavāṃ indro asme ārācciddveṣaḥ sanutaryuyotu
verses.en: May we enjoy the grace of him the Holy, yea, may we dwell in his auspicious favour. May helpful Indra as our good Preserver drive from us, even from afar, our foemen.

verses.sa:
अव त्वे इन्द्र प्रवतो नोर्मिर्गिरो ब्रह्माणि नियुतो धवन्ते ।
उरू न राधः सवना पुरूण्यपो गा वज्रिन्युवसे समिन्दून्॥
verses.tr: ava tve indra pravato normirgiro brahmāṇi niyuto dhavante urū na rādhaḥ savanā purūṇyapo gā vajrinyuvase samindūn
verses.en: Like rivers rushing down a slope, O Indra, to thee haste songs and prayers and linked verses. Thou gatherest, Thunderer! like widespread bounty, kine, water, drops, and manifold libations.

verses.sa:
क ईं स्तवत्कः पृणात्को यजाते यदुग्रमिन्मघवा विश्वहावेत् ।
पादाविव प्रहरन्नन्यमन्यं कृणोति पूर्वमपरं शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: ka īṃ stavatkaḥ pṛṇātko yajāte yadugraminmaghavā viśvahāvet pādāviva praharannanyamanyaṃ kṛṇoti pūrvamaparaṃ śacībhiḥ
verses.en: Who lauds him, satisfies him, pays him worship? E'en the rich noble still hath found him mighty. With power, as when one moves his feet alternate, he makes the last precede, the foremost follow.

verses.sa:
शृण्वे वीर उग्रमुग्रं दमायन्नन्यमन्यमतिनेनीयमानः ।
एधमानद्विळुभयस्य राजा चोष्कूयते विश इन्द्रो मनुष्यान्॥
verses.tr: śṛṇve vīra ugramugraṃ damāyannanyamanyamatinenīyamānaḥ edhamānadviḻubhayasya rājā coṣkūyate viśa indro manuṣyān
verses.en: Famed is the Hero as each strong man's tamer, ever advancing one and then another. King of both worlds, hating the high and haughty, Indra protects the men who are his people.

verses.sa:
परा पूर्वेषां सख्या वृणक्ति वितर्तुराणो अपरेभिरेति ।
अनानुभूतीरवधून्वानः पूर्वीरिन्द्रः शरदस्तर्तरीति॥
verses.tr: parā pūrveṣāṃ sakhyā vṛṇakti vitarturāṇo aparebhireti anānubhūtīravadhūnvānaḥ pūrvīrindraḥ śaradastartarīti
verses.en: He loves no more the men he loved aforetime: he turns and moves away allied with others. Rejecting those who disregard his worship, Indra victorious lives through many autumns.

verses.sa:
रूपंरूपं प्रतिरूपो बभूव तदस्य रूपं प्रतिचक्षणाय ।
इन्द्रो मायाभिः पुरुरूप ईयते युक्ता ह्यस्य हरयः शता दश॥
verses.tr: rūpaṃrūpaṃ pratirūpo babhūva tadasya rūpaṃ praticakṣaṇāya indro māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyate yuktā hyasya harayaḥ śatā daśa
verses.en: In every figure he hath been the mode: this is his only form for us to look on. Indra moves multiform by his illusions; for his Bay Steeds are yoked, ten times a hundred.

verses.sa:
युजानो हरिता रथे भूरि त्वष्टेह राजति ।
को विश्वाहा द्विषतः पक्ष आसत उतासीनेषु सूरिषु॥
verses.tr: yujāno haritā rathe bhūri tvaṣṭeha rājati ko viśvāhā dviṣataḥ pakṣa āsata utāsīneṣu sūriṣu
verses.en: Here Tvastar, yoking to the car the Bay Steeds, hath extended sway. Who will for ever stand upon the foeman's side, even when our princes sit at ease?

verses.sa:
अगव्यूति क्षेत्रमागन्म देवा उर्वी सती भूमिरंहूरणाभूत् ।
बृहस्पते प्र चिकित्सा गविष्टावित्था सते जरित्र इन्द्र पन्थाम्॥
verses.tr: agavyūti kṣetramāganma devā urvī satī bhūmiraṃhūraṇābhūt bṛhaspate pra cikitsā gaviṣṭāvitthā sate jaritra indra panthām
verses.en: Gods, we have reached a country void of pasture the land, though spacious, was too small to hold us. Brhaspati, provide in war for cattle; find a path, Indra, for this faithful singer.

verses.sa:
दिवेदिवे सदृशीरन्यमर्धं कृष्णा असेधदप सद्मनो जाः ।
अहन्दासा वृषभो वस्नयन्तोदव्रजे वर्चिनं शम्बरं च॥
verses.tr: divedive sadṛśīranyamardhaṃ kṛṣṇā asedhadapa sadmano jāḥ ahandāsā vṛṣabho vasnayantodavraje varcinaṃ śambaraṃ ca
verses.en: Day after day far from their seat he drove them, alike, from place to place, those darksome creatures. The Hero slew the meanly-huckstering Dasas, Varcin and Sambara, where the waters gather.

verses.sa:
प्रस्तोक इन्नु राधसस्त इन्द्र दश कोशयीर्दश वाजिनोऽदात् ।
दिवोदासादतिथिग्वस्य राधः शाम्बरं वसु प्रत्यग्रभीष्म॥
verses.tr: prastoka innu rādhasasta indra daśa kośayīrdaśa vājino'dāt divodāsādatithigvasya rādhaḥ śāmbaraṃ vasu pratyagrabhīṣma
verses.en: Out of thy bounty, Indra, hath Prastoka bestowed ten coffers and ten mettled horses. We have received in turn from Divodasa Sambara's wealth, the gift of Atithigva.

verses.sa: दशाश्वान्दश कोशान्दश वस्त्राधिभोजना । दशो हिरण्यपिण्डान्दिवोदासादसानिषम्॥
verses.tr: daśāśvāndaśa kośāndaśa vastrādhibhojanā daśo hiraṇyapiṇḍāndivodāsādasāniṣam
verses.en: Ten horses and ten treasure-chests, ten garments as an added gift, These and ten lumps of gold have I received from Divodasa's hand.

verses.sa: दश रथान्प्रष्टिमतः शतं गा अथर्वभ्यः । अश्वथः पायवेऽदात्॥
verses.tr: daśa rathānpraṣṭimataḥ śataṃ gā atharvabhyaḥ aśvathaḥ pāyave'dāt
verses.en: Ten cars with extra steed to each, for the Atharvans hundred cows, Hath Asvatha to Payu given.

verses.sa: महि राधो विश्वजन्यं दधानान्भरद्वाजान्त्सार्ञ्जयो अभ्ययष्ट॥
verses.tr: mahi rādho viśvajanyaṃ dadhānānbharadvājāntsārñjayo abhyayaṣṭa
verses.en: Thus Srnjaya's son honoured the Bharadvajas, recipients of all noble gifts and bounty.

verses.sa:
वनस्पते वीड्वङ्गो हि भूया अस्मत्सखा प्रतरणः सुवीरः ।
गोभिः सनद्धो असि वीळयस्वाऽऽस्थाता ते जयतु जेत्वानि॥
verses.tr: vanaspate vīḍvaṅgo hi bhūyā asmatsakhā prataraṇaḥ suvīraḥ gobhiḥ sanaddho asi vīḻayasvā''sthātā te jayatu jetvāni
verses.en: Lord of the wood, be firm and strong in body: be, bearing us, a brave victorious hero Show forth thy strength, compact with straps of leather, and let thy rider win all spoils of battle.

verses.sa:
दिवस्पृथिव्याः पर्योज उद्भृतं वनस्पतिभ्यः पर्याभृतं सहः ।
अपामोज्मानं परि गोभिरावृतमिन्द्रस्य वज्रं हविषा रथं यज॥
verses.tr: divaspṛthivyāḥ paryoja udbhṛtaṃ vanaspatibhyaḥ paryābhṛtaṃ sahaḥ apāmojmānaṃ pari gobhirāvṛtamindrasya vajraṃ haviṣā rathaṃ yaja
verses.en: Its mighty strength was borrowed from the heaven and earth: its conquering force was brought from sovrans of the wood. Honour with holy gifts the Car like Indra's bolt, the Car bound round with straps, the vigour of the floods.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वज्रो मरुतामनीकं मित्रस्य गर्भो वरुणस्य नाभिः ।
सेमां नो हव्यदातिं जुषाणो देव रथ प्रति हव्या गृभाय॥
verses.tr: indrasya vajro marutāmanīkaṃ mitrasya garbho varuṇasya nābhiḥ semāṃ no havyadātiṃ juṣāṇo deva ratha prati havyā gṛbhāya
verses.en: Thou Bolt of Indra, Vanguard of the Maruts, close knit to Varuna and Child of Mitra,- As such, accepting gifts which here we offer, receive, O Godlike Chariot, these oblations.

verses.sa:
उप श्वासय पृथिवीमुत द्यां पुरुत्रा ते मनुतां विष्ठितं जगत् ।
स दुन्दुभे सजूरिन्द्रेण देवैर्दूराद्दवीयो अप सेध शत्रून्॥
verses.tr: upa śvāsaya pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ purutrā te manutāṃ viṣṭhitaṃ jagat sa dundubhe sajūrindreṇa devairdūrāddavīyo apa sedha śatrūn
verses.en: Send forth thy voice aloud through earth and heaven, and let the world in all its breadth regard thee; O Drum, accordant with the Gods and Indra, drive thou afar, yea, very far, our foemen.

verses.sa:
आ क्रन्दय बलमोजो न आ धा निः ष्टनिहि दुरिता बाधमानः ।
अप प्रोथ दुन्दुभे दुच्छुना इत इन्द्रस्य मुष्टिरसि वीळयस्व॥
verses.tr: ā krandaya balamojo na ā dhā niḥ ṣṭanihi duritā bādhamānaḥ apa protha dundubhe ducchunā ita indrasya muṣṭirasi vīḻayasva
verses.en: Thunder out strength and fill us full of vigour: yea, thunder forth and drive away all dangers. Drive hence, O War-drum, drive away misfortune: thou art the Fist of Indra: show thy firmness.

verses.sa:
आमूरज प्रत्यावर्तयेमाः केतुमद्दुन्दुभिर्वावदीति ।
समश्वपर्णाश्चरन्ति नो नरोऽस्माकमिन्द्र रथिनो जयन्तु॥
verses.tr: āmūraja pratyāvartayemāḥ ketumaddundubhirvāvadīti samaśvaparṇāścaranti no naro'smākamindra rathino jayantu
verses.en: Drive hither those, and these again bring hither: the War-drum speaks aloud as battle's signal. Our heroes, winged with horses, come together. Let our car-warriors, Indra, be triumphant.

verses.sa: यज्ञायज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरागिरा च दक्षसे । प्रप्र वयममृतं जातवेदसं प्रियं मित्रं न शंसिषम्॥
verses.tr: yajñāyajñā vo agnaye girāgirā ca dakṣase prapra vayamamṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam
verses.en: Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice, for strength. Come, let us praise the Wise and Everlasting God, even as a well-beloved Friend,

verses.sa: ऊर्जो नपातं स हिनायमस्मयुर्दाशेम हव्यदातये । भुवद्वाजेष्वविता भुवद्वृध उत त्राता तनूनाम्॥
verses.tr: ūrjo napātaṃ sa hināyamasmayurdāśema havyadātaye bhuvadvājeṣvavitā bhuvadvṛdha uta trātā tanūnām
verses.en: The Son of Strength; for is he not our gracious Lord? Let us serve him who bears our gifts. In battle may he be our help and strengthener, yea, be the saviour of our lives.

verses.sa: वृषा ह्यग्ने अजरो महान्विभास्यर्चिषा । अजस्रेण शोचिषा शोशुचच्छुचे सुदीतिभिः सु दीदिहि॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā hyagne ajaro mahānvibhāsyarciṣā ajasreṇa śociṣā śośucacchuce sudītibhiḥ su dīdihi
verses.en: Agni, thou beamest forth with light, great Hero, never changed by time. Shining, pure Agni! with a light that never fades, beam with thy fair beams brilliantly.

verses.sa: महो देवान्यजसि यक्ष्यानुषक्तव क्रत्वोत दंसना । अर्वाचः सीं कृणुह्यग्नेऽवसे रास्व वाजोत वंस्व॥
verses.tr: maho devānyajasi yakṣyānuṣaktava kratvota daṃsanā arvācaḥ sīṃ kṛṇuhyagne'vase rāsva vājota vaṃsva
verses.en: Thou worshippest great Gods: bring them without delay by wisdom and thy wondrous power. O Agni, make them turn hither to succour us. Give strength, and win it for thyself.

verses.sa: यमापो अद्रयो वना गर्भमृतस्य पिप्रति । सहसा यो मथितो जायते नृभिः पृथिव्या अधि सानवि॥
verses.tr: yamāpo adrayo vanā garbhamṛtasya piprati sahasā yo mathito jāyate nṛbhiḥ pṛthivyā adhi sānavi
verses.en: He whom floods, stones, and trees support, the offspring of eternal Law; He who when rubbed with force is brought to life by men upon the lofty height of earth;

verses.sa: आ यः पप्रौ भानुना रोदसी उभे धूमेन धावते दिवि । तिरस्तमो ददृश ऊर्म्यास्वा श्यावास्वरुषो वृषा श्यावा अरुषो वृषा॥
verses.tr: ā yaḥ paprau bhānunā rodasī ubhe dhūmena dhāvate divi tirastamo dadṛśa ūrmyāsvā śyāvāsvaruṣo vṛṣā śyāvā aruṣo vṛṣā
verses.en: He who hath filled both worlds fult with his brilliant shine, who hastens with his smoke to heaven; He made himself apparent through the gloom by night, the Red Bull in the darksome nights, the Red Bull in the darksome nights.

verses.sa: बृहद्भिरग्ने अर्चिभिः शुक्रेण देव शोचिषा । भरद्वाजे समिधानो यविष्ठ्य रेवन्नः शुक्र दीदिहि द्युमत्पावक दीदिहि॥
verses.tr: bṛhadbhiragne arcibhiḥ śukreṇa deva śociṣā bharadvāje samidhāno yaviṣṭhya revannaḥ śukra dīdihi dyumatpāvaka dīdihi
verses.en: O Agni, with thy lofty beams, with thy pure brilliancy, O God, Kindled, Most Youthful One! by Bharadvaja's hand, shine on us, O pure God, with wealth, shine, Purifier! splendidly.

verses.sa: विश्वासां गृहपतिर्विशामसि त्वमग्ने मानुषीणाम् । शतं पूर्भिर्यविष्ठ पाह्यंहसः समेद्धारं शतं हिमाः स्तोतृभ्यो ये च ददति॥
verses.tr: viśvāsāṃ gṛhapatirviśāmasi tvamagne mānuṣīṇām śataṃ pūrbhiryaviṣṭha pāhyaṃhasaḥ sameddhāraṃ śataṃ himāḥ stotṛbhyo ye ca dadati
verses.en: Thou art the Lord of house and home of all the tribes, O Agni, of all tribes of men. Guard with a hundred forts thy kindler from distress, through hundred winters, Youngest God! and those who make thy singers rich.

verses.sa: त्वं नश्चित्र ऊत्या वसो राधांसि चोदय । अस्य रायस्त्वमग्ने रथीरसि विदा गाधं तुचे तु नः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ naścitra ūtyā vaso rādhāṃsi codaya asya rāyastvamagne rathīrasi vidā gādhaṃ tuce tu naḥ
verses.en: Wonderful, with thy favouring help, send us thy bounties, gracious Lord. Thou art the Charioteer, Agni, of earthly wealth: find rest and safety for our seed.

verses.sa: पर्षि तोकं तनयं पर्तृभिष्ट्वमदब्धैरप्रयुत्वभिः । अग्ने हेळांसि दैव्या युयोधि नोऽदेवानि ह्वरांसि च॥
verses.tr: parṣi tokaṃ tanayaṃ partṛbhiṣṭvamadabdhairaprayutvabhiḥ agne heḻāṃsi daivyā yuyodhi no'devāni hvarāṃsi ca
verses.en: With guards unfailing never negligent speed thou our children and our progeny. Keep far from us, O Agni, all celestial wrath and wickedness of godless men.

verses.sa: आ सखायः सबर्दुघां धेनुमजध्वमुप नव्यसा वचः । सृजध्वमनपस्फुराम्॥
verses.tr: ā sakhāyaḥ sabardughāṃ dhenumajadhvamupa navyasā vacaḥ sṛjadhvamanapasphurām
verses.en: Hither, O friends, with newest song drive her who freely pours her milk; Loose her who never turns away;

verses.sa: या शर्धाय मारुताय स्वभानवे श्रवोऽमृत्यु धुक्षत । या मृळीके मरुतां तुराणां या सुम्नैरेवयावरी॥
verses.tr: yā śardhāya mārutāya svabhānave śravo'mṛtyu dhukṣata yā mṛḻīke marutāṃ turāṇāṃ yā sumnairevayāvarī
verses.en: Who, for the host of Maruts bright with native sheen, hath shed immortal fame like milk; Whom the impetuous Maruts look upon with love, who moves in splendour on their ways.

verses.sa: भरद्वाजायाव धुक्षत द्विता । धेनुं च विश्वदोहसमिषं च विश्वभोजसम्॥
verses.tr: bharadvājāyāva dhukṣata dvitā dhenuṃ ca viśvadohasamiṣaṃ ca viśvabhojasam
verses.en: For Bharadvaja she poured down in days of old The milch-cow yielding milk for all, and food that gives all nourishment.

verses.sa: तं व इन्द्रं न सुक्रतुं वरुणमिव मायिनम् । अर्यमणं न मन्द्रं सृप्रभोजसं विष्णुं न स्तुष आदिशे॥
verses.tr: taṃ va indraṃ na sukratuṃ varuṇamiva māyinam aryamaṇaṃ na mandraṃ sṛprabhojasaṃ viṣṇuṃ na stuṣa ādiśe
verses.en: Your friend like Indra passing wise, with magic power like Varuna. Like Aryaman joy-giving, bringing plenteous food like Visnu for my wish, I praise,

verses.sa: त्वेषं शर्धो न मारुतं तुविष्वण्यनर्वाणं पूषणं सं यथा शता । सं सहस्रा कारिषच्चर्षणिभ्य आँ आविर्गूळ्हा वसू करत्सुवेदा नो वसू करत्॥
verses.tr: tveṣaṃ śardho na mārutaṃ tuviṣvaṇyanarvāṇaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ saṃ yathā śatā saṃ sahasrā kāriṣaccarṣaṇibhya āṃ āvirgūḻhā vasū karatsuvedā no vasū karat
verses.en: Bright as the host of Maruts mighty in their roar. May they bring Pusan free from foes; May they bring hither hundreds, thousands for our men: may they bring hidden stores to light, and make wealth easy to be found.

verses.sa: आ मा पूषन्नुप द्रव शंसिषं नु ते अपिकर्ण आघृणे । अघा अर्यो अरातयः॥
verses.tr: ā mā pūṣannupa drava śaṃsiṣaṃ nu te apikarṇa āghṛṇe aghā aryo arātayaḥ
verses.en: Haste to me, Pusan, in thine car, bright Deity: I fain would speak: Most sinful is our foeman's hate.

verses.sa: मा काकम्बीरमुद्वृहो वनस्पतिमशस्तीर्वि हि नीनशः । मोत सूरो अह एवा चन ग्रीवा आदधते वेः॥
verses.tr: mā kākambīramudvṛho vanaspatimaśastīrvi hi nīnaśaḥ mota sūro aha evā cana grīvā ādadhate veḥ
verses.en: Tear not up by the roots the Kakambira tree: destroy thou all malignity. Let them not snare by day the neck of that Celestial Bird the Sun.

verses.sa: दृतेरिव तेऽवृकमस्तु सख्यम् । अच्छिद्रस्य दधन्वतः सुपूर्णस्य दधन्वतः॥
verses.tr: dṛteriva te'vṛkamastu sakhyam acchidrasya dadhanvataḥ supūrṇasya dadhanvataḥ
verses.en: Uninjured let thy friendship be, like the smooth surface of a skin, A flawless skin, containing curds, full to the mouth, containing curds.

verses.sa: परो हि मर्त्यैरसि समो देवैरुत श्रिया । अभि ख्यः पूषन्पृतनासु नस्त्वमवा नूनं यथा पुरा॥
verses.tr: paro hi martyairasi samo devairuta śriyā abhi khyaḥ pūṣanpṛtanāsu nastvamavā nūnaṃ yathā purā
verses.en: For thou art high above mankind, in glory equal to the Gods. Therefore, O Pusan, look upon us in the fight: now help us as in days of old.

verses.sa: वामी वामस्य धूतयः प्रणीतिरस्तु सूनृता । देवस्य वा मरुतो मर्त्यस्य वेजानस्य प्रयज्यवः॥
verses.tr: vāmī vāmasya dhūtayaḥ praṇītirastu sūnṛtā devasya vā maruto martyasya vejānasya prayajyavaḥ
verses.en: May the kind excellence of him the Kind, loud Roarers! be our guide, Be it the God's, O Maruts, or a mortal man's who worships, ye impetuous Ones!

verses.sa: सद्यश्चिद्यस्य चर्कृतिः परि द्यां देवो नैति सूर्यः । त्वेषं शवो दधिरे नाम यज्ञियं मरुतो वृत्रहं शवो ज्येष्ठं वृत्रहं शवः॥
verses.tr: sadyaścidyasya carkṛtiḥ pari dyāṃ devo naiti sūryaḥ tveṣaṃ śavo dadhire nāma yajñiyaṃ maruto vṛtrahaṃ śavo jyeṣṭhaṃ vṛtrahaṃ śavaḥ
verses.en: They whose high glory in a moment like the God, the Sun, goes round the space of heaven, The Maruts have obtained bright strength, a sacred name, strength that destroys the Vrtras, strength Vrtra-destroying excellent.

verses.sa: सकृद्ध द्यौरजायत सकृद्भूमिरजायत । पृश्न्या दुग्धं सकृत्पयस्तदन्यो नानु जायते॥
verses.tr: sakṛddha dyaurajāyata sakṛdbhūmirajāyata pṛśnyā dugdhaṃ sakṛtpayastadanyo nānu jāyate
verses.en: Once, only once, the heaven was made, once only once, the earth was formed- Once, only Prsni's milk was shed: no second, after this, is born.

verses.sa:
स्तुषे जनं सुव्रतं नव्यसीभिर्गीर्भिर्मित्रावरुणा सुम्नयन्ता ।
त आ गमन्तु त इह श्रुवन्तु सुक्षत्रासो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः॥
verses.tr: stuṣe janaṃ suvrataṃ navyasībhirgīrbhirmitrāvaruṇā sumnayantā ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantu sukṣatrāso varuṇo mitro agniḥ
verses.en: I LAUD with newest songs the Righteous People, Mitra and Varuna who make us happy. Let them approach, here let them listen,Agni, Varuna, Mitra, Lords of fair dominion.

verses.sa:
विशोविश ईड्यमध्वरेष्वदृप्तक्रतुमरतिं युवत्योः ।
दिवः शिशुं सहसः सूनुमग्निं यज्ञस्य केतुमरुषं यजध्यै॥
verses.tr: viśoviśa īḍyamadhvareṣvadṛptakratumaratiṃ yuvatyoḥ divaḥ śiśuṃ sahasaḥ sūnumagniṃ yajñasya ketumaruṣaṃ yajadhyai
verses.en: Him, to be praised at each tribe's sacrifices, the Two young Matrons' sober-minded Herald, The Son of Strength, the Child of Heaven, the signal of sacrifice, red Agni will I worship.

verses.sa:
अरुषस्य दुहितरा विरूपे स्तृभिरन्या पिपिशे सूरो अन्या ।
मिथस्तुरा विचरन्ती पावके मन्म श्रुतं नक्षत ऋच्यमाने॥
verses.tr: aruṣasya duhitarā virūpe stṛbhiranyā pipiśe sūro anyā mithasturā vicarantī pāvake manma śrutaṃ nakṣata ṛcyamāne
verses.en: Unlike in form are the Red God's two Daughters: one is the Sun's, and stars bedeck the other. Apart, the Sanctifiers, in succession, come to the famed hymn, praised in holy verses.

verses.sa:
प्र वायुमच्छा बृहती मनीषा बृहद्रयिं विश्ववारं रथप्राम् ।
द्युतद्यामा नियुतः पत्यमानः कविः कविमियक्षसि प्रयज्यो॥
verses.tr: pra vāyumacchā bṛhatī manīṣā bṛhadrayiṃ viśvavāraṃ rathaprām dyutadyāmā niyutaḥ patyamānaḥ kaviḥ kavimiyakṣasi prayajyo
verses.en: I with a lofty song call hither Vayu, all-bounteous, filler of his car, most wealthy. Thou, Sage, with bright path, Lord of harnessed horses, impetuous, promptly honourest the prudent.

verses.sa:
स मे वपुश्छदयदश्विनोर्यो रथो विरुक्मान्मनसा युजानः ।
येन नरा नासत्येषयध्यै वर्तिर्याथस्तनयाय त्मने च॥
verses.tr: sa me vapuśchadayadaśvinoryo ratho virukmānmanasā yujānaḥ yena narā nāsatyeṣayadhyai vartiryāthastanayāya tmane ca
verses.en: That chariot of the Asvins, fair to look on, pleaseth me well, yoked with a thought, refulgent, Wherewith, Nasatyas, Chiefs, ye seek our dwelling, to give new strength to us and to our children.

verses.sa:
पर्जन्यवाता वृषभा पृथिव्याः पुरीषाणि जिन्वतमप्यानि ।
सत्यश्रुतः कवयो यस्य गीर्भिर्जगतः स्थातर्जगदा कृणुध्वम्॥
verses.tr: parjanyavātā vṛṣabhā pṛthivyāḥ purīṣāṇi jinvatamapyāni satyaśrutaḥ kavayo yasya gīrbhirjagataḥ sthātarjagadā kṛṇudhvam
verses.en: Bulls of the Earth, O Vata and Parjanya, stir up for us the regions of the water. Hearers of truth, ye, Sages, World-Supporters, increase his living wealth whose songs delight you.

verses.sa:
पावीरवी कन्या चित्रायुः सरस्वती वीरपत्नी धियं धात् ।
ग्नाभिरच्छिद्रं शरणं सजोषा दुराधर्षं गृणते शर्म यंसत्॥
verses.tr: pāvīravī kanyā citrāyuḥ sarasvatī vīrapatnī dhiyaṃ dhāt gnābhiracchidraṃ śaraṇaṃ sajoṣā durādharṣaṃ gṛṇate śarma yaṃsat
verses.en: So may Sarasvati, the Hero's Consort, brisk with rare life, the lightning's Child, inspire us, And, with the Dames accordant, give the singer a refuge unassailable and flawless.

verses.sa:
पथस्पथः परिपतिं वचस्या कामेन कृतो अभ्यानळर्कम् ।
स नो रासच्छुरुधश्चन्द्राग्रा धियंधियं सीषधाति प्र पूषा॥
verses.tr: pathaspathaḥ paripatiṃ vacasyā kāmena kṛto abhyānaḻarkam sa no rāsacchurudhaścandrāgrā dhiyaṃdhiyaṃ sīṣadhāti pra pūṣā
verses.en: I praise with eloquence him who guards all pathways. He, when his love impelled him, went to Arka. May he vouchsafe us gear with gold to grace it: may Pusan make each prayer of ours efective.

verses.sa:
प्रथमभाजं यशसं वयोधां सुपाणिं देवं सुगभस्तिमृभ्वम् ।
होता यक्षद्यजतं पस्त्यानामग्निस्त्वष्टारं सुहवं विभावा॥
verses.tr: prathamabhājaṃ yaśasaṃ vayodhāṃ supāṇiṃ devaṃ sugabhastimṛbhvam hotā yakṣadyajataṃ pastyānāmagnistvaṣṭāraṃ suhavaṃ vibhāvā
verses.en: May Herald Agni, fulgent, bring for worship Tvastar adored, in homes and swift to listen, Glorious, first to share, the life-bestower, the ever active God, fair-armed, fair-handed.

verses.sa:
भुवनस्य पितरं गीर्भिराभी रुद्रं दिवा वर्धया रुद्रमक्तौ ।
बृहन्तमृष्वमजरं सुषुम्नमृधग्घुवेम कविनेषितासः॥
verses.tr: bhuvanasya pitaraṃ gīrbhirābhī rudraṃ divā vardhayā rudramaktau bṛhantamṛṣvamajaraṃ suṣumnamṛdhagghuvema kavineṣitāsaḥ
verses.en: Rudra by day, Rudra at night we honour with these our songs, the Universe's Father. Him great and lofty, blissful, undecaying let us call specially as the Sage impels us.

verses.sa:
आ युवानः कवयो यज्ञियासो मरुतो गन्त गृणतो वरस्याम् ।
अचित्रं चिद्धि जिन्वथा वृधन्त इत्था नक्षन्तो नरो अङ्गिरस्वत्॥
verses.tr: ā yuvānaḥ kavayo yajñiyāso maruto ganta gṛṇato varasyām acitraṃ ciddhi jinvathā vṛdhanta itthā nakṣanto naro aṅgirasvat
verses.en: Ye who are youthful, wise, and meet for worship, come, Maruts, to the longing of the singer. Coming, as erst to Angiras, O Heroes, ye animate and quicken e'en the desert.

verses.sa:
प्र वीराय प्र तवसे तुरायाऽजा यूथेव पशुरक्षिरस्तम् ।
स पिस्पृशति तन्वि श्रुतस्य स्तृभिर्न नाकं वचनस्य विपः॥
verses.tr: pra vīrāya pra tavase turāyā'jā yūtheva paśurakṣirastam sa pispṛśati tanvi śrutasya stṛbhirna nākaṃ vacanasya vipaḥ
verses.en: Even as the herdsman driveth home his cattle, I urge my songs to him the strong swift Hero May he, the glorious, lay upon his body the singer's hymns, as stars bedeck the heaven.

verses.sa:
यो रजांसि विममे पार्थिवानि त्रिश्चिद्विष्णुर्मनवे बाधिताय ।
तस्य ते शर्मन्नुपदद्यमाने राया मदेम तन्वा३ तना च॥
verses.tr: yo rajāṃsi vimame pārthivāni triścidviṣṇurmanave bādhitāya tasya te śarmannupadadyamāne rāyā madema tanvā3 tanā ca
verses.en: He who for man's behoof in his afiliction thrice measured out the earthly regions, Visnu- When one so great as thou affordeth shelter, may we with wealth and with ourselves be happy.

verses.sa:
तन्नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यो अद्भिरर्कैस्तत्पर्वतस्तत्सविता चनो धात् ।
तदोषधीभिरभि रातिषाचो भगः पुरंधिर्जिन्वतु प्र राये॥
verses.tr: tanno'hirbudhnyo adbhirarkaistatparvatastatsavitā cano dhāt tadoṣadhībhirabhi rātiṣāco bhagaḥ puraṃdhirjinvatu pra rāye
verses.en: Sweet be this song of mine to Ahibudhnya, Parvata, Savitar, with Floods and Lightnings; Sweet, with the Plants, to Gods who seek oblations. May liberal Bhaga speed us on to riches.

verses.sa:
नू नो रयिं रथ्यं चर्षणिप्रां पुरुवीरं मह ऋतस्य गोपाम् ।
क्षयं दाताजरं येन जनान्त्स्पृधो अदेवीरभि च क्रमाम विश आदेवीरभ्य१श्नवाम॥
verses.tr: nū no rayiṃ rathyaṃ carṣaṇiprāṃ puruvīraṃ maha ṛtasya gopām kṣayaṃ dātājaraṃ yena janāntspṛdho adevīrabhi ca kramāma viśa ādevīrabhya1śnavāma
verses.en: Give riches borne on cars, with many heroes, contenting men, the guard of mighty Order. Give us a lasting home that we may battle with godless bands of men who fight against us, and meet with tribes to whom the Gods are gracious.

verses.sa:
हुवे वो देवीमदितिं नमोभिर्मृळीकाय वरुणं मित्रमग्निम् ।
अभिक्षदामर्यमणं सुशेवं त्रातॄन्देवान्त्सवितारं भगं च॥
verses.tr: huve vo devīmaditiṃ namobhirmṛḻīkāya varuṇaṃ mitramagnim abhikṣadāmaryamaṇaṃ suśevaṃ trātṝndevāntsavitāraṃ bhagaṃ ca
verses.en: I CALL with prayers on Aditi your Goddess, on Agni, Mitra, Varuna for favour, On Aryaman who gives unasked, the gracious, on Gods who save, on Savitar and Bhaga.

verses.sa:
सुज्योतिषः सूर्य दक्षपितॄननागास्त्वे सुमहो वीहि देवान् ।
द्विजन्मानो य ऋतसापः सत्याः स्वर्वन्तो यजता अग्निजिह्वाः॥
verses.tr: sujyotiṣaḥ sūrya dakṣapitṝnanāgāstve sumaho vīhi devān dvijanmāno ya ṛtasāpaḥ satyāḥ svarvanto yajatā agnijihvāḥ
verses.en: Visit, to prove us free from sin, O Surya Lord of great might, the bright Gods sprung from Daksa, Twice-born and true, observing sacred duties, Holy and full of light, whose tongue is Agni.

verses.sa:
उत द्यावापृथिवी क्षत्रमुरु बृहद्रोदसी शरणं सुषुम्ने ।
महस्करथो वरिवो यथा नोऽस्मे क्षयाय धिषणे अनेहः॥
verses.tr: uta dyāvāpṛthivī kṣatramuru bṛhadrodasī śaraṇaṃ suṣumne mahaskaratho varivo yathā no'sme kṣayāya dhiṣaṇe anehaḥ
verses.en: And, O ye Heaven and Earth, a wide dominion, O ye most blissful Worlds, our lofty shelter, Give ample room and freedom for our dwelling, a home, ye Hemispheres, which none may rival.

verses.sa:
आ नो रुद्रस्य सूनवो नमन्तामद्या हूतासो वसवोऽधृष्टाः ।
यदीमर्भे महति वा हितासो बाधे मरुतो अह्वाम देवान्॥
verses.tr: ā no rudrasya sūnavo namantāmadyā hūtāso vasavo'dhṛṣṭāḥ yadīmarbhe mahati vā hitāso bādhe maruto ahvāma devān
verses.en: This day invited may the Sons of Rudra, resistless, excellent, stoop down to meet us; For, when beset with slight or sore affliction, we ever call upon the Gods, the Maruts;

verses.sa:
मिम्यक्ष येषु रोदसी नु देवी सिषक्ति पूषा अभ्यर्धयज्वा ।
श्रुत्वा हवं मरुतो यद्ध याथ भूमा रेजन्ते अध्वनि प्रविक्ते॥
verses.tr: mimyakṣa yeṣu rodasī nu devī siṣakti pūṣā abhyardhayajvā śrutvā havaṃ maruto yaddha yātha bhūmā rejante adhvani pravikte
verses.en: To whom the Goddess Rodasi clings closely, whom Pusan follows bringing ample bounty. What time ye hear our call and come, O Maruts, upon your separate path all creatures tremble.

verses.sa:
अभि त्यं वीरं गिर्वणसमर्चेन्द्रं ब्रह्मणा जरितर्नवेन ।
श्रवदिद्धवमुप च स्तवानो रासद्वाजाँ उप महो गृणानः॥
verses.tr: abhi tyaṃ vīraṃ girvaṇasamarcendraṃ brahmaṇā jaritarnavena śravadiddhavamupa ca stavāno rāsadvājāṃ upa maho gṛṇānaḥ
verses.en: With a new hymn extol, O thou who singest, the Lover of the Song, the Hero Indra. May he, exalted, hear our invocation, and grant us mighty wealth and strength when lauded.

verses.sa:
ओमानमापो मानुषीरमृक्तं धात तोकाय तनयाय शं योः ।
यूयं हि ष्ठा भिषजो मातृतमा विश्वस्य स्थातुर्जगतो जनित्रीः॥
verses.tr: omānamāpo mānuṣīramṛktaṃ dhāta tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā bhiṣajo mātṛtamā viśvasya sthāturjagato janitrīḥ
verses.en: Give full protection, Friends of man, ye Waters, in peace and trouble, to our sons and grandsons. For ye are our most motherly physicians, parents of all that standeth, all that moveth.

verses.sa:
आ नो देवः सविता त्रायमाणो हिरण्यपाणिर्यजतो जगम्यात् ।
यो दत्रवाँ उषसो न प्रतीकं व्यूर्णुते दाशुषे वार्याणि॥
verses.tr: ā no devaḥ savitā trāyamāṇo hiraṇyapāṇiryajato jagamyāt yo datravāṃ uṣaso na pratīkaṃ vyūrṇute dāśuṣe vāryāṇi
verses.en: May Savitar come hither and approach us, the God who rescues, Holy, goldenhanded, The God who, bounteous as the face of Morning, discloses precious gifts for him who worships.

verses.sa:
उत त्वं सूनो सहसो नो अद्या देवाँ अस्मिन्नध्वरे ववृत्याः ।
स्यामहं ते सदमिद्रातौ तव स्यामग्नेऽवसा सुवीरः॥
verses.tr: uta tvaṃ sūno sahaso no adyā devāṃ asminnadhvare vavṛtyāḥ syāmahaṃ te sadamidrātau tava syāmagne'vasā suvīraḥ
verses.en: And thou, O Son of Strength, do thou turn hither the Gods to-day to this our holy service. May I for evermore enjoy thy bounty and, Agni, by thy grace be rich in heroes.

verses.sa:
उत त्या मे हवमा जग्म्यातं नासत्या धीभिर्युवमङ्ग विप्रा ।
अत्रिं न महस्तमसोऽमुमुक्तं तूर्वतं नरा दुरितादभीके॥
verses.tr: uta tyā me havamā jagmyātaṃ nāsatyā dhībhiryuvamaṅga viprā atriṃ na mahastamaso'mumuktaṃ tūrvataṃ narā duritādabhīke
verses.en: Come also to my call, O ye Nasatyas, yea, verily, through my prayers, ye Holy Sages. As from great darkness ye delivered Atri, protect us, Chiefs, from danger in the conflict.

verses.sa:
ते नो रायो द्युमतो वाजवतो दातारो भूत नृवतः पुरुक्षोः ।
दशस्यन्तो दिव्याः पार्थिवासो गोजाता अप्या मृळता च देवाः॥
verses.tr: te no rāyo dyumato vājavato dātāro bhūta nṛvataḥ purukṣoḥ daśasyanto divyāḥ pārthivāso gojātā apyā mṛḻatā ca devāḥ
verses.en: O Gods, bestow upon us riches, splendid with strength and heroes, bringing food in plenty. Be gracious, helpful Gods of earth, of heaven, born of the Cow, and dwellers in the waters.

verses.sa:
ते नो रुद्रः सरस्वती सजोषा मीळ्हुष्मन्तो विष्णुर्मृळन्तु वायुः ।
ऋभुक्षा वाजो दैव्यो विधाता पर्जन्यावाता पिप्यतामिषं नः॥
verses.tr: te no rudraḥ sarasvatī sajoṣā mīḻhuṣmanto viṣṇurmṛḻantu vāyuḥ ṛbhukṣā vājo daivyo vidhātā parjanyāvātā pipyatāmiṣaṃ naḥ
verses.en: May Rudra and Sarasvati, accordant, Visnu and Vayu, pour down gifts and bless us; Rbhuksan, Vaja, and divine Vidhatar, Parjanya, Vata make our food abundant.

verses.sa:
उत स्य देवः सविता भगो नोऽपां नपादवतु दानु पप्रिः ।
त्वष्टा देवेभिर्जनिभिः सजोषा द्यौर्देवेभिः पृथिवी समुद्रैः॥
verses.tr: uta sya devaḥ savitā bhago no'pāṃ napādavatu dānu papriḥ tvaṣṭā devebhirjanibhiḥ sajoṣā dyaurdevebhiḥ pṛthivī samudraiḥ
verses.en: May this God Savitar, the Lord, the Offspring of Waters, pouring down his dew be gracious, And, with the Gods and Dames accordant, Tvastar; Dyaus with the Gods and Prthivi with oceans.

verses.sa:
उत नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यः शृणोत्वज एकपात्पृथिवी समुद्रः ।
विश्वे देवा ऋतावृधो हुवानाः स्तुता मन्त्राः कविशस्ता अवन्तु॥
verses.tr: uta no'hirbudhnyaḥ śṛṇotvaja ekapātpṛthivī samudraḥ viśve devā ṛtāvṛdho huvānāḥ stutā mantrāḥ kaviśastā avantu
verses.en: May Aja-Ekapad and Ahibudhnya, and Earth and Ocean hear our invocation; All Gods who strengthen Law, invoked and lauded, and holy texts uttered by sages, help us.

verses.sa:
एवा नपातो मम तस्य धीभिर्भरद्वाजा अभ्यर्चन्त्यर्कैः ।
ग्ना हुतासो वसवोऽधृष्टा विश्वे स्तुतासो भूता यजत्राः॥
verses.tr: evā napāto mama tasya dhībhirbharadvājā abhyarcantyarkaiḥ gnā hutāso vasavo'dhṛṣṭā viśve stutāso bhūtā yajatrāḥ
verses.en: So with my thoughts and hymns of praise the children of Bharadvaja sing aloud to please you. The Dames invoked, and the resistless Vasus, and all ye Holy Ones have been exalted.

verses.sa:
उदु त्यच्चक्षुर्महि मित्रयोराँ एति प्रियं वरुणयोरदब्धम् ।
ऋतस्य शुचि दर्शतमनीकं रुक्मो न दिव उदिता व्यद्यौत्॥
verses.tr: udu tyaccakṣurmahi mitrayorāṃ eti priyaṃ varuṇayoradabdham ṛtasya śuci darśatamanīkaṃ rukmo na diva uditā vyadyaut
verses.en: That mighty eye of Varuna and Mitra, infallible and dear, is moving upward. The pure and lovely face of holy Order hath shone like gold of heaven in its arising.

verses.sa:
वेद यस्त्रीणि विदथान्येषां देवानां जन्म सनुतरा च विप्रः ।
ऋजु मर्तेषु वृजिना च पश्यन्नभि चष्टे सूरो अर्य एवान्॥
verses.tr: veda yastrīṇi vidathānyeṣāṃ devānāṃ janma sanutarā ca vipraḥ ṛju marteṣu vṛjinā ca paśyannabhi caṣṭe sūro arya evān
verses.en: The Sage who knows these Gods' three ranks and orders, and all their generations near and distant, Beholding good and evil acts of mortals, Sura marks well the doing of the pious.

verses.sa:
स्तुष उ वो मह ऋतस्य गोपानदितिं मित्रं वरुणं सुजातान् ।
अर्यमणं भगमदब्धधीतीनच्छा वोचे सधन्यः पावकान्॥
verses.tr: stuṣa u vo maha ṛtasya gopānaditiṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sujātān aryamaṇaṃ bhagamadabdhadhītīnacchā voce sadhanyaḥ pāvakān
verses.en: I praise you Guards of mighty Law eternal, Aditi, Mitra, Varuna, the noble, Aryaman, Bhaga, all whose thoughts are faithful: hither I call the Bright who share in common.

verses.sa:
रिशादसः सत्पतीँरदब्धान्महो राज्ञः सुवसनस्य दातॄन् ।
यूनः सुक्षत्रान्क्षयतो दिवो नॄनादित्यान्याम्यदितिं दुवोयु॥
verses.tr: riśādasaḥ satpatīṃradabdhānmaho rājñaḥ suvasanasya dātṝn yūnaḥ sukṣatrānkṣayato divo nṝnādityānyāmyaditiṃ duvoyu
verses.en: Lords of the brave, infallible, foe-destroyers, great Kings, bestowers of fair homes to dwell in, Young, Heroes, ruling heaven with strong dominion, Adityas, Aditi I seek with worship.

verses.sa:
द्यौ३ष्पितः पृथिवि मातरध्रुगग्ने भ्रातर्वसवो मृळता नः ।
विश्व आदित्या अदिते सजोषा अस्मभ्यं शर्म बहुलं वि यन्त॥
verses.tr: dyau3ṣpitaḥ pṛthivi mātaradhrugagne bhrātarvasavo mṛḻatā naḥ viśva ādityā adite sajoṣā asmabhyaṃ śarma bahulaṃ vi yanta
verses.en: O Heaven our Father, Earth our guileless Mother, O Brother Agni, and ye Vasus, bless us. Grant us, O Aditi and ye Adityas, all of one mind, your manifold protection.

verses.sa:
मा नो वृकाय वृक्ये समस्मा अघायते रीरधता यजत्राः ।
यूयं हि ष्ठा रथ्यो नस्तनूनां यूयं दक्षस्य वचसो बभूव॥
verses.tr: mā no vṛkāya vṛkye samasmā aghāyate rīradhatā yajatrāḥ yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā rathyo nastanūnāṃ yūyaṃ dakṣasya vacaso babhūva
verses.en: Give us not up to any evil creature, as spoil to wolf or she-wolf, O ye Holy. For ye are they who guide aright our bodies, ye are the rulers of our speech and vigour.

verses.sa:
मा व एनो अन्यकृतं भुजेम मा तत्कर्म वसवो यच्चयध्वे ।
विश्वस्य हि क्षयथ विश्वदेवाः स्वयं रिपुस्तन्वं रीरिषीष्ट॥
verses.tr: mā va eno anyakṛtaṃ bhujema mā tatkarma vasavo yaccayadhve viśvasya hi kṣayatha viśvadevāḥ svayaṃ ripustanvaṃ rīriṣīṣṭa
verses.en: Let us not suffer for the sin of others, nor do the deed which ye, O Vasus, punish. Ye, Universal Gods! are all-controllers: may he do harm unto himself who hates Me.

verses.sa:
नम इदुग्रं नम आ विवासे नमो दाधार पृथिवीमुत द्याम् ।
नमो देवेभ्यो नम ईश एषां कृतं चिदेनो नमसा विवासे॥
verses.tr: nama idugraṃ nama ā vivāse namo dādhāra pṛthivīmuta dyām namo devebhyo nama īśa eṣāṃ kṛtaṃ cideno namasā vivāse
verses.en: Mighty is homage: I adopt and use it. Homage hath held in place the earth and heaven. Homage to Gods! Homage commands and rules them. I banish even committed sin by homage

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य वो रथ्यः पूतदक्षानृतस्य पस्त्यसदो अदब्धान् ।
ताँ आ नमोभिरुरुचक्षसो नॄन्विश्वान्व आ नमे महो यजत्राः॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya vo rathyaḥ pūtadakṣānṛtasya pastyasado adabdhān tāṃ ā namobhirurucakṣaso nṝnviśvānva ā name maho yajatrāḥ
verses.en: You Furtherers of Law, pure in your spirit, infallible, dwellers in the home of Order, To you all Heroes mighty and far-seeing I bow me down, O Holy Ones, with homage.

verses.sa:
ते हि श्रेष्ठवर्चसस्त उ नस्तिरो विश्वानि दुरिता नयन्ति ।
सुक्षत्रासो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निॠतधीतयो वक्मराजसत्याः॥
verses.tr: te hi śreṣṭhavarcasasta u nastiro viśvāni duritā nayanti sukṣatrāso varuṇo mitro agniṝtadhītayo vakmarājasatyāḥ
verses.en: For these are they who shine with noblest splendour; through all our troubles these conduct us safely- Varuna, Mitra, Agni, mighty Rulers, trueminded, faithful to the hymn's controllers.

verses.sa:
ते न इन्द्रः पृथिवी क्षाम वर्धन्पूषा भगो अदितिः पञ्च जनाः ।
सुशर्माणः स्ववसः सुनीथा भवन्तु नः सुत्रात्रासः सुगोपाः॥
verses.tr: te na indraḥ pṛthivī kṣāma vardhanpūṣā bhago aditiḥ pañca janāḥ suśarmāṇaḥ svavasaḥ sunīthā bhavantu naḥ sutrātrāsaḥ sugopāḥ
verses.en: May they, Earth, Aditi, Indra, Bhaga, Pusan increase our laud, increase the Fivefold people. Giving good help, good refuge, goodly guidance, be they our good deliverers, good protectors.

verses.sa:
नू सद्मानं दिव्यं नंशि देवा भारद्वाजः सुमतिं याति होता ।
आसानेभिर्यजमानो मियेधैर्देवानां जन्म वसूयुर्ववन्द॥
verses.tr: nū sadmānaṃ divyaṃ naṃśi devā bhāradvājaḥ sumatiṃ yāti hotā āsānebhiryajamāno miyedhairdevānāṃ janma vasūyurvavanda
verses.en: Come now, O Gods, to your celestial station: the Bharadvajas' priest entreats your favour. He, sacrificing, fain for wealth, hath honoured the Gods vath those who sit and share oblations.

verses.sa: अप त्यं वृजिनं रिपुं स्तेनमग्ने दुराध्यम् । दविष्ठमस्य सत्पते कृधी सुगम्॥
verses.tr: apa tyaṃ vṛjinaṃ ripuṃ stenamagne durādhyam daviṣṭhamasya satpate kṛdhī sugam
verses.en: Agni, drive thou the wicked foe, the evil-hearted thief away, Far, far, Lord of the brave I and give us easy paths.

verses.sa: ग्रावाणः सोम नो हि कं सखित्वनाय वावशुः । जही न्य१त्रिणं पणिं वृको हि षः॥
verses.tr: grāvāṇaḥ soma no hi kaṃ sakhitvanāya vāvaśuḥ jahī nya1triṇaṃ paṇiṃ vṛko hi ṣaḥ
verses.en: Soma, these pressing-stones have called aloud to win thee for our Friend. Destroy the greedy Pani, for a wolf is he.

verses.sa: यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानव इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अभिद्यवः । कर्ता नो अध्वन्ना सुगं गोपा अमा॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānava indrajyeṣṭhā abhidyavaḥ kartā no adhvannā sugaṃ gopā amā
verses.en: Ye, O most bountiful, are they who, led by Indra, seek the sky. Give us good paths for travel: guard us ivell at home.

verses.sa: अपि पन्थामगन्महि स्वस्तिगामनेहसम् । येन विश्वाः परि द्विषो वृणक्ति विन्दते वसु॥
verses.tr: api panthāmaganmahi svastigāmanehasam yena viśvāḥ pari dviṣo vṛṇakti vindate vasu
verses.en: Now have we entered on the road that leads to bliss, without a foe, The road whereon a man escapes all enemies and gathers wealth.

verses.sa:
न तद्दिवा न पृथिव्यानु मन्ये न यज्ञेन नोत शमीभिराभिः ।
उब्जन्तु तं सुभ्व१ः पर्वतासो नि हीयतामतियाजस्य यष्टा॥
verses.tr: na taddivā na pṛthivyānu manye na yajñena nota śamībhirābhiḥ ubjantu taṃ subhva1ḥ parvatāso ni hīyatāmatiyājasya yaṣṭā
verses.en: This I allow not in the earth or heaven, at sacrifice or in these holy duties. May the huge mountains crush him down: degraded be Atiyaja's sacrificing patron.

verses.sa:
अति वा यो मरुतो मन्यते नो ब्रह्म वा यः क्रियमाणं निनित्सात् ।
तपूंषि तस्मै वृजिनानि सन्तु ब्रह्मद्विषमभि तं शोचतु द्यौः॥
verses.tr: ati vā yo maruto manyate no brahma vā yaḥ kriyamāṇaṃ ninitsāt tapūṃṣi tasmai vṛjināni santu brahmadviṣamabhi taṃ śocatu dyauḥ
verses.en: Or he who holds us in contempt, O Maruts, or seeks to blame the prayer that we are making, May agonies of burning be his portion. May the sky scorch the man who hates devotion.

verses.sa:
किमङ्ग त्वा ब्रह्मणः सोम गोपां किमङ्ग त्वाहुरभिशस्तिपां नः ।
किमङ्ग नः पश्यसि निद्यमानान्ब्रह्मद्विषे तपुषिं हेतिमस्य॥
verses.tr: kimaṅga tvā brahmaṇaḥ soma gopāṃ kimaṅga tvāhurabhiśastipāṃ naḥ kimaṅga naḥ paśyasi nidyamānānbrahmadviṣe tapuṣiṃ hetimasya
verses.en: Why then, O Soma, do they call thee keeper of prayer? Why then our guardian from reproaches? Why then beholdest thou how men revile us? Cast thy hot dart at him who hates devotion.

verses.sa:
अवन्तु मामुषसो जायमाना अवन्तु मा सिन्धवः पिन्वमानाः ।
अवन्तु मा पर्वतासो ध्रुवासोऽवन्तु मा पितरो देवहूतौ॥
verses.tr: avantu māmuṣaso jāyamānā avantu mā sindhavaḥ pinvamānāḥ avantu mā parvatāso dhruvāso'vantu mā pitaro devahūtau
verses.en: May Mornings as they spring to life, protect me, and may the Rivers as they swell preserve me. My guardians be the firmly-seated mountains: the Fathers, when I call on Gods, defend me!

verses.sa:
विश्वदानीं सुमनसः स्याम पश्येम नु सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम् ।
तथा करद्वसुपतिर्वसूनां देवाँ ओहानोऽवसागमिष्ठः॥
verses.tr: viśvadānīṃ sumanasaḥ syāma paśyema nu sūryamuccarantam tathā karadvasupatirvasūnāṃ devāṃ ohāno'vasāgamiṣṭhaḥ
verses.en: Through all our days may we be healthy. minded, and look upon the Sun when he arises. Grant this the Treasure-Lord of treasures, coming, observant, oftenest of Gods, with succour!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो नेदिष्ठमवसागमिष्ठः सरस्वती सिन्धुभिः पिन्वमाना ।
पर्जन्यो न ओषधीभिर्मयोभुरग्निः सुशंसः सुहवः पितेव॥
verses.tr: indro nediṣṭhamavasāgamiṣṭhaḥ sarasvatī sindhubhiḥ pinvamānā parjanyo na oṣadhībhirmayobhuragniḥ suśaṃsaḥ suhavaḥ piteva
verses.en: Most near, most oft comes Indra with protection, and she Sarasvati, who swells with rivers - Parjanya, bringing health with herbs, and Agni, well lauded swift to listen, like a father.

verses.sa: विश्वे देवास आ गत शृणुता म इमं हवम् । एदं बर्हिर्नि षीदत॥
verses.tr: viśve devāsa ā gata śṛṇutā ma imaṃ havam edaṃ barhirni ṣīdata
verses.en: Hear this mine invocation; come hither, O Universal Gods, Be seated on this holy grass.

verses.sa: यो वो देवा घृतस्नुना हव्येन प्रतिभूषति । तं विश्व उप गच्छथ॥
verses.tr: yo vo devā ghṛtasnunā havyena pratibhūṣati taṃ viśva upa gacchatha
verses.en: To him who comes to meet you, Gods, with offerings bathed in holy oil- Approach ye, one and all, to him.

verses.sa: उप नः सूनवो गिरः शृण्वन्त्वमृतस्य ये । सुमृळीका भवन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: upa naḥ sūnavo giraḥ śṛṇvantvamṛtasya ye sumṛḻīkā bhavantu naḥ
verses.en: All Sons of Immortality shall listen to the songs we sing, And be exceeding good to us.

verses.sa: विश्वे देवा ऋतावृध ऋतुभिर्हवनश्रुतः । जुषन्तां  युज्यं पयः॥
verses.tr: viśve devā ṛtāvṛdha ṛtubhirhavanaśrutaḥ juṣantāṃ yujyaṃ payaḥ
verses.en: May all the Gods who strengthen Law, with Rtus, listening to our call, Be pleased with theit appropriate draught.

verses.sa: स्तोत्रमिन्द्रो मरुद्गणस्त्वष्टृमान्मित्रो अर्यमा । इमा हव्या जुषन्त नः॥
verses.tr: stotramindro marudgaṇastvaṣṭṛmānmitro aryamā imā havyā juṣanta naḥ
verses.en: May 1ndra, with the Marut host, with Tvastar, Mitra, Aryaman, Accept the laud and these our gifts.

verses.sa: इमं नो अग्ने अध्वरं होतर्वयुनशो यज । चिकित्वान्दैव्यं जनम्॥
verses.tr: imaṃ no agne adhvaraṃ hotarvayunaśo yaja cikitvāndaivyaṃ janam
verses.en: O Agni, Priest, as rules ordain, offer this sacrifice of ours, Remembering the Heavenly Folk.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवाः शृणुतेमं हवं मे ये अन्तरिक्षे य उप द्यवि ष्ठ ।
ये अग्निजिह्वा उत वा यजत्रा आसद्यास्मिन्बर्हिषि मादयध्वम्॥
verses.tr: viśve devāḥ śṛṇutemaṃ havaṃ me ye antarikṣe ya upa dyavi ṣṭha ye agnijihvā uta vā yajatrā āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayadhvam
verses.en: Listen, All-Gods, to this mine invocation, Ye who inhabit heaven, and air's midregions, All ye, O Holy Ones, whose tongue is Agni, seated upon this sacred grass, be joyful.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवा मम शृण्वन्तु यज्ञिया उभे रोदसी अपां नपाच्च मन्म ।
मा वो वचांसि परिचक्ष्याणि वोचं सुम्नेष्विद्वो अन्तमा मदेम॥
verses.tr: viśve devā mama śṛṇvantu yajñiyā ubhe rodasī apāṃ napācca manma mā vo vacāṃsi paricakṣyāṇi vocaṃ sumneṣvidvo antamā madema
verses.en: May the All-Gods who claim our worship hear my thought; may the two World-halves hear it, and the Waters' Child. Let me not utter words that ye may disregard. Closely allied with you may we rejoice in bliss.

verses.sa:
ये के च ज्मा महिनो अहिमाया दिवो जज्ञिरे अपां सधस्थे ।
ते अस्मभ्यमिषये विश्वमायुः क्षप उस्रा वरिवस्यन्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: ye ke ca jmā mahino ahimāyā divo jajñire apāṃ sadhasthe te asmabhyamiṣaye viśvamāyuḥ kṣapa usrā varivasyantu devāḥ
verses.en: And those who, Mighty, with the wiles of serpents, were born on earth, in heaven, where waters gather- May they vouchsafe us life of full duration. May the Gods kindly give us nights and mornings.

verses.sa:
अग्नीपर्जन्याववतं धियं मेऽस्मिन्हवे सुहवा सुष्टुतिं नः ।
इळामन्यो जनयद्गर्भमन्यः प्रजावतीरिष आ धत्तमस्मे॥
verses.tr: agnīparjanyāvavataṃ dhiyaṃ me'sminhave suhavā suṣṭutiṃ naḥ iḻāmanyo janayadgarbhamanyaḥ prajāvatīriṣa ā dhattamasme
verses.en: At this my call, O Agni and Parjanya, help, swift to hear, my thought and our laudation. One generates holy food, the other offspring, so grant us food enough with store of children.

verses.sa:
स्तीर्णे बर्हिषि समिधाने अग्नौ सूक्तेन महा नमसा विवासे ।
अस्मिन्नो अद्य विदथे यजत्रा विश्वे देवा हविषि मादयध्वम्॥
verses.tr: stīrṇe barhiṣi samidhāne agnau sūktena mahā namasā vivāse asminno adya vidathe yajatrā viśve devā haviṣi mādayadhvam
verses.en: When holy grass is strewn and fire enkindled, with hymn and lowly homage I invite you. All-Gods, to day in this our great assembly rejoice, ye Holy, in the gifts we offer.

verses.sa: वयमु त्वा पथस्पते रथं न वाजसातये । धिये पूषन्नयुज्महि॥
verses.tr: vayamu tvā pathaspate rathaṃ na vājasātaye dhiye pūṣannayujmahi
verses.en: Lord of the path, O Pusan, we have yoked and bound thee to our hymn, Even as a car, to win the prize.

verses.sa: अभि नो नर्यं वसु वीरं प्रयतदक्षिणम् । वामं गृहपतिं नय॥
verses.tr: abhi no naryaṃ vasu vīraṃ prayatadakṣiṇam vāmaṃ gṛhapatiṃ naya
verses.en: Bring us the wealth that men require, a manly master of a house, Free-handed with the liberal meed.

verses.sa: अदित्सन्तं चिदाघृणे पूषन्दानाय चोदय । पणेश्चिद्वि म्रदा मनः॥
verses.tr: aditsantaṃ cidāghṛṇe pūṣandānāya codaya paṇeścidvi mradā manaḥ
verses.en: Even him who would not give, do thou, O glowing Pusan, urge to give, And make the niggard's soul grow soft.

verses.sa: वि पथो वाजसातये चिनुहि वि मृधो जहि । साधन्तामुग्र नो धियः॥
verses.tr: vi patho vājasātaye cinuhi vi mṛdho jahi sādhantāmugra no dhiyaḥ
verses.en: Clear paths that we may win the prize; scatter our enemies afar. Strong God, be all our thoughts fulfilled.

verses.sa: परि तृन्धि पणीनामारया हृदया कवे । अथेमस्मभ्यं रन्धय॥
verses.tr: pari tṛndhi paṇīnāmārayā hṛdayā kave athemasmabhyaṃ randhaya
verses.en: Penetrate with an awl, O Sage, the hearts of avaricious churls, And make them subject to our will.

verses.sa: वि पूषन्नारया तुद पणेरिच्छ हृदि प्रियम् । अथेमस्मभ्यं रन्धय॥
verses.tr: vi pūṣannārayā tuda paṇericcha hṛdi priyam athemasmabhyaṃ randhaya
verses.en: Thrust with thine awl, O Pusan: seek that which the niggard's heart holds dear, And make him subject to our will.

verses.sa: आ रिख किकिरा कृणु पणीनां हृदया कवे । अथेमस्मभ्यं रन्धय॥
verses.tr: ā rikha kikirā kṛṇu paṇīnāṃ hṛdayā kave athemasmabhyaṃ randhaya
verses.en: Tear up and read in pieces, Sage, the hearts of avaricious churls, And make them subject to our will.

verses.sa: यां पूषन्ब्रह्मचोदनीमारां बिभर्ष्याघृणे । तया समस्य हृदयमा रिख किकिरा कृणु॥
verses.tr: yāṃ pūṣanbrahmacodanīmārāṃ bibharṣyāghṛṇe tayā samasya hṛdayamā rikha kikirā kṛṇu
verses.en: Thou, glowing Pusan, carriest an awl that urges men to prayer; Therewith do thou tear up and rend to shreds the heart of every one.

verses.sa: या ते अष्ट्रा गोओपशाऽऽघृणे पशुसाधनी । तस्यास्ते सुम्नमीमहे॥
verses.tr: yā te aṣṭrā goopaśā''ghṛṇe paśusādhanī tasyāste sumnamīmahe
verses.en: Thou bearest, glowing Lord! a goad with horny point that guides the cows Thence do we seek thy gift of bliss.

verses.sa: उत नो गोषणिं धियमश्वसां वाजसामुत । नृवत्कृणुहि वीतये॥
verses.tr: uta no goṣaṇiṃ dhiyamaśvasāṃ vājasāmuta nṛvatkṛṇuhi vītaye
verses.en: And make this hymn of ours produce kine, horses, and a store of wealth For our delight and use as men.

verses.sa: सं पूषन्विदुषा नय यो अञ्जसानुशासति । य एवेदमिति ब्रवत्॥
verses.tr: saṃ pūṣanviduṣā naya yo añjasānuśāsati ya evedamiti bravat
verses.en: O PUSAN, bring us to the man who knows, who shall direct us straight, And say unto us, It is here.

verses.sa: समु पूष्णा गमेमहि यो गृहाँ अभिशासति । इम एवेति च ब्रवत्॥
verses.tr: samu pūṣṇā gamemahi yo gṛhāṃ abhiśāsati ima eveti ca bravat
verses.en: May we go forth with Pusan who shall point the houses out to us, And say to us, These same are they.

verses.sa: पूष्णश्चक्रं न रिष्यति न कोशोऽव पद्यते । नो अस्य व्यथते पविः॥
verses.tr: pūṣṇaścakraṃ na riṣyati na kośo'va padyate no asya vyathate paviḥ
verses.en: Unharmed is Pusan's chariot wheel; the box ne'er falleth to the ground, Nor doth the loosened felIy shake.

verses.sa: यो अस्मै हविषाविधन्न तं पूषापि मृष्यते । प्रथमो विन्दते वसु॥
verses.tr: yo asmai haviṣāvidhanna taṃ pūṣāpi mṛṣyate prathamo vindate vasu
verses.en: Pusan forgetteth not the man who serveth him with offered gift: That man is first to gather wealth.

verses.sa: पूषा गा अन्वेतु नः पूषा रक्षत्वर्वतः । पूषा वाजं सनोतु नः॥
verses.tr: pūṣā gā anvetu naḥ pūṣā rakṣatvarvataḥ pūṣā vājaṃ sanotu naḥ
verses.en: May Pusan follow near our kine; may Pusan keep our horses safe: May Pusan gather gear for us.

verses.sa: पूषन्ननु प्र गा इहि यजमानस्य सुन्वतः । अस्माकं स्तुवतामुत॥
verses.tr: pūṣannanu pra gā ihi yajamānasya sunvataḥ asmākaṃ stuvatāmuta
verses.en: Follow the kine of him who pours libations out and worships thee; And ours who sing thee songs of praise.

verses.sa: माकिर्नेशन्माकीं रिषन्माकीं सं शारि केवटे । अथारिष्टाभिरा गहि॥
verses.tr: mākirneśanmākīṃ riṣanmākīṃ saṃ śāri kevaṭe athāriṣṭābhirā gahi
verses.en: Let none be lost, none injured, none sink in a pit and break a limb. Return with these all safe and sound.

verses.sa: शृण्वन्तं पूषणं वयमिर्यमनष्टवेदसम् । ईशानं राय ईमहे॥
verses.tr: śṛṇvantaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ vayamiryamanaṣṭavedasam īśānaṃ rāya īmahe
verses.en: Pusan who listens to our prayers, the Strong whose wealth is never lost, The Lord of riches, we implore.

verses.sa: पूषन्तव व्रते वयं न रिष्येम कदा चन । स्तोतारस्त इह स्मसि॥
verses.tr: pūṣantava vrate vayaṃ na riṣyema kadā cana stotārasta iha smasi
verses.en: Secure in thy protecting care, O Pusan, never may we fail. We here are they who sing thy praise.

verses.sa: परि पूषा परस्ताद्धस्तं दधातु दक्षिणम् । पुनर्नो नष्टमाजतु॥
verses.tr: pari pūṣā parastāddhastaṃ dadhātu dakṣiṇam punarno naṣṭamājatu
verses.en: From out the distance, far and wide, may Pusan stretch his right hand forth, And drive our lost again to us.

verses.sa: एहि वां विमुचो नपादाघृणे सं सचावहै । रथीॠतस्य नो भव॥
verses.tr: ehi vāṃ vimuco napādāghṛṇe saṃ sacāvahai rathīṝtasya no bhava
verses.en: Son of Deliverance, come, bright God! Let us twain go together: be our charioteer of sacrifice.

verses.sa: रथीतमं कपर्दिनमीशानं राधसो महः । रायः सखायमीमहे॥
verses.tr: rathītamaṃ kapardinamīśānaṃ rādhaso mahaḥ rāyaḥ sakhāyamīmahe
verses.en: We pray for wealth to thee most skilled of charioteers, with braided hair, Lord of great riches, and our Friend.

verses.sa: रायो धारास्याघृणे वसो राशिरजाश्व । धीवतोधीवतः सखा॥
verses.tr: rāyo dhārāsyāghṛṇe vaso rāśirajāśva dhīvatodhīvataḥ sakhā
verses.en: Bright God whose steeds are goats, thou art a stream of wealth, a treasure-heap, The Friend of every pious man.

verses.sa: पूषणं न्व१जाश्वमुप स्तोषाम वाजिनम् । स्वसुर्यो जार उच्यते॥
verses.tr: pūṣaṇaṃ nva1jāśvamupa stoṣāma vājinam svasuryo jāra ucyate
verses.en: Pusan, who driveth goats for steeds, the strong and Mighty, who is called His Sister's lover, will we laud.

verses.sa: मातुर्दिधिषुमब्रवं स्वसुर्जारः शृणोतु नः । भ्रातेन्द्रस्य सखा मम॥
verses.tr: māturdidhiṣumabravaṃ svasurjāraḥ śṛṇotu naḥ bhrātendrasya sakhā mama
verses.en: His Mother's suitor I address. May he who loves his Sister hear, Brother of Indra, and my Friend.

verses.sa: आजासः पूषणं रथे निशृम्भास्ते जनश्रियम् । देवं वहन्तु बिभ्रतः॥
verses.tr: ājāsaḥ pūṣaṇaṃ rathe niśṛmbhāste janaśriyam devaṃ vahantu bibhrataḥ
verses.en: May the sure-footed goats come nigh, conveying Pusan on his car, The God who visiteth mankind.

verses.sa: य एनमादिदेशति करम्भादिति पूषणम् । न तेन देव आदिशे॥
verses.tr: ya enamādideśati karambhāditi pūṣaṇam na tena deva ādiśe
verses.en: Whoso remembers Pusan as cater of mingled curd and meal Need think no more upon the God.

verses.sa: उत घा स रथीतमः सख्या सत्पतिर्युजा । इन्द्रो वृत्राणि जिघ्नते॥
verses.tr: uta ghā sa rathītamaḥ sakhyā satpatiryujā indro vṛtrāṇi jighnate
verses.en: And he is best of charioteers. Indra, the hero's Lord, allied With him as Friend, destroys the foes.

verses.sa: उतादः परुषे गवि सूरश्चक्रं हिरण्ययम् । न्यैरयद्रथीतमः॥
verses.tr: utādaḥ paruṣe gavi sūraścakraṃ hiraṇyayam nyairayadrathītamaḥ
verses.en: And there the best of charioteers hath guided through the speckled cloud The golden wheel of Sura's car.

verses.sa: यदद्य त्वा पुरुष्टुत ब्रवाम दस्र मन्तुमः । तत्सु नो मन्म साधय॥
verses.tr: yadadya tvā puruṣṭuta bravāma dasra mantumaḥ tatsu no manma sādhaya
verses.en: Whate'er we speak this day to thee, Wise, Wondrous God whom many praise, Give thou fulfilment of our thought.

verses.sa: इमं च नो गवेषणं सातये सीषधो गणम् । आरात्पूषन्नसि श्रुतः॥
verses.tr: imaṃ ca no gaveṣaṇaṃ sātaye sīṣadho gaṇam ārātpūṣannasi śrutaḥ
verses.en: Lead on this company of ours, that longs for kine, to win the spoil: Thou, Pusan, art renowned afar.

verses.sa: आ ते स्वस्तिमीमह आरेअघामुपावसुम् । अद्या च सर्वतातये श्वश्च सर्वतातये॥
verses.tr: ā te svastimīmaha āreaghāmupāvasum adyā ca sarvatātaye śvaśca sarvatātaye
verses.en: Prosperity we crave from thee, afar from sin and near to wealth, Tending to perfect happiness both for to. morrow and to-day.

verses.sa: इन्द्रा नु पूषणा वयं सख्याय स्वस्तये । हुवेम वाजसातये॥
verses.tr: indrā nu pūṣaṇā vayaṃ sakhyāya svastaye huvema vājasātaye
verses.en: Indra and Pusan will we call for friend ship and prosperity And for the winning of the spoil.

verses.sa: सोममन्य उपासदत्पातवे चम्वोः सुतम् । करम्भमन्य इच्छति॥
verses.tr: somamanya upāsadatpātave camvoḥ sutam karambhamanya icchati
verses.en: One by the Soma sits to drink juice which the mortar hath expressed: The other longs for curd and meal.

verses.sa: अजा अन्यस्य वह्नयो हरी अन्यस्य सम्भृता । ताभ्यां वृत्राणि जिघ्नते॥
verses.tr: ajā anyasya vahnayo harī anyasya sambhṛtā tābhyāṃ vṛtrāṇi jighnate
verses.en: Goats are the team that draws the one: the other hath Bay Steeds at hand; With both of these he slays the fiends.

verses.sa: यदिन्द्रो अनयद्रितो महीरपो वृषन्तमः । तत्र पूषाभवत्सचा॥
