verses.tr: yadindro anayadrito mahīrapo vṛṣantamaḥ tatra pūṣābhavatsacā
verses.en: When Indra, wondrous strong, brought down the streams, the mighty waterfloods, Pusan was standing by his side.

verses.sa: तां पूष्णः सुमतिं वयं वृक्षस्य प्र वयामिव । इन्द्रस्य चा रभामहे॥
verses.tr: tāṃ pūṣṇaḥ sumatiṃ vayaṃ vṛkṣasya pra vayāmiva indrasya cā rabhāmahe
verses.en: To this, to Pusan's favouring love, and Indra's, may we closely cling, As to a tree's extended bough.

verses.sa: उत्पूषणं युवामहेऽभीशूँरिव सारथिः । मह्या इन्द्रं स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: utpūṣaṇaṃ yuvāmahe'bhīśūṃriva sārathiḥ mahyā indraṃ svastaye
verses.en: As one who drives a car draws in his reins, may we draw Pusan near, And Indra, for our great success.

verses.sa:
शुक्रं ते अन्यद्यजतं ते अन्यद्विषुरूपे अहनी द्यौरिवासि ।
विश्वा हि माया अवसि स्वधावो भद्रा ते पूषन्निह रातिरस्तु॥
verses.tr: śukraṃ te anyadyajataṃ te anyadviṣurūpe ahanī dyaurivāsi viśvā hi māyā avasi svadhāvo bhadrā te pūṣanniha rātirastu
verses.en: Like heaven art thou: one form is bright, one holy, like Day and Night dissimilar in colour. All magic powers thou aidest, self-depen. dent! Auspicious be thy bounty here, O Pusan.

verses.sa:
अजाश्वः पशुपा वाजपस्त्यो धियंजिन्वो भुवने विश्वे अर्पितः ।
अष्ट्रां पूषा शिथिरामुद्वरीवृजत्संचक्षाणो भुवना देव ईयते॥
verses.tr: ajāśvaḥ paśupā vājapastyo dhiyaṃjinvo bhuvane viśve arpitaḥ aṣṭrāṃ pūṣā śithirāmudvarīvṛjatsaṃcakṣāṇo bhuvanā deva īyate
verses.en: Goat-borne, the guard of cattle, he whose home is strength, inspirer of the hymn, set over all the world; Brandishing here and there his lightly. moving goad, beholding every creature, Pusan, God, goes forth.

verses.sa:
यास्ते पूषन्नावो अन्तः समुद्रे हिरण्ययीरन्तरिक्षे चरन्ति ।
ताभिर्यासि दूत्यां सूर्यस्य कामेन कृत श्रव इच्छमानः॥
verses.tr: yāste pūṣannāvo antaḥ samudre hiraṇyayīrantarikṣe caranti tābhiryāsi dūtyāṃ sūryasya kāmena kṛta śrava icchamānaḥ
verses.en: O Pusan, with thy golden ships that travel across the ocean, in the air's mid-region, Thou goest on an embassy to Surya, subdued by love, desirous of the glory.

verses.sa:
पूषा सुबन्धुर्दिव आ पृथिव्या इळस्पतिर्मघवा दस्मवर्चाः ।
यं देवासो अददुः सूर्यायै कामेन कृतं तवसं स्वञ्चम्॥
verses.tr: pūṣā subandhurdiva ā pṛthivyā iḻaspatirmaghavā dasmavarcāḥ yaṃ devāso adaduḥ sūryāyai kāmena kṛtaṃ tavasaṃ svañcam
verses.en: Near kinsman of the heaven and earth is Pusan, liberal, Lord of food, of wondrous iustre, Whom strong and vigorous and swiftlymoving, subdued by love, the Deities gave to Surya.

verses.sa:
प्र नु वोचा सुतेषु वां वीर्या३ यानि चक्रथुः ।
हतासो वां पितरो देवशत्रव इन्द्राग्नी जीवथो युवम्॥
verses.tr: pra nu vocā suteṣu vāṃ vīryā3 yāni cakrathuḥ hatāso vāṃ pitaro devaśatrava indrāgnī jīvatho yuvam
verses.en: I WILL declare, while juices flow, the manly deeds that ye have done: Your Fathers, enemies of Gods, were smitten down, and, Indra-Agni, ye survive.

verses.sa: बळित्था महिमा वामिन्द्राग्नी पनिष्ठ आ । समानो वां जनिता भ्रातरा युवं यमाविहेहमातरा॥
verses.tr: baḻitthā mahimā vāmindrāgnī paniṣṭha ā samāno vāṃ janitā bhrātarā yuvaṃ yamāvihehamātarā
verses.en: Thus, Indra-Agni verily your greatness merits loftiest praise, Sprung from one common Father, brothers, twins are ye; your Mother is in every place.

verses.sa: ओकिवांसा सुते सचाँ अश्वा सप्ती इवादने । इन्द्रा न्व१ग्नी अवसेह वज्रिणा वयं देवा हवामहे॥
verses.tr: okivāṃsā sute sacāṃ aśvā saptī ivādane indrā nva1gnī avaseha vajriṇā vayaṃ devā havāmahe
verses.en: These who delight in flowing juice, like fellow horses at their food, Indra and Agni, Gods armed with the thunderbolt, we call this day to come with help.

verses.sa: य इन्द्राग्नी सुतेषु वां स्तवत्तेष्वृतावृधा । जोषवाकं वदतः पज्रहोषिणा न देवा भसथश्चन॥
verses.tr: ya indrāgnī suteṣu vāṃ stavatteṣvṛtāvṛdhā joṣavākaṃ vadataḥ pajrahoṣiṇā na devā bhasathaścana
verses.en: Indra and Agni, Friends of Law, served with rich gifts, your speech is kind To him who praises you while these libations flow: that man, O Gods, ye ne'er consume.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी को अस्य वां देवौ मर्तश्चिकेतति ।
विषूचो अश्वान्युयुजान ईयत एकः समान आ रथे॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī ko asya vāṃ devau martaściketati viṣūco aśvānyuyujāna īyata ekaḥ samāna ā rathe
verses.en: What mortal understands, O Gods, Indra and Agni, this your way? One of you, yoking Steeds that move to every side, advances in your common car.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी अपादियं पूर्वागात्पद्वतीभ्यः । हित्वी शिरो जिह्वया वावदच्चरत्त्रिंशत्पदा न्यक्रमीत्॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī apādiyaṃ pūrvāgātpadvatībhyaḥ hitvī śiro jihvayā vāvadaccarattriṃśatpadā nyakramīt
verses.en: First, Indra-Agni, hath this Maid come footless unto those with feet. Stretching her head and speaking loudly with her tongue, she hath gone downward thirty steps.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी आ हि तन्वते नरो धन्वानि बाह्वोः । मा नो अस्मिन्महाधने परा वर्क्तं गविष्टिषु॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī ā hi tanvate naro dhanvāni bāhvoḥ mā no asminmahādhane parā varktaṃ gaviṣṭiṣu
verses.en: E'en now, O Indra-Agni, men hold in their arms and stretch their bows. Desert us not in this great fray, in battles for the sake of kine.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी तपन्ति माऽघा अर्यो अरातयः । अप द्वेषांस्या कृतं युयुतं सूर्यादधि॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī tapanti mā'ghā aryo arātayaḥ apa dveṣāṃsyā kṛtaṃ yuyutaṃ sūryādadhi
verses.en: The foeman's sinful enmities, Indra and Agni, vex me sore. Drive those who hate me far away, and keep them distant from the Sun.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी युवोरपि वसु दिव्यानि पार्थिवा । आ न इह प्र यच्छतं रयिं विश्वायुपोषसम्॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī yuvorapi vasu divyāni pārthivā ā na iha pra yacchataṃ rayiṃ viśvāyupoṣasam
verses.en: Indra and Agni, yours are all the treasures of the heavens and earth. Here give ye us the opulence that prospers every living man.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी उक्थवाहसा स्तोमेभिर्हवनश्रुता । विश्वाभिर्गीर्भिरा गतमस्य सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī ukthavāhasā stomebhirhavanaśrutā viśvābhirgīrbhirā gatamasya somasya pītaye
verses.en: O Indra-Agni, who accept the laud, and hear us for our praise, Come near us, drawn by all our songs, to drink of this our Soma juice.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी ।गायत्री;१-३, १३ त्रिष्टुप् ,१४ बृहती,१५ अनुष्टप्।
श्नथद्वृत्रमुत सनोति वाजमिन्द्रा यो अग्नी सहुरी सपर्यात् ।
इरज्यन्ता वसव्यस्य भूरेः सहस्तमा सहसा वाजयन्ता॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī gāyatrī;1-3, 13 triṣṭup ,14 bṛhatī,15 anuṣṭap śnathadvṛtramuta sanoti vājamindrā yo agnī sahurī saparyāt irajyantā vasavyasya bhūreḥ sahastamā sahasā vājayantā
verses.en: He slays the foe and wins the spoil who worships Indra and Agni, strong and mighty Heroes, Who rule as Sovrans over ample riches, victorious, showing forth their power in conquest.

verses.sa:
ता योधिष्टमभि गा इन्द्र नूनमपः स्वरुषसो अग्न ऊळ्हाः ।
दिशः स्वरुषस इन्द्र चित्रा अपो गा अग्ने युवसे नियुत्वान्॥
verses.tr: tā yodhiṣṭamabhi gā indra nūnamapaḥ svaruṣaso agna ūḻhāḥ diśaḥ svaruṣasa indra citrā apo gā agne yuvase niyutvān
verses.en: So battle now, O Indra and thou, Agni, for cows and waters, sunlight, stolen Mornings. Team-borne, thou makest kine thine own, O Agni: thou, Indra, light, Dawns, regions, wondrous waters.

verses.sa:
आ वृत्रहणा वृत्रहभिः शुष्मैरिन्द्र यातं नमोभिरग्ने अर्वाक् ।
युवं राधोभिरकवेभिरिन्द्राग्ने अस्मे भवतमुत्तमेभिः॥
verses.tr: ā vṛtrahaṇā vṛtrahabhiḥ śuṣmairindra yātaṃ namobhiragne arvāk yuvaṃ rādhobhirakavebhirindrāgne asme bhavatamuttamebhiḥ
verses.en: With Vrtra-slaying might, Indra and Agni, come, drawn by homage, O ye Vrtra-slayers. Indra and Agni, show yourselves among us with your supreme and unrestricted bounties.

verses.sa: ता हुवे ययोरिदं पप्ने विश्वं पुरा कृतम् । इन्द्राग्नी न मर्धतः॥
verses.tr: tā huve yayoridaṃ papne viśvaṃ purā kṛtam indrāgnī na mardhataḥ
verses.en: I call the Twain whose deeds of old have all been famed in ancient days O Indra-Agni, harm us not.

verses.sa: उग्रा विघनिना मृध इन्द्राग्नी हवामहे । ता नो मृळात ईदृशे॥
verses.tr: ugrā vighaninā mṛdha indrāgnī havāmahe tā no mṛḻāta īdṛśe
verses.en: The Strong, the scatterers of the foe, Indra and Agni, we invoke; May they be kind to one like me.

verses.sa: हतो वृत्राण्यार्या हतो दासानि सत्पती । हतो विश्वा अप द्विषः॥
verses.tr: hato vṛtrāṇyāryā hato dāsāni satpatī hato viśvā apa dviṣaḥ
verses.en: They slay our Arya foes, these Lords of heroes, slay our Dasyu foes And drive our enemies away.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी युवामिमे३ऽभि स्तोमा अनूषत । पिबतं शम्भुवा सुतम्॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī yuvāmime3'bhi stomā anūṣata pibataṃ śambhuvā sutam
verses.en: Indra and Agni, these our songs of praise have sounded forth to you: Ye who bring blessings! drink the juice.

verses.sa: या वां सन्ति पुरुस्पृहो नियुतो दाशुषे नरा । इन्द्राग्नी ताभिरा गतम्॥
verses.tr: yā vāṃ santi puruspṛho niyuto dāśuṣe narā indrāgnī tābhirā gatam
verses.en: Come, Indra-Agni, with those teams, desired of many, which ye have, O Heroes, for the worshipper.

verses.sa: ताभिरा गच्छतं नरोपेदं सवनं सुतम् । इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: tābhirā gacchataṃ naropedaṃ savanaṃ sutam indrāgnī somapītaye
verses.en: With those to this libation poured, ye Heroes, Indra-Agni, come: Come ye to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: तमीळिष्व यो अर्चिषा वना विश्वा परिष्वजत् । कृष्णा कृणोति जिह्वया॥
verses.tr: tamīḻiṣva yo arciṣā vanā viśvā pariṣvajat kṛṣṇā kṛṇoti jihvayā
verses.en: Glorify him who compasses all forests with his glowing flame, And leaves them blackened with his tongue.

verses.sa: य इद्ध आविवासति सुम्नमिन्द्रस्य मर्त्यः । द्युम्नाय सुतरा अपः॥
verses.tr: ya iddha āvivāsati sumnamindrasya martyaḥ dyumnāya sutarā apaḥ
verses.en: He who gains Indra's bliss with fire enkindled finds an easy way Over the floods to happiness.

verses.sa: ता नो वाजवतीरिष आशून्पिपृतमर्वतः । इन्द्रमग्निं च वोळ्हवे॥
verses.tr: tā no vājavatīriṣa āśūnpipṛtamarvataḥ indramagniṃ ca voḻhave
verses.en: Give us fleet coursers to convey Indra and Agni, and bestow Abundant strengthening food on us.

verses.sa:
उभा वामिन्द्राग्नी आहुवध्या उभा राधसः सह मादयध्यै ।
उभा दाताराविषां रयीणामुभा वाजस्य सातये हुवे वाम्॥
verses.tr: ubhā vāmindrāgnī āhuvadhyā ubhā rādhasaḥ saha mādayadhyai ubhā dātārāviṣāṃ rayīṇāmubhā vājasya sātaye huve vām
verses.en: Indra and Agni, I will call you hither and make you joyful with the gifts I offer. Ye Twain are givers both of food and riches: to win me strength and vigour I invoke you.

verses.sa:
आ नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैर्वसव्यै३रुप गच्छतम् ।
सखायौ देवौ सख्याय शम्भुवेन्द्राग्नी ता हवामहे॥
verses.tr: ā no gavyebhiraśvyairvasavyai3rupa gacchatam sakhāyau devau sakhyāya śambhuvendrāgnī tā havāmahe
verses.en: Come unto us with riches, come with wealth in horses and in kine. Indra and Agni, we invoke you both, the Gods, as Friends for friendship, bringing bliss.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी शृणुतं हवं यजमानस्य सुन्वतः । वीतं हव्यान्या गतं पिबतं सोम्यं मधु॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ yajamānasya sunvataḥ vītaṃ havyānyā gataṃ pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu
verses.en: Indra and Agni, hear his call who worships. with libations poured. Come and enjoy the offerings, drink the sweetly-flavoured Soma juice.

verses.sa:
इयमददाद्रभसमृणच्युतं दिवोदासं वध्र्यश्वाय दाशुषे ।
या शश्वन्तमाचखादावसं पणिं ता ते दात्राणि तविषा सरस्वति॥
verses.tr: iyamadadādrabhasamṛṇacyutaṃ divodāsaṃ vadhryaśvāya dāśuṣe yā śaśvantamācakhādāvasaṃ paṇiṃ tā te dātrāṇi taviṣā sarasvati
verses.en: To Vadhryasva when. be worshipped her with gifts she gave fierce Divodasa, canceller of debts. Consumer of the churlish niggard, one and all, thine, O Sarasvati, are these effectual boons.

verses.sa:
इयं शुष्मेभिर्बिसखा इवारुजत्सानु गिरीणां तविषेभिरूर्मिभिः ।
पारावतघ्नीमवसे सुवृक्तिभिः सरस्वतीमा विवासेम धीतिभिः॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ śuṣmebhirbisakhā ivārujatsānu girīṇāṃ taviṣebhirūrmibhiḥ pārāvataghnīmavase suvṛktibhiḥ sarasvatīmā vivāsema dhītibhiḥ
verses.en: She with her might, like one who digs for lotus-stems, hath burst with her strong waves the ridges of the hills. Let us invite with songs and holy hymns for help Sarasvati who slayeth the Paravatas.

verses.sa:
सरस्वति देवनिदो नि बर्हय प्रजां विश्वस्य बृसयस्य मायिनः ।
उत क्षितिभ्योऽवनीरविन्दो विषमेभ्यो अस्रवो वाजिनीवति॥
verses.tr: sarasvati devanido ni barhaya prajāṃ viśvasya bṛsayasya māyinaḥ uta kṣitibhyo'vanīravindo viṣamebhyo asravo vājinīvati
verses.en: Thou castest down, Sarasvati, those who scorned the Gods, the brood of every Brsaya skilled in magic arts. Thou hast discovered rivers for the tribes of men, and, rich in wealth! made poison flow away from them.

verses.sa: प्र णो देवी सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती । धीनामवित्र्यवतु॥
verses.tr: pra ṇo devī sarasvatī vājebhirvājinīvatī dhīnāmavitryavatu
verses.en: May the divine Sarasvati, rich in her wealth, protect us well, Furthering all our thoughts with might

verses.sa: यस्त्वा देवि सरस्वत्युपब्रूते धने हिते । इन्द्रं न वृत्रतूर्ये॥
verses.tr: yastvā devi sarasvatyupabrūte dhane hite indraṃ na vṛtratūrye
verses.en: Whoso, divine Sarasvati, invokes thee where the prize is set, Like Indra when he smites the foe.

verses.sa: त्वं देवि सरस्वत्यवा वाजेषु वाजिनि । रदा पूषेव नः सनिम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ devi sarasvatyavā vājeṣu vājini radā pūṣeva naḥ sanim
verses.en: Aid us, divine Sarasvad, thou who art strong in wealth and power Like Pusan, give us opulence.

verses.sa: उत स्या नः सरस्वती घोरा हिरण्यवर्तनिः । वृत्रघ्नी वष्टि सुष्टुतिम्॥
verses.tr: uta syā naḥ sarasvatī ghorā hiraṇyavartaniḥ vṛtraghnī vaṣṭi suṣṭutim
verses.en: Yea, this divine Sarasvati, terrible with her golden path, Foe-slayer, claims our eulogy.

verses.sa: यस्या अनन्तो अह्रुतस्त्वेषश्चरिष्णुरर्णवः । अमश्चरति रोरुवत्॥
verses.tr: yasyā ananto ahrutastveṣaścariṣṇurarṇavaḥ amaścarati roruvat
verses.en: Whose limitless unbroken flood, swift-moving with a rapid rush, Comes onward with tempestuous roar.

verses.sa: सा नो विश्वा अति द्विषः स्वसॄरन्या ऋतावरी । अतन्नहेव सूर्यः॥
verses.tr: sā no viśvā ati dviṣaḥ svasṝranyā ṛtāvarī atannaheva sūryaḥ
verses.en: She hath spread us beyond all foes, beyond her Sisters, Holy One, As Surya spreadeth out the days.

verses.sa: उत नः प्रिया प्रियासु सप्तस्वसा सुजुष्टा । सरस्वती स्तोम्या भूत्॥
verses.tr: uta naḥ priyā priyāsu saptasvasā sujuṣṭā sarasvatī stomyā bhūt
verses.en: Yea, she most dear amid dear stream, Seven-sistered, graciously inclined, Sarasvati hath earned our praise.

verses.sa: आपप्रुषी पार्थिवान्युरु रजो अन्तरिक्षम् । सरस्वती निदस्पातु॥
verses.tr: āpapruṣī pārthivānyuru rajo antarikṣam sarasvatī nidaspātu
verses.en: Guard us from hate Sarasvati, she who hath filled the realms of earth, And that wide tract, the firmament!

verses.sa: त्रिषधस्था सप्तधातुः पञ्च जाता वर्धयन्ती । वाजेवाजे हव्या भूत्॥
verses.tr: triṣadhasthā saptadhātuḥ pañca jātā vardhayantī vājevāje havyā bhūt
verses.en: Seven-sistered, sprung from threefold source, the Five Tribes' prosperer, she must be Invoked in every deed of might.

verses.sa:
प्र या महिम्ना महिनासु चेकिते द्युम्नेभिरन्या अपसामपस्तमा ।
रथ इव बृहती विभ्वने कृतोपस्तुत्या चिकितुषा सरस्वती॥
verses.tr: pra yā mahimnā mahināsu cekite dyumnebhiranyā apasāmapastamā ratha iva bṛhatī vibhvane kṛtopastutyā cikituṣā sarasvatī
verses.en: Marked out by majesty among the Mighty Ones, in glory swifter than the other rapid Streams, Created vast for victory like a chariot, Sarasvati must be extolled by every sage.

verses.sa:
सरस्वत्यभि नो नेषि वस्यो माप स्फरीः पयसा मा न आ धक् ।
जुषस्व नः सख्या वेश्या च मा त्वत्क्षेत्राण्यरणानि गन्म॥
verses.tr: sarasvatyabhi no neṣi vasyo māpa spharīḥ payasā mā na ā dhak juṣasva naḥ sakhyā veśyā ca mā tvatkṣetrāṇyaraṇāni ganma
verses.en: Guide us, Sarasvati, to glorious treasure: refuse us not thy milk, nor spurn us from thee. Gladly accept our friendship and obedience: let us not go from thee to distant countries.

verses.sa:
स्तुषे नरा दिवो अस्य प्रसन्ताऽश्विना हुवे जरमाणो अर्कैः ।
या सद्य उस्रा व्युषि ज्मो अन्तान्युयूषतः पर्युरू वरांसि॥
verses.tr: stuṣe narā divo asya prasantā'śvinā huve jaramāṇo arkaiḥ yā sadya usrā vyuṣi jmo antānyuyūṣataḥ paryurū varāṃsi
verses.en: I LAUD the Heroes Twain, this heaven's Controllers: singing with songs of praise I call the Asvins, Fain in a moment, when the morns are breaking, to part the earth's ends and the spacious regions.

verses.sa:
ता यज्ञमा शुचिभिश्चक्रमाणा रथस्य भानुं रुरुचू रजोभिः ।
पुरू वरांस्यमिता मिमानाऽपो धन्वान्यति याथो अज्रान्॥
verses.tr: tā yajñamā śucibhiścakramāṇā rathasya bhānuṃ rurucū rajobhiḥ purū varāṃsyamitā mimānā'po dhanvānyati yātho ajrān
verses.en: Moving to sacrifice through realms of lustre they light the radiance of the car that bears them. Traversing many wide unmeasured spaces, over the wastes ye pass, and fields, and waters.

verses.sa:
ता ह त्यद्वर्तिर्यदरध्रमुग्रेत्था धिय ऊहथुः शश्वदश्वैः ।
मनोजवेभिरिषिरैः शयध्यै परि व्यथिर्दाशुषो मर्त्यस्य॥
verses.tr: tā ha tyadvartiryadaradhramugretthā dhiya ūhathuḥ śaśvadaśvaiḥ manojavebhiriṣiraiḥ śayadhyai pari vyathirdāśuṣo martyasya
verses.en: Ye to that bounteous path of yours, ye mighty, have ever borne away our thoughts with horses, Mind-swift and full of vigour, that the trouble of man who offers gifts might cease and slumber.

verses.sa:
ता नव्यसो जरमाणस्य मन्मोप भूषतो युयुजानसप्ती ।
शुभं पृक्षमिषमूर्जं वहन्ता होता यक्षत्प्रत्नो अध्रुग्युवाना॥
verses.tr: tā navyaso jaramāṇasya manmopa bhūṣato yuyujānasaptī śubhaṃ pṛkṣamiṣamūrjaṃ vahantā hotā yakṣatpratno adhrugyuvānā
verses.en: So ye, when ye have yoked your chariothorses, come to the hymn of the most recent singer. Our true and ancient Herald Priest shall bring you, the Youthful, bearing splendour, food, and vigour.

verses.sa:
ता वल्गू दस्रा पुरुशाकतमा प्रत्ना नव्यसा वचसा विवासे ।
या शंसते स्तुवते शम्भविष्ठा बभूवतुर्गृणते चित्रराती॥
verses.tr: tā valgū dasrā puruśākatamā pratnā navyasā vacasā vivāse yā śaṃsate stuvate śambhaviṣṭhā babhūvaturgṛṇate citrarātī
verses.en: With newest hymn I call those Wonder-Workers, ancient and brilliant, and exceeding mighty, Bringers of bliss to him who lauds and praises, bestowing varied bounties on the singer.

verses.sa:
ता भुज्युं विभिरद्भ्यः समुद्रात्तुग्रस्य सूनुमूहथू रजोभिः ।
अरेणुभिर्योजनेभिर्भुजन्ता पतत्रिभिरर्णसो निरुपस्थात्॥
verses.tr: tā bhujyuṃ vibhiradbhyaḥ samudrāttugrasya sūnumūhathū rajobhiḥ areṇubhiryojanebhirbhujantā patatribhirarṇaso nirupasthāt
verses.en: So ye, with birds, out of the sea and waters bore Bhujyu, son of Tugra, through the regions. Speeding with winged steeds through dustless spaces, out of the bosom of the flood they bore him.

verses.sa:
वि जयुषा रथ्या यातमद्रिं श्रुतं हवं वृषणा वध्रिमत्याः ।
दशस्यन्ता शयवे पिप्यथुर्गामिति च्यवाना सुमतिं भुरण्यू॥
verses.tr: vi jayuṣā rathyā yātamadriṃ śrutaṃ havaṃ vṛṣaṇā vadhrimatyāḥ daśasyantā śayave pipyathurgāmiti cyavānā sumatiṃ bhuraṇyū
verses.en: Victors, car-borne, ye rent the rock asunder: Bulls, heard the calling of the eunuch's consort. Bounteous, ye filled the cow with milk for Sayu: thus, swift and zealous Ones, ye showed your favour.

verses.sa:
यद्रोदसी प्रदिवो अस्ति भूमा हेळो देवानामुत मर्त्यत्रा ।
तदादित्या वसवो रुद्रियासो रक्षोयुजे तपुरघं दधात॥
verses.tr: yadrodasī pradivo asti bhūmā heḻo devānāmuta martyatrā tadādityā vasavo rudriyāso rakṣoyuje tapuraghaṃ dadhāta
verses.en: Whate'er from olden time, Heaven, Earth! existeth great object of the wrath of Gods and mortals, Make that, Adityas, Vasus, sons of Rudra, an evil brand to one allied with demons.

verses.sa:
य ईं राजानावृतुथा विदधद्रजसो मित्रो वरुणश्चिकेतत् ।
गम्भीराय रक्षसे हेतिमस्य द्रोघाय चिद्वचस आनवाय॥
verses.tr: ya īṃ rājānāvṛtuthā vidadhadrajaso mitro varuṇaściketat gambhīrāya rakṣase hetimasya droghāya cidvacasa ānavāya
verses.en: May he who knows, as Varuna and Mitra, air's realm, appointing both the Kings in season, Against the secret fiend cast forth his weapon, against the lying words that strangers utter.

verses.sa:
अन्तरैश्चक्रैस्तनयाय वर्तिर्द्युमता यातं नृवता रथेन ।
सनुत्येन त्यजसा मर्त्यस्य वनुष्यतामपि शीर्षा ववृक्तम्॥
verses.tr: antaraiścakraistanayāya vartirdyumatā yātaṃ nṛvatā rathena sanutyena tyajasā martyasya vanuṣyatāmapi śīrṣā vavṛktam
verses.en: Come to our home with friendly wheels, for offipring; come on your radiant chariot rich in heroes. Strike off, ye Twain, the heads of our assailants who with man's treacherous attack approach us.

verses.sa:
आ परमाभिरुत मध्यमाभिर्नियुद्भिर्यातमवमाभिरर्वाक् ।
दृळ्हस्य चिद्गोमतो वि व्रजस्य दुरो वर्तं गृणते चित्रराती॥
verses.tr: ā paramābhiruta madhyamābhirniyudbhiryātamavamābhirarvāk dṛḻhasya cidgomato vi vrajasya duro vartaṃ gṛṇate citrarātī
verses.en: Come hitherward to us with teams of horses, the highest and the midmost and the lowest. Bountiful Lords, throw open to the singer doors e'en of the firm-closed stall of cattle.

verses.sa:
क्व१ त्या वल्गू पुरुहूताद्य दूतो न स्तोमोऽविदन्नमस्वान् ।
आ यो अर्वाङ्नासत्या ववर्त प्रेष्ठा ह्यसथो अस्य मन्मन्॥
verses.tr: kva1 tyā valgū puruhūtādya dūto na stomo'vidannamasvān ā yo arvāṅnāsatyā vavarta preṣṭhā hyasatho asya manman
verses.en: Where hath the hymn with reverence, like an envoy, found both fair Gods to-day, invoked of many- Hymn that hath brought the two Nasatyas hither? To this man's thought be ye, both Gods, most friendly.

verses.sa:
अरं मे गन्तं हवनायास्मै गृणाना यथा पिबाथो अन्धः ।
परि ह त्यद्वर्तिर्याथो रिषो न यत्परो नान्तरस्तुतुर्यात्॥
verses.tr: araṃ me gantaṃ havanāyāsmai gṛṇānā yathā pibātho andhaḥ pari ha tyadvartiryātho riṣo na yatparo nāntarastuturyāt
verses.en: Come readily to this mine invocation, lauded with songs, that ye may drink the juices. Compass this house to keep it from the foeman, that none may force it, either near or distant.

verses.sa:
अकारि वामन्धसो वरीमन्नस्तारि बर्हिः सुप्रायणतमम् ।
उत्तानहस्तो युवयुर्ववन्दा ऽऽवां नक्षन्तो अद्रय आञ्जन्॥
verses.tr: akāri vāmandhaso varīmannastāri barhiḥ suprāyaṇatamam uttānahasto yuvayurvavandā ''vāṃ nakṣanto adraya āñjan
verses.en: Juice in wide room hath been prepared to feast you: for you the grass is strewn, most soft to tread on. With lifted hands your servant hath adored you. Yearningfor you the press-stones shed the liquid.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो वामग्निरध्वरेष्वस्थात्प्र रातिरेति जूर्णिनी घृताची ।
प्र होता गूर्तमना उराणोऽयुक्त यो नासत्या हवीमन्॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvo vāmagniradhvareṣvasthātpra rātireti jūrṇinī ghṛtācī pra hotā gūrtamanā urāṇo'yukta yo nāsatyā havīman
verses.en: Agni uplifts him at your sacrifices: forth goes the oblation dropping oil and glowing. Up stands the grateful-minded priest, elected, appointed to invoke the two Nasatyas.

verses.sa:
अधि श्रिये दुहिता सूर्यस्य रथं तस्थौ पुरुभुजा शतोतिम् ।
प्र मायाभिर्मायिना भूतमत्र नरा नृतू जनिमन्यज्ञियानाम्॥
verses.tr: adhi śriye duhitā sūryasya rathaṃ tasthau purubhujā śatotim pra māyābhirmāyinā bhūtamatra narā nṛtū janimanyajñiyānām
verses.en: Lords of great wealth! for glory, Surya's Daughter mounted your car that brings a hundred succours. Famed for your magic arts were ye, magicians! amid the race of Gods, ye dancing Heroes!

verses.sa:
युवं श्रीभिर्दर्शताभिराभिः शुभे पुष्टिमूहथुः सूर्यायाः ।
प्र वां वयो वपुषेऽनु पप्तन्नक्षद्वाणी सुष्टुता धिष्ण्या वाम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ śrībhirdarśatābhirābhiḥ śubhe puṣṭimūhathuḥ sūryāyāḥ pra vāṃ vayo vapuṣe'nu paptannakṣadvāṇī suṣṭutā dhiṣṇyā vām
verses.en: Ye Twain, with these your glories fair to look on, brought, to win victory, rich gifts for Surya. After you flew your birds, marvels of beauty: dear to our hearts! the song, well lauded, reached you.

verses.sa:
आ वां वयोऽश्वासो वहिष्ठा अभि प्रयो नासत्या वहन्तु ।
प्र वां रथो मनोजवा असर्जीषः पृक्ष इषिधो अनु पूर्वीः॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ vayo'śvāso vahiṣṭhā abhi prayo nāsatyā vahantu pra vāṃ ratho manojavā asarjīṣaḥ pṛkṣa iṣidho anu pūrvīḥ
verses.en: May your winged coursers, best to draw. Nasatyas! convey you to the object of your wishes. Swift as the thought, your car hath been sent onward to food of many a sort and dainty viands.

verses.sa:
पुरु हि वां पुरुभुजा देष्णं धेनुं न इषं पिन्वतमसक्राम् ।
स्तुतश्च वां माध्वी सुष्टुतिश्च रसाश्च ये वामनु रातिमग्मन्॥
verses.tr: puru hi vāṃ purubhujā deṣṇaṃ dhenuṃ na iṣaṃ pinvatamasakrām stutaśca vāṃ mādhvī suṣṭutiśca rasāśca ye vāmanu rātimagman
verses.en: Lords of great wealth, manifold is your bounty: ye filled our cow with food that never faileth. Lovers of sweetness! yours are praise and singers, and poured libations which have sought your favour.

verses.sa:
उत म ऋज्रे पुरयस्य रघ्वी सुमीळ्हे शतं पेरुके च पक्वा ।
शाण्डो दाद्धिरणिनः स्मद्दिष्टीन्दश वशासो अभिषाच ऋष्वान्॥
verses.tr: uta ma ṛjre purayasya raghvī sumīḻhe śataṃ peruke ca pakvā śāṇḍo dāddhiraṇinaḥ smaddiṣṭīndaśa vaśāso abhiṣāca ṛṣvān
verses.en: Mine were two mares of Puraya, brown, swift-footed; a hundred with Sumidha, food with Peruk Sanda gave ten gold-decked and well-trained horses, tame and obedient and of lofty stature.

verses.sa:
सं वां शता नासत्या सहस्राऽश्वानां पुरुपन्था गिरे दात् ।
भरद्वाजाय वीर नू गिरे दाद्धता रक्षांसि पुरुदंससा स्युः॥
verses.tr: saṃ vāṃ śatā nāsatyā sahasrā'śvānāṃ purupanthā gire dāt bharadvājāya vīra nū gire dāddhatā rakṣāṃsi purudaṃsasā syuḥ
verses.en: Nasatyas! Purupanthas offered hundreds, thousands of steeds to him who sang your praises, Gave, Heroes! to the singer Bharadvaja. Ye-Wonder-Workers, let the fiends be slaughtered.

verses.sa: आ वां सुम्ने वरिमन्त्सूरिभिः ष्याम्॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ sumne varimantsūribhiḥ ṣyām
verses.en: May I with princes share your bliss in freedom.

verses.sa:
उदु श्रिय उषसो रोचमाना अस्थुरपां नोर्मयो रुशन्तः ।
कृणोति विश्वा सुपथा सुगान्यभूदु वस्वी दक्षिणा मघोनी॥
verses.tr: udu śriya uṣaso rocamānā asthurapāṃ normayo ruśantaḥ kṛṇoti viśvā supathā sugānyabhūdu vasvī dakṣiṇā maghonī
verses.en: The radiant Dawns have risen up for glory, in their white splendour like the waves of waters. She maketh paths all easy, fair to travel, and, rich, hath shown herself benign and friendly.

verses.sa:
भद्रा ददृक्ष उर्विया वि भास्युत्ते शोचिर्भानवो द्यामपप्तन् ।
आविर्वक्षः कृणुषे शुम्भमानोषो देवि रोचमाना महोभिः॥
verses.tr: bhadrā dadṛkṣa urviyā vi bhāsyutte śocirbhānavo dyāmapaptan āvirvakṣaḥ kṛṇuṣe śumbhamānoṣo devi rocamānā mahobhiḥ
verses.en: We see that thou art good: far shines thy lustre; thy beams, thy splendours have flown up to heaven. Decking thyself, thou makest bare thy bosom, shining in majesty, thou Goddess Morning.

verses.sa:
वहन्ति सीमरुणासो रुशन्तो गावः सुभगामुर्विया प्रथानाम् ।
अपेजते शूरो अस्तेव शत्रून्बाधते तमो अजिरो न वोळ्हा॥
verses.tr: vahanti sīmaruṇāso ruśanto gāvaḥ subhagāmurviyā prathānām apejate śūro asteva śatrūnbādhate tamo ajiro na voḻhā
verses.en: Red are the kine and luminous that bear her the Blessed One who spreadeth through the distance. The foes she chaseth like a valiant archer, like a swift warrior she repelleth darkness.

verses.sa:
सुगोत ते सुपथा पर्वतेष्ववाते अपस्तरसि स्वभानो ।
सा न आ वह पृथुयामन्नृष्वे रयिं दिवो दुहितरिषयध्यै॥
verses.tr: sugota te supathā parvateṣvavāte apastarasi svabhāno sā na ā vaha pṛthuyāmannṛṣve rayiṃ divo duhitariṣayadhyai
verses.en: Thy ways are easy on the hills: thou passest Invincible! Se1f-luminous! through waters. So lofty Goddess with thine ample pathway, Daughter of Heaven, bring wealth to give us comfort.

verses.sa:
सा वह योक्षभिरवातोषो वरं वहसि जोषमनु ।
त्वं दिवो दुहितर्या ह देवी पूर्वहूतौ मंहना दर्शता भूः॥
verses.tr: sā vaha yokṣabhiravātoṣo varaṃ vahasi joṣamanu tvaṃ divo duhitaryā ha devī pūrvahūtau maṃhanā darśatā bhūḥ
verses.en: Dawn, bring me wealth: untroubled, with thine oxen thou bearest riches at thy will and pleasure; Thou who, a Goddess, Child of Heaven, hast shown thee lovely through bounty when we called thee early.

verses.sa:
उत्ते वयश्चिद्वसतेरपप्तन्नरश्च ये पितुभाजो व्युष्टौ ।
अमा सते वहसि भूरि वाममुषो देवि दाशुषे मर्त्याय॥
verses.tr: utte vayaścidvasaterapaptannaraśca ye pitubhājo vyuṣṭau amā sate vahasi bhūri vāmamuṣo devi dāśuṣe martyāya
verses.en: As the birds fly forth from their resting places, so men with store of food rise at thy dawning. Yea, to the liberal mortal who remaineth at home, O Goddess Dawn, much good thou bringest.

verses.sa:
एषा स्या नो दुहिता दिवोजाः क्षितीरुच्छन्ती मानुषीरजीगः ।
या भानुना रुशता राम्यास्वज्ञायि तिरस्तमसश्चिदक्तून्॥
verses.tr: eṣā syā no duhitā divojāḥ kṣitīrucchantī mānuṣīrajīgaḥ yā bhānunā ruśatā rāmyāsvajñāyi tirastamasaścidaktūn
verses.en: Shedding her light on human habitations this Child of Heaven hath called us from our slumber; She who at night-time with her argent lustre hath shown herself e'en through the shades of darkness.

verses.sa:
वि तद्ययुररुणयुग्भिरश्वैश्चित्रं भान्त्युषसश्चन्द्ररथाः ।
अग्रं यज्ञस्य बृहतो नयन्तीर्वि ता बाधन्ते तम ऊर्म्यायाः॥
verses.tr: vi tadyayuraruṇayugbhiraśvaiścitraṃ bhāntyuṣasaścandrarathāḥ agraṃ yajñasya bṛhato nayantīrvi tā bādhante tama ūrmyāyāḥ
verses.en: All this with red-rayed steeds have they divided: the Dawns on bright cars shine in wondrous fashion. They, bringing near the stately rite's commencement, drive far away the night's surrounding shadows.

verses.sa:
श्रवो वाजमिषमूर्जं वहन्तीर्नि दाशुष उषसो मर्त्याय ।
मघोनीर्वीरवत्पत्यमाना अवो धात विधते रत्नमद्य॥
verses.tr: śravo vājamiṣamūrjaṃ vahantīrni dāśuṣa uṣaso martyāya maghonīrvīravatpatyamānā avo dhāta vidhate ratnamadya
verses.en: Dawns, bringing hither, to the man who worships, glory and power and might and food and vigour, Opulent, with imperial sway like heroes, favour your servant and this day enrich him.

verses.sa:
इदा हि वो विधते रत्नमस्तीदा वीराय दाशुष उषासः ।
इदा विप्राय जरते यदुक्था नि ष्म मावते वहथा पुरा चित्॥
verses.tr: idā hi vo vidhate ratnamastīdā vīrāya dāśuṣa uṣāsaḥ idā viprāya jarate yadukthā ni ṣma māvate vahathā purā cit
verses.en: Now is there treasure for the man who serves you, now for the hero, Dawns! who brings oblation; Now for the singer when he sings the praise-song. Even to one like me ye brought aforetime.

verses.sa:
इदा हि त उषो अद्रिसानो गोत्रा गवामङ्गिरसो गृणन्ति ।
व्य१र्केण बिभिदुर्ब्रह्मणा च सत्या नृणामभवद्देवहूतिः॥
verses.tr: idā hi ta uṣo adrisāno gotrā gavāmaṅgiraso gṛṇanti vya1rkeṇa bibhidurbrahmaṇā ca satyā nṛṇāmabhavaddevahūtiḥ
verses.en: O Dawn who standest on the mountain ridges, Angirases now praise thy stalls of cattle. With prayer and holy hymn they burst them open: the heroes' calling on the Gods was fruitful.

verses.sa:
उच्छा दिवो दुहितः प्रत्नवन्नो भरद्वाजवद्विधते मघोनि ।
सुवीरं रयिं गृणते रिरीह्युरुगायमधि धेहि श्रवो नः॥
verses.tr: ucchā divo duhitaḥ pratnavanno bharadvājavadvidhate maghoni suvīraṃ rayiṃ gṛṇate rirīhyurugāyamadhi dhehi śravo naḥ
verses.en: Shine on us as of old, thou Child of Heaven,on him, rich Maid! who serves like Bharadvaja. Give to the singer wealth with noble heroes, and upon us bestow wide-spreading glory.

verses.sa:
वपुर्नु तच्चिकितुषे चिदस्तु समानं नाम धेनु पत्यमानम् ।
मर्तेष्वन्यद्दोहसे पीपाय सकृच्छुक्रं दुदुहे पृश्निरूधः॥
verses.tr: vapurnu taccikituṣe cidastu samānaṃ nāma dhenu patyamānam marteṣvanyaddohase pīpāya sakṛcchukraṃ duduhe pṛśnirūdhaḥ
verses.en: E'EN to the wise let that be still a wonder to which the general name of Cow is given. The one hath swelled among mankind for milking: Prsni hath drained but once her fair bright udder.

verses.sa:
ये अग्नयो न शोशुचन्निधाना द्विर्यत्त्रिर्मरुतो वावृधन्त ।
अरेणवो हिरण्ययास एषां साकं नृम्णैः पौंस्येभिश्च भूवन्॥
verses.tr: ye agnayo na śośucannidhānā dviryattrirmaruto vāvṛdhanta areṇavo hiraṇyayāsa eṣāṃ sākaṃ nṛmṇaiḥ pauṃsyebhiśca bhūvan
verses.en: They who like kindled flames of fire are glowing,. the Maruts, twice and thrice have waxen mighty. Golden and dustless were their cars, invested with their great strength and their heroic vigour.

verses.sa:
रुद्रस्य ये मीळ्हुषः सन्ति पुत्रा याँश्चो नु दाधृविर्भरध्यै ।
विदे हि माता महो मही षा सेत्पृश्निः सुभ्वे३ गर्भमाधात्॥
verses.tr: rudrasya ye mīḻhuṣaḥ santi putrā yāṃśco nu dādhṛvirbharadhyai vide hi mātā maho mahī ṣā setpṛśniḥ subhve3 garbhamādhāt
verses.en: They who are Sons of the rain-pouring Rudra, whom the long-lasting One had power to foster: The Mighty Ones whose germ great Mother Prsni is known to have received for man's advantage.

verses.sa:
न य ईषन्ते जनुषोऽया न्व१न्तः सन्तोऽवद्यानि पुनानाः ।
निर्यद्दुह्रे शुचयोऽनु जोषमनु श्रिया तन्वमुक्षमाणाः॥
verses.tr: na ya īṣante januṣo'yā nva1ntaḥ santo'vadyāni punānāḥ niryadduhre śucayo'nu joṣamanu śriyā tanvamukṣamāṇāḥ
verses.en: They shrink not from the birth; in this same manner still resting there they purge away reproaches. When they have streamed forth, brilliant, at their pleasure, with their own splendour they bedew their bodies.

verses.sa:
मक्षू न येषु दोहसे चिदया आ नाम धृष्णु मारुतं दधानाः ।
न ये स्तौना अयासो मह्ना नू चित्सुदानुरव यासदुग्रान्॥
verses.tr: makṣū na yeṣu dohase cidayā ā nāma dhṛṣṇu mārutaṃ dadhānāḥ na ye staunā ayāso mahnā nū citsudānurava yāsadugrān
verses.en: Even those who bear the brave bold name of Maruts, whom not the active quickly wins for milking. Even the liberal wards not off those fierce ones, those who are light and agile in their greatness.

verses.sa:
त इदुग्राः शवसा धृष्णुषेणा उभे युजन्त रोदसी सुमेके ।
अध स्मैषु रोदसी स्वशोचिरामवत्सु तस्थौ न रोकः॥
verses.tr: ta idugrāḥ śavasā dhṛṣṇuṣeṇā ubhe yujanta rodasī sumeke adha smaiṣu rodasī svaśocirāmavatsu tasthau na rokaḥ
verses.en: When, strong in strength and armed with potent weapons, they had united wellformed earth and heaven, Rodasl stood among these furious Heroes like splendour shining with her native brightness.

verses.sa:
अनेनो वो मरुतो यामो अस्त्वनश्वश्चिद्यमजत्यरथीः ।
अनवसो अनभीशू रजस्तूर्वि रोदसी पथ्या याति साधन्॥
verses.tr: aneno vo maruto yāmo astvanaśvaścidyamajatyarathīḥ anavaso anabhīśū rajastūrvi rodasī pathyā yāti sādhan
verses.en: No team of goats shall draw your car, O Maruts, no horse no charioteer be he who drives it. Halting not, reinless, through the air it travels, speeding alone its paths through earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
नास्य वर्ता न तरुता न्वस्ति मरुतो यमवथ वाजसातौ ।
तोके वा गोषु तनये यमप्सु स व्रजं दर्ता पार्ये अध द्योः॥
verses.tr: nāsya vartā na tarutā nvasti maruto yamavatha vājasātau toke vā goṣu tanaye yamapsu sa vrajaṃ dartā pārye adha dyoḥ
verses.en: None may obstruct, none overtake, O Maruts, him whom ye succour in the strife of battle For sons and progeny, for kine and waters: he bursts the cow-stall on the day of trial.

verses.sa:
प्र चित्रमर्कं गृणते तुराय मारुताय स्वतवसे भरध्वम् ।
ये सहांसि सहसा सहन्ते रेजते अग्ने पृथिवी मखेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: pra citramarkaṃ gṛṇate turāya mārutāya svatavase bharadhvam ye sahāṃsi sahasā sahante rejate agne pṛthivī makhebhyaḥ
verses.en: Bring a bright hymn to praise the band of Maruts, the Singers, rapid, strong in native vigour, Who conquer mighty strength with strength more mighty: earth shakes in terror at their wars, O Agni.

verses.sa:
त्विषीमन्तो अध्वरस्येव दिद्युत्तृषुच्यवसो जुह्वो३ नाग्नेः ।
अर्चत्रयो धुनयो न वीरा भ्राजज्जन्मानो मरुतो अधृष्टाः॥
verses.tr: tviṣīmanto adhvarasyeva didyuttṛṣucyavaso juhvo3 nāgneḥ arcatrayo dhunayo na vīrā bhrājajjanmāno maruto adhṛṣṭāḥ
verses.en: Bright like the flashing flames of sacrifices, like tongues of fire impetuous in their onset, Chanting their psalm, singing aloud, like heroes, splendid from birth, invincible, the Maruts.

verses.sa:
तं वृधन्तं मारुतं भ्राजदृष्टिं रुद्रस्य सूनुं हवसा विवासे ।
दिवः शर्धाय शुचयो मनीषा गिरयो नाप उग्रा अस्पृध्रन्॥
verses.tr: taṃ vṛdhantaṃ mārutaṃ bhrājadṛṣṭiṃ rudrasya sūnuṃ havasā vivāse divaḥ śardhāya śucayo manīṣā girayo nāpa ugrā aspṛdhran
verses.en: That swelling band I call with invocation, the brood of Rudra, armed with glittering lances. Pure hymns are meet for that celestial army: like floods and mountains have the Strong Ones battled.

verses.sa:
विश्वेषां वः सतां ज्येष्ठतमा गीर्भिर्मित्रावरुणा वावृधध्यै ।
सं या रश्मेव यमतुर्यमिष्ठा द्वा जनाँ असमा बाहुभिः स्वैः॥
verses.tr: viśveṣāṃ vaḥ satāṃ jyeṣṭhatamā gīrbhirmitrāvaruṇā vāvṛdhadhyai saṃ yā raśmeva yamaturyamiṣṭhā dvā janāṃ asamā bāhubhiḥ svaiḥ
verses.en: Now Mitra-Varuna shall be exalted high by your songs, noblest of all existing; They who, as 'twere with reins are best Controllers, unequalled with their arms to check the people.

verses.sa:
इयं मद्वां प्र स्तृणीते मनीषोप प्रिया नमसा बर्हिरच्छ ।
यन्तं नो मित्रावरुणावधृष्टं छर्दिर्यद्वां वरूथ्यं सुदानू॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ madvāṃ pra stṛṇīte manīṣopa priyā namasā barhiraccha yantaṃ no mitrāvaruṇāvadhṛṣṭaṃ chardiryadvāṃ varūthyaṃ sudānū
verses.en: To you Two Gods is this my thought extended, turned to the sacred grass with loving homage. Give us, O Mitra-Varuna, a dwelling safe from attack, which ye shall guard, Boon-Givers!

verses.sa:
आ यातं मित्रावरुणा सुशस्त्युप प्रिया नमसा हूयमाना ।
सं यावप्नःस्थो अपसेव जनाञ्छ्रुधीयतश्चिद्यतथो महित्वा॥
verses.tr: ā yātaṃ mitrāvaruṇā suśastyupa priyā namasā hūyamānā saṃ yāvapnaḥstho apaseva janāñchrudhīyataścidyatatho mahitvā
verses.en: Come hither, Mitra-Varuna, invited with eulogies and loving adoration, Ye who with your might, as Work-Controllers, urge even men who quickly hear to labour.

verses.sa:
अश्वा न या वाजिना पूतबन्धू ऋता यद्गर्भमदितिर्भरध्यै ।
प्र या महि महान्ता जायमाना घोरा मर्ताय रिपवे नि दीधः॥
verses.tr: aśvā na yā vājinā pūtabandhū ṛtā yadgarbhamaditirbharadhyai pra yā mahi mahāntā jāyamānā ghorā martāya ripave ni dīdhaḥ
verses.en: Whom, of pure origin, like two strong horses, Aditi bore as babes in proper season, Whom, Mighty at your birth, the Mighty Goddess brought forth as terrors to the mortal foeman.

verses.sa:
विश्वे यद्वां मंहना मन्दमानाः क्षत्रं देवासो अदधुः सजोषाः ।
परि यद्भूथो रोदसी चिदुर्वी सन्ति स्पशो अदब्धासो अमूराः॥
verses.tr: viśve yadvāṃ maṃhanā mandamānāḥ kṣatraṃ devāso adadhuḥ sajoṣāḥ pari yadbhūtho rodasī cidurvī santi spaśo adabdhāso amūrāḥ
verses.en: As all the Gods in their great joy and gladness gave you with one accord your high dominion, As ye surround both worlds, though wide and spacious your spies are ever true and never bewildered.

verses.sa:
ता हि क्षत्रं धारयेथे अनु द्यून्दृंहेथे सानुमुपमादिव द्योः ।
दृळ्हो नक्षत्र उत विश्वदेवो भूमिमातान्द्यां धासिनायोः॥
verses.tr: tā hi kṣatraṃ dhārayethe anu dyūndṛṃhethe sānumupamādiva dyoḥ dṛḻho nakṣatra uta viśvadevo bhūmimātāndyāṃ dhāsināyoḥ
verses.en: So, through the days maintaining princely power. ye prop the height as 'twere from loftiest heaven. The Star of all the Gods, established, filleth the heaven and earth with food of man who liveth.

verses.sa:
ता विग्रं धैथे जठरं पृणध्या आ यत्सद्म सभृतयः पृणन्ति ।
न मृष्यन्ते युवतयोऽवाता वि यत्पयो विश्वजिन्वा भरन्ते॥
verses.tr: tā vigraṃ dhaithe jaṭharaṃ pṛṇadhyā ā yatsadma sabhṛtayaḥ pṛṇanti na mṛṣyante yuvatayo'vātā vi yatpayo viśvajinvā bharante
verses.en: Take the strong drink, to quaff till ye are sated, when he and his attendants fill the chamber. The young Maids brook not that none seeks to win them, when, Quickeners of all! they scatter moisture.

verses.sa:
ता जिह्वया सदमेदं सुमेधा आ यद्वां सत्यो अरतिॠते भूत् ।
तद्वां महित्वं घृतान्नावस्तु युवं दाशुषे वि चयिष्टमंहः॥
verses.tr: tā jihvayā sadamedaṃ sumedhā ā yadvāṃ satyo aratiṝte bhūt tadvāṃ mahitvaṃ ghṛtānnāvastu yuvaṃ dāśuṣe vi cayiṣṭamaṃhaḥ
verses.en: So with your tongue come ever, when your envoy, faithful and very wise, attends our worship. Nourished by holy oil! he this your glory: annihilate the sacrificer's trouble.

verses.sa:
प्र यद्वां मित्रावरुणा स्पूर्धन्प्रिया धाम युवधिता मिनन्ति ।
न ये देवास ओहसा न मर्ता अयज्ञसाचो अप्यो न पुत्राः॥
verses.tr: pra yadvāṃ mitrāvaruṇā spūrdhanpriyā dhāma yuvadhitā minanti na ye devāsa ohasā na martā ayajñasāco apyo na putrāḥ
verses.en: When, Mitra-Varuna, they strive against you and break the friendly laws ye have established, They, neither Gods nor men in estimation, like Api's sons have godless sacrifices.

verses.sa:
वि यद्वाचं कीस्तासो भरन्ते शंसन्ति के चिन्निविदो मनानाः ।
आद्वां ब्रवाम सत्यान्युक्था नकिर्देवेभिर्यतथो महित्वा॥
verses.tr: vi yadvācaṃ kīstāso bharante śaṃsanti ke cinnivido manānāḥ ādvāṃ bravāma satyānyukthā nakirdevebhiryatatho mahitvā
verses.en: When singers in their song uplift their voices, some chant the Nivid texts with steady purpose. Then may we sing you lauds that shall be fruitful: do ye not rival all the Gods in greatness?

verses.sa:
अवोरित्था वां छर्दिषो अभिष्टौ युवोर्मित्रावरुणावस्कृधोयु ।
अनु यद्गावः स्फुरानृजिप्यं धृष्णुं यद्रणे वृषणं युनजन्॥
verses.tr: avoritthā vāṃ chardiṣo abhiṣṭau yuvormitrāvaruṇāvaskṛdhoyu anu yadgāvaḥ sphurānṛjipyaṃ dhṛṣṇuṃ yadraṇe vṛṣaṇaṃ yunajan
verses.en: O Mitra-Varuna, may your large bounty come to us hither, near to this our dwelling, When the kine haste to us, and when they harness the fleet-foot mettled stallion for the battle.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणौ । त्रिष्टुप् , ९-१० जगती ।
श्रुष्टी वां यज्ञ उद्यतः सजोषा मनुष्वद्वृक्तबर्हिषो यजध्यै ।
आ य इन्द्रावरुणाविषे अद्य महे सुम्नाय मह आववर्तत्॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇau triṣṭup , 9-10 jagatī śruṣṭī vāṃ yajña udyataḥ sajoṣā manuṣvadvṛktabarhiṣo yajadhyai ā ya indrāvaruṇāviṣe adya mahe sumnāya maha āvavartat
verses.en: His honouring rite whose grass is trimmed is offered swiftly to you, in Manu's wise, accordant, The rite which Indra-Varuna shall carry this day to high success and glorious issue.

verses.sa:
ता हि श्रेष्ठा देवताता तुजा शूराणां शविष्ठा ता हि भूतम् ।
मघोनां मंहिष्ठा तुविशुष्म ऋतेन वृत्रतुरा सर्वसेना॥
verses.tr: tā hi śreṣṭhā devatātā tujā śūrāṇāṃ śaviṣṭhā tā hi bhūtam maghonāṃ maṃhiṣṭhā tuviśuṣma ṛtena vṛtraturā sarvasenā
verses.en: For at Gods' worship they are best through vigour; they have become the strongest of the Heroes; With mighty strength, most liberal of the Princes, Chiefs of the host, by Law made Vrtra's slayers.

verses.sa:
ता गृणीहि नमस्येभिः शूषैः सुम्नेभिरिन्द्रावरुणा चकाना ।
वज्रेणान्यः शवसा हन्ति वृत्रं सिषक्त्यन्यो वृजनेषु विप्रः॥
verses.tr: tā gṛṇīhi namasyebhiḥ śūṣaiḥ sumnebhirindrāvaruṇā cakānā vajreṇānyaḥ śavasā hanti vṛtraṃ siṣaktyanyo vṛjaneṣu vipraḥ
verses.en: Praise those Twain Gods for powers that merit worship, Indra and Varuna, for bliss, the joyous. One with his might and thunderbolt slays Vrtra; the other as a Sage stands near in troubles.

verses.sa:
ग्नाश्च यन्नरश्च वावृधन्त विश्वे देवासो नरां स्वगूर्ताः ।
प्रैभ्य इन्द्रावरुणा महित्वा द्यौश्च पृथिवि भूतमुर्वी॥
verses.tr: gnāśca yannaraśca vāvṛdhanta viśve devāso narāṃ svagūrtāḥ praibhya indrāvaruṇā mahitvā dyauśca pṛthivi bhūtamurvī
verses.en: Though dames and men have waxen strong and mighty, and all the Gods selfpraised among the Heroes, Ye, Indra-Varuna, have in might surpassed them, and thus were ye spread wide, O Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
स इत्सुदानुः स्ववाँ ऋतावेन्द्रा यो वां वरुण दाशति त्मन् ।
इषा स द्विषस्तरेद्दास्वान्वंसद्रयिं रयिवतश्च जनान्॥
verses.tr: sa itsudānuḥ svavāṃ ṛtāvendrā yo vāṃ varuṇa dāśati tman iṣā sa dviṣastareddāsvānvaṃsadrayiṃ rayivataśca janān
verses.en: Righteous is he, and liberal and helpful who, Indra-Varuna, brings you gifts with gladness. That bounteous man through food shall conquer faemen, and win him opulence and wealthy people.

verses.sa:
यं युवं दाश्वध्वराय देवा रयिं धत्थो वसुमन्तं पुरुक्षुम् ।
अस्मे स इन्द्रावरुणावपि ष्यात्प्र यो भनक्ति वनुषामशस्तीः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ yuvaṃ dāśvadhvarāya devā rayiṃ dhattho vasumantaṃ purukṣum asme sa indrāvaruṇāvapi ṣyātpra yo bhanakti vanuṣāmaśastīḥ
verses.en: May wealth which ye bestow in food and treasure on him who brings you gifts and sacrifices, Wealth, Gods! which breaks the curse of those who vex us, be, Indra-Varuna, e'en our own possession.

verses.sa:
उत नः सुत्रात्रो देवगोपाः सूरिभ्य इन्द्रावरुणा रयिः ष्यात् ।
येषां शुष्मः पृतनासु साह्वान्प्र सद्यो द्युम्ना तिरते ततुरिः॥
verses.tr: uta naḥ sutrātro devagopāḥ sūribhya indrāvaruṇā rayiḥ ṣyāt yeṣāṃ śuṣmaḥ pṛtanāsu sāhvānpra sadyo dyumnā tirate taturiḥ
verses.en: So also, Indra-Varuna, may our princes have riches swift to save, with Gods to guard them- They whose great might gives victory in battles, and their triumphant glory spreads with swiftness.

verses.sa:
नू न इन्द्रावरुणा गृणाना पृङ्क्तं रयिं सौश्रवसाय देवा ।
इत्था गृणन्तो महिनस्य शर्धोऽपो न नावा दुरिता तरेम॥
verses.tr: nū na indrāvaruṇā gṛṇānā pṛṅktaṃ rayiṃ sauśravasāya devā itthā gṛṇanto mahinasya śardho'po na nāvā duritā tarema
verses.en: Indra. and Varuna, Gods whom we are lauding, mingle ye wealth with our heroic glory. May we, who praise the strength of what is mighty, pass dangers, as with boats we cross the waters.

verses.sa:
प्र सम्राजे बृहते मन्म नु प्रियमर्च देवाय वरुणाय सप्रथः ।
अयं य उर्वी महिना महिव्रतः क्रत्वा विभात्यजरो न शोचिषा॥
verses.tr: pra samrāje bṛhate manma nu priyamarca devāya varuṇāya saprathaḥ ayaṃ ya urvī mahinā mahivrataḥ kratvā vibhātyajaro na śociṣā
verses.en: Now will I sing a dear and far-extending hymn to Varuna the God, sublime, imperial Lord, Who, mighty Governor, Eternal, as with flame, illumines both wide worlds with majesty and power.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणा सुतपाविमं सुतं सोमं पिबतं मद्यं धृतव्रता ।
युवो रथो अध्वरं देववीतये प्रति स्वसरमुप याति पीतये॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇā sutapāvimaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ pibataṃ madyaṃ dhṛtavratā yuvo ratho adhvaraṃ devavītaye prati svasaramupa yāti pītaye
verses.en: True to Law, Indra-Varuna, drinkers of the juice, drink this pressed Soma which shall give you rapturous joy. Your chariot cometh to the banquet of the Gods, to sacrifice, as it were home, that ye may drink.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणा मधुमत्तमस्य वृष्णः सोमस्य वृषणा वृषेथाम् ।
इदं वामन्धः परिषिक्तमस्मे आसद्यास्मिन्बर्हिषि मादयेथाम्॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇā madhumattamasya vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām idaṃ vāmandhaḥ pariṣiktamasme āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayethām
verses.en: Indra and Varuna, drink your fill, ye Heroes, of this invigorating sweetest Soma. This juice is shed by us that ye may quaff it: on this trimmed grass be seated, and rejoice you

verses.sa:
इन्द्राविष्णू। त्रिष्टुप् ।
सं वां कर्मणा समिषा हिनोमीन्द्राविष्णू अपसस्पारे अस्य ।
जुषेथां यज्ञं द्रविणं च धत्तमरिष्टैर्नः पथिभिः पारयन्ता॥
verses.tr: indrāviṣṇū triṣṭup saṃ vāṃ karmaṇā samiṣā hinomīndrāviṣṇū apasaspāre asya juṣethāṃ yajñaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattamariṣṭairnaḥ pathibhiḥ pārayantā
verses.en: Indra and Visnu, at my task's completion I urge you on with food and sacred service. Accept the sacrifice and grant us riches, leading us on by unobstructed pathways.

verses.sa:
या विश्वासां जनितारा मतीनामिन्द्राविष्णू कलशा सोमधाना ।
प्र वां गिरः शस्यमाना अवन्तु प्र स्तोमासो गीयमानासो अर्कैः॥
verses.tr: yā viśvāsāṃ janitārā matīnāmindrāviṣṇū kalaśā somadhānā pra vāṃ giraḥ śasyamānā avantu pra stomāso gīyamānāso arkaiḥ
verses.en: Ye who inspire all hymns, Indra and Visnu, ye vessels who contain the Soma juices, May hymns of praise that now are sung address you, the lauds that are recited by the singers.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राविष्णू मदपती मदानामा सोमं यातं द्रविणो दधाना ।
सं वामञ्जन्त्वक्तुभिर्मतीनां सं स्तोमासः शस्यमानास उक्थैः॥
verses.tr: indrāviṣṇū madapatī madānāmā somaṃ yātaṃ draviṇo dadhānā saṃ vāmañjantvaktubhirmatīnāṃ saṃ stomāsaḥ śasyamānāsa ukthaiḥ
verses.en: Lords of joy-giving draughts, Indra and Visnu, come, giving gifts of treasure, to the Soma. With brilliant rays of hymns let chanted praises, repeated with the lauds, adorn and deck you.

verses.sa:
आ वामश्वासो अभिमातिषाह इन्द्राविष्णू सधमादो वहन्तु ।
जुषेथां विश्वा हवना मतीनामुप ब्रह्माणि शृणुतं गिरो मे॥
verses.tr: ā vāmaśvāso abhimātiṣāha indrāviṣṇū sadhamādo vahantu juṣethāṃ viśvā havanā matīnāmupa brahmāṇi śṛṇutaṃ giro me
verses.en: May your foe-conquering horses bring you hither, Indra and Visnu, sharers of the banquet. Of all our hymns accept the invocations list to my prayers and hear the songs I sing you.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राविष्णू तत्पनयाय्यं वां सोमस्य मद उरु चक्रमाथे ।
अकृणुतमन्तरिक्षं वरीयोऽप्रथतं जीवसे नो रजांसि॥
verses.tr: indrāviṣṇū tatpanayāyyaṃ vāṃ somasya mada uru cakramāthe akṛṇutamantarikṣaṃ varīyo'prathataṃ jīvase no rajāṃsi
verses.en: This your deed, Indra-Visnu, must be lauded: widely ye strode in the wild joy of Soma. Ye made the firmament of larger compass, and made the regions broad for our existence.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राविष्णू हविषा वावृधानाऽग्राद्वाना नमसा रातहव्या ।
घृतासुती द्रविणं धत्तमस्मे समुद्रः स्थः कलशः सोमधानः॥
verses.tr: indrāviṣṇū haviṣā vāvṛdhānā'grādvānā namasā rātahavyā ghṛtāsutī draviṇaṃ dhattamasme samudraḥ sthaḥ kalaśaḥ somadhānaḥ
verses.en: Strengthened with sacred offerings, IndraVisnu, first eaters, served with worship ana oblation, Fed with the holy oil, vouchsafe us riches ye are the lake, the vat that holds the Soma.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राविष्णू पिबतं मध्वो अस्य सोमस्य दस्रा जठरं पृणेथाम् ।
आ वामन्धांसि मदिराण्यग्मन्नुप ब्रह्माणि शृणुतं हवं मे॥
verses.tr: indrāviṣṇū pibataṃ madhvo asya somasya dasrā jaṭharaṃ pṛṇethām ā vāmandhāṃsi madirāṇyagmannupa brahmāṇi śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ me
verses.en: Drink of this meath, O Indra, thou, and Visnu; drink ye your fill of Soma, Wonder-Workers. The sweet exhilarating juice hath reached you. Hear ye my prayers, give ear unto my calling.

verses.sa:
उभा जिग्यथुर्न परा जयेथे न परा जिग्ये कतरश्चनैनोः ।
इन्द्रश्च विष्णो यदपस्पृधेथां त्रेधा सहस्रं वि तदैरयेथाम्॥
verses.tr: ubhā jigyathurna parā jayethe na parā jigye kataraścanainoḥ indraśca viṣṇo yadapaspṛdhethāṃ tredhā sahasraṃ vi tadairayethām
verses.en: Ye Twain have conquered, ne'er have you been conquered: never hath either of the Twain been vanquished. Ye, Indra-Visnu, when ye fought the battle, produced this infinite with three divisions.

verses.sa:
द्यावापृथिवी।जगती ।
घृतवती भुवनानामभिश्रियोर्वी पृथ्वी मधुदुघे सुपेशसा ।
द्यावापृथिवी वरुणस्य धर्मणा विष्कभिते अजरे भूरिरेतसा॥
verses.tr: dyāvāpṛthivījagatī ghṛtavatī bhuvanānāmabhiśriyorvī pṛthvī madhudughe supeśasā dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇasya dharmaṇā viṣkabhite ajare bhūriretasā
verses.en: Filled full of fatness, compassing all things that be, wide, spacious, dropping meath, beautiful in their form, The Heaven and the Earth by Varuna's decree, unwasting, rich in germs, stand parted each from each.

verses.sa:
असश्चन्ती भूरिधारे पयस्वती घृतं दुहाते सुकृते शुचिव्रते ।
राजन्ती अस्य भुवनस्य रोदसी अस्मे रेतः सिञ्चतं यन्मनुर्हितम्॥
verses.tr: asaścantī bhūridhāre payasvatī ghṛtaṃ duhāte sukṛte śucivrate rājantī asya bhuvanasya rodasī asme retaḥ siñcataṃ yanmanurhitam
verses.en: The Everlasting Pair, with full streams, rich in milk, in their pure rule pour fatness for the pious man. Ye who are Regents of this world, O Earth and Heaven, pour into us the genial flow that prospers meit.

verses.sa:
यो वामृजवे क्रमणाय रोदसी मर्तो ददाश धिषणे स साधति ।
प्र प्रजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस्परि युवोः सिक्ता विषुरूपाणि सव्रता॥
verses.tr: yo vāmṛjave kramaṇāya rodasī marto dadāśa dhiṣaṇe sa sādhati pra prajābhirjāyate dharmaṇaspari yuvoḥ siktā viṣurūpāṇi savratā
verses.en: Whoso, for righteous life, pours offerings to you, O Heaven and Earth, ye Hemispheres, that man succeeds. He in his seed is born again and spreads by Law: from you flow things diverse in form, but ruled alike.

verses.sa:
घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी अभीवृते घृतश्रिया घृतपृचा घृतावृधा ।
उर्वी पृथ्वी होतृवूर्ये पुरोहिते ते इद्विप्रा ईळते सुम्नमिष्टये॥
verses.tr: ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī abhīvṛte ghṛtaśriyā ghṛtapṛcā ghṛtāvṛdhā urvī pṛthvī hotṛvūrye purohite te idviprā īḻate sumnamiṣṭaye
verses.en: Enclosed in fatness, Heaven and Earth are bright therewith: they mingle with the fatness which they still increase. Wide, broad, set foremost at election of the priest, to them the singers pray for bliss to further them.

verses.sa:
मधु नो द्यावापृथिवी मिमिक्षतां मधुश्चुता मधुदुघे मधुव्रते ।
दधाने यज्ञं द्रविणं च देवता महि श्रवो वाजमस्मे सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: madhu no dyāvāpṛthivī mimikṣatāṃ madhuścutā madhudughe madhuvrate dadhāne yajñaṃ draviṇaṃ ca devatā mahi śravo vājamasme suvīryam
verses.en: May Heaven and Earth pour down the balmy rain for us, balm-dropping, yielding balm, with balm upon your path, Bestowing by your Godhead sacrifice and wealth, great fame and strength for us and good heroic might.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जं नो द्यौश्च पृथिवी च पिन्वतां पिता माता विश्वविदा सुदंससा ।
संरराणे रोदसी विश्वशम्भुवा सनिं वाजं रयिमस्मे समिन्वताम्॥
verses.tr: ūrjaṃ no dyauśca pṛthivī ca pinvatāṃ pitā mātā viśvavidā sudaṃsasā saṃrarāṇe rodasī viśvaśambhuvā saniṃ vājaṃ rayimasme saminvatām
verses.en: May Heaven and Earth make food swell plenteously for us, all-knowing Father, jother, wondrous in their works. Pouring out bounties, may, in union, both the Worlds, all beneficial, send us gain, and power, and wealth.

verses.sa:
उदु ष्य देवः सविता हिरण्यया बाहू अयंस्त सवनाय सुक्रतुः ।
घृतेन पाणी अभि प्रुष्णुते मखो युवा सुदक्षो रजसो विधर्मणि॥
verses.tr: udu ṣya devaḥ savitā hiraṇyayā bāhū ayaṃsta savanāya sukratuḥ ghṛtena pāṇī abhi pruṣṇute makho yuvā sudakṣo rajaso vidharmaṇi
verses.en: Full of effectual wisdom Savitar the God hath stretched out golden arms that he may bring forth life. Young and most skilful, while he holds the region up, the Warrior sprinkles fatness over both his hands.

verses.sa:
देवस्य वयं सवितुः सवीमनि श्रेष्ठे स्याम वसुनश्च दावने ।
यो विश्वस्य द्विपदो यश्चतुष्पदो निवेशने प्रसवे चासि भूमनः॥
verses.tr: devasya vayaṃ savituḥ savīmani śreṣṭhe syāma vasunaśca dāvane yo viśvasya dvipado yaścatuṣpado niveśane prasave cāsi bhūmanaḥ
verses.en: May we enjoy the noblest vivifying force of Savitar the God, that he may give us wealth: For thou art mighty to produce and lull to rest the world of life that moves on two feet and on four.

verses.sa:
अदब्धेभिः सवितः पायुभिष्ट्वं शिवेभिरद्य परि पाहि नो गयम् ।
हिरण्यजिह्वः सुविताय नव्यसे रक्षा माकिर्नो अघशंस ईशत॥
verses.tr: adabdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pāyubhiṣṭvaṃ śivebhiradya pari pāhi no gayam hiraṇyajihvaḥ suvitāya navyase rakṣā mākirno aghaśaṃsa īśata
verses.en: Protect our habitation, Savitar, this day, with guardian aids around, auspicious, firm and true. God of the golden tongue, keep us for newest bliss: let not the evil-wisher have us in his power.

verses.sa:
उदु ष्य देवः सविता दमूना हिरण्यपाणिः प्रतिदोषमस्थात् ।
अयोहनुर्यजतो मन्द्रजिह्व आ दाशुषे सुवति भूरि वामम्॥
verses.tr: udu ṣya devaḥ savitā damūnā hiraṇyapāṇiḥ pratidoṣamasthāt ayohanuryajato mandrajihva ā dāśuṣe suvati bhūri vāmam
verses.en: This Savitar the God, the golden-handed, Friend of the home, hath risen to meet the twilight. With cheeks of brass, with pleasant tongue, the Holy, he sends the worshipper rich gifts in plenty.

verses.sa:
उदू अयाँ उपवक्तेव बाहू हिरण्यया सविता सुप्रतीका ।
दिवो रोहांस्यरुहत्पृथिव्या अरीरमत्पतयत्कच्चिदभ्वम्॥
verses.tr: udū ayāṃ upavakteva bāhū hiraṇyayā savitā supratīkā divo rohāṃsyaruhatpṛthivyā arīramatpatayatkaccidabhvam
verses.en: Like a Director, Savitar hath extended his golden arms, exceeding fair to look on. He hath gone up the heights of earth and heaven, and made each monster fall and cease from troubling.

verses.sa:
वाममद्य सवितर्वाममु श्वो दिवेदिवे वाममस्मभ्यं सावीः ।
वामस्य हि क्षयस्य देव भूरेरया धिया वामभाजः स्याम॥
verses.tr: vāmamadya savitarvāmamu śvo divedive vāmamasmabhyaṃ sāvīḥ vāmasya hi kṣayasya deva bhūrerayā dhiyā vāmabhājaḥ syāma
verses.en: Fair wealth, O Savitar, to-day, to-morrow, fair wealth produce for us each day that passes. May we through this our song be happy gainers, God, of a fair and spacious habitation.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमौ।त्रिष्टुप् ।
इन्द्रासोमा महि तद्वां महित्वं युवं महानि प्रथमानि चक्रथुः ।
युवं सूर्यं विविदथुर्युवं स्व१र्विश्वा तमांस्यहतं निदश्च॥
verses.tr: indrāsomautriṣṭup indrāsomā mahi tadvāṃ mahitvaṃ yuvaṃ mahāni prathamāni cakrathuḥ yuvaṃ sūryaṃ vividathuryuvaṃ sva1rviśvā tamāṃsyahataṃ nidaśca
verses.en: Great is this might of yours, Indra and Soma: the first high exploits were your own achievements. Ye found the Sun ye found the light of heaven: ye killed all darkness and the Gods' blasphemers.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा वासयथ उषासमुत्सूर्यं नयथो ज्योतिषा सह ।
उप द्यां स्कम्भथुः स्कम्भनेनाप्रथतं पृथिवीं मातरं वि॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā vāsayatha uṣāsamutsūryaṃ nayatho jyotiṣā saha upa dyāṃ skambhathuḥ skambhanenāprathataṃ pṛthivīṃ mātaraṃ vi
verses.en: Ye, Indra-Soma, gave her light to Morning, and led the Sun on high with all his splendour. Ye stayed the heaven with a supporting pillar, and spread abroad apart, the Earth, the Mother.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमावहिमपः परिष्ठां हथो वृत्रमनु वां द्यौरमन्यत ।
प्रार्णांस्यैरयतं नदीनामा समुद्राणि पप्रथुः पुरूणि॥
verses.tr: indrāsomāvahimapaḥ pariṣṭhāṃ hatho vṛtramanu vāṃ dyauramanyata prārṇāṃsyairayataṃ nadīnāmā samudrāṇi paprathuḥ purūṇi
verses.en: Ye slew the flood -obstructing serpent Vrtra, Indra and Soma: Heaven approved your exploit. Ye urged to speed the currents of the rivers, and many seas have ye filled full with waters.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा पक्वमामास्वन्तर्नि गवामिद्दधथुर्वक्षणासु ।
जगृभथुरनपिनद्धमासु रुशच्चित्रासु जगतीष्वन्तः॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā pakvamāmāsvantarni gavāmiddadhathurvakṣaṇāsu jagṛbhathuranapinaddhamāsu ruśaccitrāsu jagatīṣvantaḥ
verses.en: Ye in the unripe udders of the milch-kine have set the ripe milk, Indra, thou, and Soma. Ye have held fast the unimpeded whiteness within these many-coloured moving creatures.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा युवमङ्ग तरुत्रमपत्यसाचं श्रुत्यं रराथे ।
युवं शुष्मं नर्यं चर्षणिभ्यः सं विव्यथुः पृतनाषाहमुग्रा॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā yuvamaṅga tarutramapatyasācaṃ śrutyaṃ rarāthe yuvaṃ śuṣmaṃ naryaṃ carṣaṇibhyaḥ saṃ vivyathuḥ pṛtanāṣāhamugrā
verses.en: Verily ye bestow, Indra and Soma, wealth, famed, victorious, passing to our children. Ye have invested men, ye Mighty Beings, with manly strength that conquers in the battle.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिः। त्रिष्टुप् ।
यो अद्रिभित्प्रथमजा ऋतावा बृहस्पतिराङ्गिरसो हविष्मान् ।
द्विबर्हज्मा प्राघर्मसत्पिता न आ रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatiḥ triṣṭup yo adribhitprathamajā ṛtāvā bṛhaspatirāṅgiraso haviṣmān dvibarhajmā prāgharmasatpitā na ā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti
verses.en: Served with oblations, first-born, mountain-render, Angiras' son, Brhaspati, the Holy, With twice-firm path, dwelling in light, our Father, roars loudly, as a bull, to Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
जनाय चिद्य ईवत उ लोकं बृहस्पतिर्देवहूतौ चकार ।
घ्नन्वृत्राणि वि पुरो दर्दरीति जयञ्छत्रूँरमित्रान्पृत्सु साहन्॥
verses.tr: janāya cidya īvata u lokaṃ bṛhaspatirdevahūtau cakāra ghnanvṛtrāṇi vi puro dardarīti jayañchatrūṃramitrānpṛtsu sāhan
verses.en: Brhaspati, who made for such a people wide room and verge when Gods were invocated, Slaying his enemies, breaks down their castles, quelling his foes and conquering those who hate him.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिः समजयद्वसूनि महो व्रजान्गोमतो देव एषः ।
अपः सिषासन्त्स्व१रप्रतीतो बृहस्पतिर्हन्त्यमित्रमर्कैः॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatiḥ samajayadvasūni maho vrajāngomato deva eṣaḥ apaḥ siṣāsantsva1rapratīto bṛhaspatirhantyamitramarkaiḥ
verses.en: Brhaspati in war hath won rich treasures, hath won, this God, the great stalls filled with cattle. Striving to win waters and light, resistless, Brhaspati with lightning smites the foeman.

verses.sa:
सोमारुद्रौ। त्रिष्टुप् ।
सोमारुद्रा धारयेथामसुर्यं१ प्र वामिष्टयोऽरमश्नुवन्तु ।
दमेदमे सप्त रत्ना दधाना शं नो भूतं द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे॥
verses.tr: somārudrau triṣṭup somārudrā dhārayethāmasuryaṃ1 pra vāmiṣṭayo'ramaśnuvantu damedame sapta ratnā dadhānā śaṃ no bhūtaṃ dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade
verses.en: Hold fast your Godlike sway, O Soma-Rudra: let these our sacrifices quickly reach you. Placing in every house your seven great treasures, bring blessing to our quadrupeds and bipeds.

verses.sa:
सोमारुद्रा वि वृहतं विषूचीममीवा या नो गयमाविवेश ।
आरे बाधेथां निॠतिं पराचैरस्मे भद्रा सौश्रवसानि सन्तु॥
verses.tr: somārudrā vi vṛhataṃ viṣūcīmamīvā yā no gayamāviveśa āre bādhethāṃ niṝtiṃ parācairasme bhadrā sauśravasāni santu
verses.en: Soma and Rudra, chase to every quarter the sickness that hath visited our dwelling. Drive Nirrti away into the distance, and give us excellent and happy glories.

verses.sa:
सोमारुद्रा युवमेतान्यस्मे विश्वा तनूषु भेषजानि धत्तम् ।
अव स्यतं मुञ्चतं यन्नो अस्ति तनूषु बद्धं कृतमेनो अस्मत्॥
verses.tr: somārudrā yuvametānyasme viśvā tanūṣu bheṣajāni dhattam ava syataṃ muñcataṃ yanno asti tanūṣu baddhaṃ kṛtameno asmat
verses.en: Provide, O Soma-Rudra, for our bodies all needful medicines to heal and cure us. Set free and draw away the sin committed which we have still inherent in our persons.

verses.sa:
तिग्मायुधौ तिग्महेती सुशेवौ सोमारुद्राविह सु मृळतं नः ।
प्र नो मुञ्चतं वरुणस्य पाशाद्गोपायतं नः सुमनस्यमाना॥
verses.tr: tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāviha su mṛḻataṃ naḥ pra no muñcataṃ varuṇasya pāśādgopāyataṃ naḥ sumanasyamānā
verses.en: Armed with keen shafts and weapons, kind and loving, be gracious unto us, Soma and Rudra. Release us from the noose of Varuna; keep us from sorrow, in your tender loving-kindness.

verses.sa:
जीमूतस्येव भवति प्रतीकं यद्वर्मी याति समदामुपस्थे ।
अनाविद्धया तन्वा जय त्वं स त्वा वर्मणो महिमा पिपर्तु॥
verses.tr: jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratīkaṃ yadvarmī yāti samadāmupasthe anāviddhayā tanvā jaya tvaṃ sa tvā varmaṇo mahimā pipartu
verses.en: The warrior's look is like a thunderous rain-cloud's, when, armed with mail, he seeks the lap of battle. Be thou victorious with unwounded body: so let the thickness of thy mail protect thee.

verses.sa:
धन्वना गा धन्वनाजिं जयेम धन्वना तीव्राः समदो जयेम ।
धनुः शत्रोरपकामं कृणोति धन्वना सर्वाः प्रदिशो जयेम॥
verses.tr: dhanvanā gā dhanvanājiṃ jayema dhanvanā tīvrāḥ samado jayema dhanuḥ śatrorapakāmaṃ kṛṇoti dhanvanā sarvāḥ pradiśo jayema
verses.en: With Bow let us win kine, with Bow the battle, with Bow be victors in our hot encounters. The Bow brings grief and sorrow to the foeman: armed with the Bow may we subdue all regions.

verses.sa:
वक्ष्यन्तीवेदा गनीगन्ति कर्णं प्रियं सखायं परिषस्वजाना ।
योषेव शिङ्क्ते वितताधि धन्वञ्ज्या इयं समने पारयन्ती॥
verses.tr: vakṣyantīvedā ganīganti karṇaṃ priyaṃ sakhāyaṃ pariṣasvajānā yoṣeva śiṅkte vitatādhi dhanvañjyā iyaṃ samane pārayantī
verses.en: Close to his car, as fain to speak, She presses, holding her well-loved Friend in her embraces. Strained on the Bow, She whispers like a woman-this Bowstring that preserves us in the combat.

verses.sa:
ते आचरन्ती समनेव योषा मातेव पुत्रं बिभृतामुपस्थे ।
अप शत्रून्विध्यतां संविदाने आर्त्नी इमे विष्फुरन्ती अमित्रान्॥
verses.tr: te ācarantī samaneva yoṣā māteva putraṃ bibhṛtāmupasthe apa śatrūnvidhyatāṃ saṃvidāne ārtnī ime viṣphurantī amitrān
verses.en: These, meeting like a woman and her lover, bear, mother-like, their child upon their bosom. May the two Bow-ends, starting swift asunder, scatter, in unison, the foes who hate us.

verses.sa:
बह्वीनां पिता बहुरस्य पुत्रश्चिश्चा कृणोति समनावगत्य ।
इषुधिः सङ्काः पृतनाश्च सर्वाः पृष्ठे निनद्धो जयति प्रसूतः॥
verses.tr: bahvīnāṃ pitā bahurasya putraściścā kṛṇoti samanāvagatya iṣudhiḥ saṅkāḥ pṛtanāśca sarvāḥ pṛṣṭhe ninaddho jayati prasūtaḥ
verses.en: With many a son, father of many daughters, He clangs and clashes as he goes to battle. Slung on the back, pouring his brood, the Quiver vanquishes all opposing bands and armies.

verses.sa:
रथे तिष्ठन्नयति वाजिनः पुरो यत्रयत्र कामयते सुषारथिः ।
अभीशूनां महिमानं पनायत मनः पश्चादनु यच्छन्ति रश्मयः॥
verses.tr: rathe tiṣṭhannayati vājinaḥ puro yatrayatra kāmayate suṣārathiḥ abhīśūnāṃ mahimānaṃ panāyata manaḥ paścādanu yacchanti raśmayaḥ
verses.en: Upstanding in the Car the skilful Charioteer guides his strong Horses on whithersoe'er he will. See and admire the strength of those controlling Reins which from behind declare the will of him who drives.

verses.sa:
तीव्रान्घोषान्कृण्वते वृषपाणयोऽश्वा रथेभिः सह वाजयन्तः ।
अवक्रामन्तः प्रपदैरमित्रान्क्षिणन्ति शत्रूँरनपव्ययन्तः॥
verses.tr: tīvrānghoṣānkṛṇvate vṛṣapāṇayo'śvā rathebhiḥ saha vājayantaḥ avakrāmantaḥ prapadairamitrānkṣiṇanti śatrūṃranapavyayantaḥ
verses.en: Horses whose hoofs rain dust are neighing loudly, yoked to the Chariots, showing forth their vigour, With their forefeet descending on the foemen, they, never flinching, trample and destroy them.

verses.sa:
रथवाहनं हविरस्य नाम यत्रायुधं निहितमस्य वर्म ।
तत्रा रथमुप शग्मं सदेम विश्वाहा वयं सुमनस्यमानाः॥
verses.tr: rathavāhanaṃ havirasya nāma yatrāyudhaṃ nihitamasya varma tatrā rathamupa śagmaṃ sadema viśvāhā vayaṃ sumanasyamānāḥ
verses.en: Car-bearer is the name of his oblation, whereon are laid his Weapons and his Armour. So let us here, each day that passes, honour the helpful Car with hearts exceeding joyful.

verses.sa:
स्वादुषंसदः पितरो वयोधाः कृच्छ्रेश्रितः शक्तीवन्तो गभीराः ।
चित्रसेना इषुबला अमृध्राः सतोवीरा उरवो व्रातसाहाः॥
verses.tr: svāduṣaṃsadaḥ pitaro vayodhāḥ kṛcchreśritaḥ śaktīvanto gabhīrāḥ citrasenā iṣubalā amṛdhrāḥ satovīrā uravo vrātasāhāḥ
verses.en: In sweet association lived the fathers who gave us life, profound and strong in trouble, Unwearied, armed with shafts and wondrous weapons, free, real heroes, conquerors of armies.

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणासः पितरः सोम्यासः शिवे नो द्यावापृथिवी अनेहसा ।
पूषा नः पातु दुरितादृतावृधो रक्षा माकिर्नो अघशंस ईशत॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇāsaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ śive no dyāvāpṛthivī anehasā pūṣā naḥ pātu duritādṛtāvṛdho rakṣā mākirno aghaśaṃsa īśata
verses.en: The Brahmans, and the Fathers meet for Soma-draughts, and, graciously inclined, unequalled Heaven and Earth. Guard us from evil, Pusan, guard us strengtheners of Law: let not the evil-wisher master us.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णं वस्ते मृगो अस्या दन्तो गोभिः संनद्धा पतति प्रसूता ।
यत्रा नरः सं च वि च द्रवन्ति तत्रास्मभ्यमिषवः शर्म यंसन्॥
verses.tr: suparṇaṃ vaste mṛgo asyā danto gobhiḥ saṃnaddhā patati prasūtā yatrā naraḥ saṃ ca vi ca dravanti tatrāsmabhyamiṣavaḥ śarma yaṃsan
verses.en: Her tooth a deer, dressed in an eagle's feathers, bound with cow-hide, launched forth, She flieth onward. There where the heroes speed hither and thither, there may the Arrows shelter and protect us.

verses.sa: ऋजीते परि वृङ्धि नोऽश्मा भवतु नस्तनूः । सोमो अधि ब्रवीतु नोऽदितिः शर्म यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: ṛjīte pari vṛṅdhi no'śmā bhavatu nastanūḥ somo adhi bravītu no'ditiḥ śarma yacchatu
verses.en: Avoid us thou whose flight is straight, and let our bodies be as stone. May Soma kindly speak to us, and Aditi protect us well.

verses.sa: आ जङ्घन्ति सान्वेषां जघनाँ उप जिघ्नते । अश्वाजनि प्रचेतसोऽश्वान्त्समत्सु चोदय॥
verses.tr: ā jaṅghanti sānveṣāṃ jaghanāṃ upa jighnate aśvājani pracetaso'śvāntsamatsu codaya
verses.en: He lays his blows upon their backs, he deals his blows upon their thighs. Thou, Whip, who urgest horses, drive sagacious horses in the fray.

verses.sa:
अहिरिव भोगैः पर्येति बाहुं ज्याया हेतिं परिबाधमानः ।
हस्तघ्नो विश्वा वयुनानि विद्वान्पुमान्पुमांसं परि पातु विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: ahiriva bhogaiḥ paryeti bāhuṃ jyāyā hetiṃ paribādhamānaḥ hastaghno viśvā vayunāni vidvānpumānpumāṃsaṃ pari pātu viśvataḥ
verses.en: It compasses the arm with serpent windings, fending away the friction of the bowstring: So may the Brace, well-skilled in all its duties, guard manfully the man from every quarter.

verses.sa: आलाक्ता या रुरुशीर्ष्ण्यथो यस्या अयो मुखम् । इदं पर्जन्यरेतस इष्वै देव्यै बृहन्नमः॥
verses.tr: ālāktā yā ruruśīrṣṇyatho yasyā ayo mukham idaṃ parjanyaretasa iṣvai devyai bṛhannamaḥ
verses.en: Now to the Shaft with venom smeared, tipped with deer-horn, with iron mouth, Celestial, of Parjanya's seed, be this great adoration paid.

verses.sa: अवसृष्टा परा पत शरव्ये ब्रह्मसंशिते । गच्छामित्रान्प्र पद्यस्व मामीषां कं चनोच्छिषः॥
verses.tr: avasṛṣṭā parā pata śaravye brahmasaṃśite gacchāmitrānpra padyasva māmīṣāṃ kaṃ canocchiṣaḥ
verses.en: Loosed from the Bowstring fly away, thou Arrow, sharpened by our prayer. Go to the foemen, strike them home, and let not one be left alive.

verses.sa:
यत्र बाणाः सम्पतन्ति कुमारा विशिखा इव ।
तत्रा नो ब्रह्मणस्पतिरदितिः शर्म यच्छतु विश्वाहा शर्म यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: yatra bāṇāḥ sampatanti kumārā viśikhā iva tatrā no brahmaṇaspatiraditiḥ śarma yacchatu viśvāhā śarma yacchatu
verses.en: There where the flights of Arrows fall like boys whose locks are yet unshorn. Even there may Brahmanaspati, and Aditi protect us well, protect us well through all our days.

verses.sa:
मर्माणि ते वर्मणा छादयामि सोमस्त्वा राजामृतेनानु वस्ताम् ।
उरोर्वरीयो वरुणस्ते कृणोतु जयन्तं त्वानु देवा मदन्तु॥
verses.tr: marmāṇi te varmaṇā chādayāmi somastvā rājāmṛtenānu vastām urorvarīyo varuṇaste kṛṇotu jayantaṃ tvānu devā madantu
verses.en: Thy vital parts I cover with thine Armour: with immortality King Soma clothe thee. Varuna give thee what is more than ample, and in thy triumph may the Gods be joyful.

verses.sa: यो नः स्वो अरणो यश्च निष्ट्यो जिघांसति । देवास्तं सर्वे धूर्वन्तु ब्रह्म वर्म ममान्तरम्॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ svo araṇo yaśca niṣṭyo jighāṃsati devāstaṃ sarve dhūrvantu brahma varma mamāntaram
verses.en: Whoso would kill us, whether he be a strange foe or one of us,
